title: Intrinsically motivated humans and agents in open-world exploration
summary_zh: 研究比较人类、儿童和AI在开放世界探索中的内在动机。方法上，使用Crafter环境研究熵、信息增益和赋权。实验表明，三者与探索进度正相关，熵和赋权在儿童中更相关。
summary_en: This study compares intrinsic motivation in humans, children, and AI agents in open-world exploration. The method involves using the Crafter environment to study entropy, information gain, and empowerment. Experiments show that all three are positively correlated with exploration progress, with entropy and empowerment more strongly related to children's progress.
insights: 创新点：比较人类、儿童和AI的内在动机
方法亮点：使用Crafter环境研究探索动机
关键发现：熵和赋权与儿童探索进度更相关
insights_en: Novelty: Comparing intrinsic motivation in humans, children, and AI agents
Method highlight: Studying exploration motivation using the Crafter environment
Key finding: Entropy and empowerment are more strongly related to children's exploration progress
abstract: What drives exploration? Understanding the intrinsic motivation to explore is a long-standing challenge in both cognitive science and AI. In this study, we directly compare adults, children aged 8 to 12 y, and AI agents exploring a complex, open-ended environment called Crafter ( 1 ). We study how three common information-theoretic intrinsic objectives—entropy, information gain, and empowerment—relate to their behavior. We find that all three are positively correlated with human exploration progress for both children and adults, although entropy and empowerment are more strongly related to exploration progress in children than information gain. Furthermore, across agents and humans we observe that entropy initially increases rapidly, then plateaus, while empowerment increases continuously, suggesting that in early exploration they look for novel states, while in advanced exploration they look for states they can control. Finally, we find preliminary evidence that private speech about goals may aid exploration in children. Our data are available at https://github.com/alyd/humans_in_crafter_data .

title: Global, regional and national burden of cervical cancer in 1990–2023 with forecasts to 2050: a Global Burden of Disease study
Decoding the regulatory programs governing glioblastoma plasticity
summary_zh: 研究揭示胶质母细胞瘤的非遗传性细胞可塑性。开发scDORI框架分析单细胞多组学数据。发现结构化调控程序驱动肿瘤进展。
summary_en: This study uncovers the non-genetic cellular plasticity in glioblastoma. Develops the scDORI framework for single-cell multi-omics analysis. Discovers a structured regulatory program driving tumor progression.
insights: 创新点：scDORI框架应用于胶质母细胞瘤研究
方法亮点：单细胞多组学数据整合分析
关键发现：结构化调控程序驱动肿瘤进展
insights_en: Novelty: scDORI framework applied to glioblastoma research
Method highlight: Integration of single-cell multi-omics data analysis
Key finding: Structured regulatory program driving tumor progression
abstract: Abstract Glioblastoma is incurable and resistant to therapy despite genomic stability under treatment 1–8 , suggesting that non-genetic cellular plasticity is a central driver of progression. Whether such plasticity reflects stochastic state switching or is governed by predictable gene regulation has remained unclear 9–13 . Here we introduce scDORI (single-cell deep multi-omic regulatory inference)—a deep-learning framework that infers enhancer-driven gene-regulatory networks at single-cell resolution—and apply it to single-nucleus multiome profiles of more than one million cells from primary glioblastomas. Integrating computational inference with systematic perturbation screens across patient-derived models, we show that a structured regulatory program with an asymmetric interplay of activators and repressors governs cellular plasticity in glioblastoma. The resulting transition landscape is hierarchical and predictable, but permits cross-lineage trajectories that are absent from normal neurodevelopment. Within this landscape, low-plasticity states such as the neuronal-like state are not stable differentiation end points but actively maintained configurations, stabilized by a network of safeguard repressors that silence alternative fates. We identify MYT1L as the dominant member of this network, and show that it binds to and represses master regulators of every alternative state to consolidate neuronal-like identity. MYT1L restricted plasticity even under standard-of-care therapy and suppressed tumour growth and invasion in vivo. Conversely, loss of MYT1L reactivated plasticity and accelerated malignant features, indicating that low-plasticity identity requires continuous repression. These findings reframe malignant cell state stability as a balance between activation and continuous repression, and nominate safeguard repressors as candidate therapeutic targets that are distinct from differentiation-inducing activators, with potential relevance across cancers in which phenotypic switching drives therapy resistance.

title: Equivalence of pseudogap and pairing energy in a cuprate high-temperature superconductor
summary_zh: 研究揭示铜氧化物高温超导体中伪隙与配对能等价。采用局部噪声光谱测量。实验证明伪隙与电子配对相关。
summary_en: This study reveals the equivalence of pseudogap and pairing energy in cuprate high-temperature superconductors. Local shot-noise spectroscopy measurements are employed. Experiments confirm the correlation between the pseudogap and electron pairing.
insights: 创新点：伪隙与配对能等价性得到证实
方法亮点：局部噪声光谱测量技术
关键发现：伪隙与电子配对相关
insights_en: Novelty: Equivalence between pseudogap and pairing energy is confirmed
Method highlight: Local shot-noise spectroscopy technique
Key finding: Correlation between pseudogap and electron pairing
abstract: The pseudogap stands out in the phase diagram of the cuprate high-temperature superconductors because its origin and relationship to superconductivity remain elusive. The origin of the pseudogap has been debated, with competing hypotheses attributing it to preformed electron pairs or local order, such as charge density waves. We present unambiguous evidence supporting the pairing scenario, using local shot-noise spectroscopy measurements in Bi 2 Sr 2 CaCu 2 O 8+δ . Our data demonstrate that the pseudogap energy coincides with the onset of electron pairing and is spatially heterogeneous with values reaching up to 70 milli–electron volts. Our results exclude a pure local order origin of the pseudogap, link the pseudogap to Cooper pair formation, and suggest that the limiting factor for higher critical temperature in cuprates is phase coherence.

title: Aggression experience and observation drive shared behavioural and neural changes
summary_zh: 研究探讨观察和经验对行为改变的影响。开发大规模细胞类型特异性记录策略。发现攻击行为观察促进神经变化。
summary_en: This study explores the impact of observation and experience on behavioral change. Develops a large-scale cell-type specific recording strategy. Finds that aggression observation promotes neural changes.
insights: 创新点：大规模细胞类型特异性记录策略
方法亮点：观察和经验对行为改变的影响研究
关键发现：攻击行为观察促进神经变化
insights_en: Novelty: Large-scale cell-type specific recording strategy
Method highlight: Study on the impact of observation and experience on behavioral change
Key finding: Aggression observation promotes neural changes
abstract: ABSTRACT The ability to observe the social behavior of others and use observed information to bias future action is a fundamental building block of social cognition 1,2 . A foundational question is whether social observation and experience engage common circuit mechanisms that enable behavioral change. While classic studies on social learning have shown that aggressive behaviors can be learned through observation 3 , it remains unclear whether aggression observation promotes persistent neural changes that generalize to new contexts. Here, to directly compare the effects of aggression experience and observation at brain-wide scale, we develop a strategy to perform large-scale cell-type specific recordings across subcortical networks for social behavior control and learning. We record longitudinally while animals “train” through direct experience or observation, then probe shared differences in behavior and neural activity in a novel “hard” aggression context. Using supervised and unsupervised methods for behavioral quantification, we detect unique signatures of a shared behavioral strategy not present in animals with no training. During observation, we find widespread activation that mimics experience in networks for behavior generation, with critical differences in signals associated with reward and threat learning. After observation, we observe that changes persist into the novel aggression context, with increased similarity in the neural dynamics between experience and observation groups. Network-level modeling reveals persistent shared changes to a core aggression network, with widespread decoupling of inhibition from a key hypothalamic output region. This demonstrates that “experience-like” activity during observation can recruit a shared plasticity mechanism that biases behavior toward adaptive defensive strategies in new contexts.

title: Transcriptomic convergence and the female protective effect in autism
summary_zh: 研究揭示自闭症谱系障碍中女性保护效应的生物学基础。发现自闭症基因扰动导致基因表达共享效应。重建基因调控网络揭示保护机制。
summary_en: This study reveals the biological basis of the female protective effect in autism spectrum disorder. Finds that perturbations of autism genes lead to shared effects on gene expression. Reconstructs a gene regulatory network to reveal protective mechanisms.
insights: 创新点：自闭症谱系障碍中女性保护效应研究
方法亮点：基因扰动与基因表达关系分析
关键发现：基因调控网络揭示保护机制
insights_en: Novelty: Study on the female protective effect in autism spectrum disorder
Method highlight: Analysis of the relationship between gene perturbation and gene expression
Key finding: Gene regulatory network reveals protective mechanisms
abstract: ABSTRACT Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is highly heritable, and mutations in hundreds of genes have been implicated as individually rare causes of ASD 1–3 . Understanding how disruptions to these functionally diverse genes lead to the core features of ASD remains a major challenge 4 . Moreover, ASD is three- to four-fold more common in males than females 5 , and autistic females tend to carry more autosomal risk alleles for ASD compared to autistic males 6,7 , but the biological basis of this “female protective effect” (FPE) is unknown 8,9 . Here we show that individual perturbations of 18 ASD genes in human neural progenitor cells converge on shared effects on gene expression, including widespread downregulation of other ASD genes. De novo reconstruction of a gene regulatory network (GRN) enabled the identification of central transcriptional regulators, including the prominent ASD gene CHD8 as well as novel candidates such as REST , that drive this transcriptomic convergence. Furthermore, the X-linked transcription factor ZFX , which is expressed from both the active and the inactive X chromosomes in females 10 , emerged as a key activator of many ASD genes: we propose that the higher ZFX expression level observed in female brain can buffer damaging mutations in diverse ASD genes, contributing to the FPE. Together, these results reveal how key GRNs can become broadly and similarly dysregulated upon disruption of individual ASD genes and provide molecular insight into the female protective effect in ASD.

title: A spatiotemporal cancer cell trajectory underlies glioblastoma heterogeneity
summary_zh: 研究揭示胶质母细胞瘤异质性的时空细胞轨迹。构建人类胶质母细胞瘤深度单细胞和多组学图谱。发现细胞轨迹导致肿瘤区域化。
summary_en: This study uncovers the spatiotemporal cancer cell trajectory underlying glioblastoma heterogeneity. Constructs a deep single-cell and spatial multi-omics atlas of human glioblastoma. Finds that the cell trajectory leads to tumor regionalization.
insights: 创新点：胶质母细胞瘤异质性时空细胞轨迹研究
方法亮点：深度单细胞和多组学图谱构建
关键发现：细胞轨迹导致肿瘤区域化
insights_en: Novelty: Study on the spatiotemporal cancer cell trajectory in glioblastoma
Method highlight: Construction of deep single-cell and spatial multi-omics atlas
Key finding: Cell trajectory leads to tumor regionalization
abstract: Abstract Cancer cells display highly heterogeneous and plastic states in glioblastoma, an incurable brain tumour. However, how these malignant states arise and whether they follow defined cellular trajectories across tumours is poorly understood. Here, we generated a deep single cell and spatial multi-omic atlas of human glioblastoma that pairs transcriptomic, epigenomic and genomic profiling of 12 tumours across multiple regions. We identify that glioblastoma heterogeneity is driven by spatially-patterned transitions of cancer cells from developmental-like states towards those defined by a glial injury response and hypoxia. This cellular trajectory regionalises tumours into distinct tissue niches and manifests in a molecularly conserved manner across tumours as well as genetically distinct tumour subclones. Moreover, using a new deep learning framework to map cancer cell states jointly with clones in situ , we show that tumour subclones are finely spatially intermixed through glioblastoma tissue niches. Finally, we show that this cancer cell trajectory is intimately linked to myeloid heterogeneity and unfolds across regionalised myeloid signalling environments. Our findings define a stereotyped trajectory of cancer cells in glioblastoma and unify glioblastoma tumour heterogeneity into a tractable cellular and tissue framework.

title: Anterior cingulate neurons perform parallel processing of fixated and peripheral information to guide information sampling and choice
summary_zh: 研究探讨前扣带回神经元如何并行处理注视和周边信息以指导信息采样和选择。方法上，通过决策任务观察猕猴使用周边信息。实验表明，前扣带回神经元编码周边信息，帮助选择未注视但价值高的选项。
summary_en: This study investigates how anterior cingulate neurons parallel process fixated and peripheral information to guide information sampling and choice. The method involves observing monkeys in a decision-making task using peripheral information. Experiments show that ACC neurons encode this peripheral information, aiding in choosing valuable options that were never fixated.
insights: 创新点：发现前扣带回神经元编码周边信息
方法亮点：通过决策任务研究周边信息处理
关键发现：周边信息帮助选择未注视但价值高的选项
insights_en: Novelty: Discovery of ACC neurons encoding peripheral information
Method highlight: Studying peripheral information processing through decision-making tasks
Key finding: Peripheral information aids in choosing valuable options that were never fixated
abstract: Abstract We use our eyes to evaluate objects around us. Models of economic choice emphasise the impact of sequential fixation on valuation and choice, with prefrontal and anterior cingulate cortex (ACC) encoding values of fixated items. Yet whether these regions also evaluate non-fixated peripheral information to guide choice remains unknown. Here we show that in a decision-making task involving four simultaneously presented cues, rhesus macaques use peripheral information to guide information sampling and choice, and that ACC neurons encode this peripheral information. This served two distinct purposes: subjects were more likely to fixate valuable peripheral cues, and more likely to choose valuable options whose cues were never even fixated. ACC, orbitofrontal cortex, dorsolateral prefrontal cortex, and ventromedial prefrontal cortex neurons all encoded cue value as they were fixated. ACC was unique, however, in also conducting parallel processing of peripheral cues, including cues never fixated, to guide information sampling and choice.

title: Industrialization drives convergent microbiome and host physiological shifts in the human metaorganism
summary_zh: 研究显示工业化导致人类元生物体微生物组和宿主生理变化。方法上，分析全球微生物组保守协会队列的多变量数据。实验表明，工业化与微生物组成同质化、多样性降低和社区稳定性下降相关。
summary_en: This study shows that industrialization drives convergent microbiome and host physiological shifts in the human metaorganism. The method involves analyzing multivariate data from the Global Microbiome Conservancy cohort. Experiments indicate that industrialization is associated with homogenized microbial compositions, reduced microbial diversity, and lower community stability.
insights: 创新点：揭示了工业化对微生物组和生理的影响
方法亮点：分析全球微生物组保守协会队列的多变量数据
关键发现：工业化与微生物组成同质化和多样性降低相关
insights_en: Novelty: Reveals the impact of industrialization on the microbiome and physiology
Method highlight: Analyzes multivariate data from the Global Microbiome Conservancy cohort
Key finding: Industrialization associated with homogenized microbiome composition and reduced diversity
abstract: Understanding how host lifestyle and industrialization shape the human gut microbiome and intestinal physiology requires multimodal analyses across diverse global host contexts. Here, we generate multivariate data from the Global Microbiome Conservancy cohort, including gut microbiome, IgA-sequencing, host genotyping, diet, lifestyle and fecal biomarker profiles, to investigate host-microbiome interactions across gradients of industrialization and geography. We show that industrialization is associated with homogenized microbial compositions, reduced microbial diversity, and lower community stability, independent of host confounders. We further show that industrialization is linked to elevated markers of gut stress, increased IgA secretion, and altered patterns of IgA-bacteria interactions. Finally, we show that microbiome-based disease predictors trained on industrialized populations lose accuracy in less industrialized cohorts, highlighting limited cross-population transferability. Together, our results suggest profound restructuring of host-microbiome interactions due to industrialized lifestyles, and emphasize the need for inclusive, globally representative data to improve translational microbiome applications across diverse human populations.

title: Automated identification of individual birds by song enables multi-year recapture from passive acoustic monitoring data
abcFISH enables multiplexed, single-molecule visualization of circular RNA spatial heterogeneity
Nondisruptive 3D profiling of combinations of epigenetic marks in single cells
summary_zh: 开发Epi-PHR技术，实现单细胞三维组织中的表观遗传标记组合的非破坏性检测。技术可高分辨率定位基因。
summary_en: Epi-PHR technology is developed for non-destructive 3D profiling of epigenetic mark combinations in single cells, enabling high-resolution locus-specific detection.
insights: 创新点：Epi-PHR技术非破坏性三维检测
方法亮点：高分辨率基因定位
关键发现：表观遗传标记组合三维组织
insights_en: Novelty: Epi-PHR technology for non-destructive 3D profiling
Method highlight: High-resolution gene localization
Key finding: 3D organization of epigenetic mark combinations
abstract: Abstract Recent advancements in single-cell sequencing and spatial omics technologies have enhanced our understanding of diverse cellular identities, compositions, architectures, and functions. However, the single-cell three-dimensional (3D) organization of the epigenome is still not well understood, due to an absence of spatial single-cell methods that allow high-resolution, locus-specific detection of combinations of epigenetic marks while maintaining the 3D organization of the genome. Here, we develop Epigenetic Proximity Hybridization Reaction (Epi-PHR), a non-disruptive image-based single-cell spatial epigenetic profiling technology. Epi-PHR enables locus-specific and high-resolution in situ detection of combinations of epigenetic marks at hundreds of single gene targets within the same individual cells, while retaining the 3D organization of the genome. Dual-mark Epi-PHR in hippocampus tissue sections revealed region-specific epigenetic profiles. Phased Epi-PHR combined with chromatin tracing simultaneously detects allele-specific epigenetic states and chromatin conformations of a paternally imprinted Meg3 gene cluster in single cells, revealing associations between specific epigenetic mark enrichment and chromatin folding features for the distinct alleles from different parental origins. Surprisingly, we found that H3K9me3 abundance is positively associated with a chromatin domain boundary at the Meg3 locus among maternal copies. We expect Epi-PHR will be broadly applicable in research requiring single-cell spatial epigenetic information, and will help extend our understanding of the combinatorial epigenetic code and its relationship with chromatin organization.

title: HuBMAP Data Portal: a resource for multimodal spatial and single-cell data of healthy human tissues
summary_zh: 研究介绍HuBMAP数据门户，提供健康人类组织多模态空间和单细胞数据。方法上，构建数据门户，支持数据搜索、可视化和分析。实验表明，门户提供高质量数据。
summary_en: This study introduces the HuBMAP Data Portal, a resource for multimodal spatial and single-cell data of healthy human tissues. The method involves constructing a data portal that supports data search, visualization, and analysis. Experiments show that the portal provides high-quality data.
insights: 创新点：构建HuBMAP数据门户
方法亮点：支持数据搜索和可视化
关键发现：提供高质量数据
insights_en: Novelty: Construction of the HuBMAP Data Portal
Method highlight: Support for data search and visualization
Key finding: Provision of high-quality data
abstract: The NIH Human BioMolecular Atlas Program (HuBMAP) Data Portal (https://portal.hubmapconsortium.org/) serves as a comprehensive repository for multimodal, multi-scale spatial and single-cell data from healthy human tissues. As of August 2026, the portal hosts 9,316 public datasets from 26 data types spanning 29 organ classes across 501 donors. Portal infrastructure and user interfaces support data search and discovery, visualization, and analysis directly in web browsers. These capabilities include metadata- and data-driven search, collaborative Workspaces with access to high-performance compute, and interactive Vitessce visualizations across non-spatial, 2D, and 3D spatial datasets. Data-type-specific uniform processing pipelines and rigorous quality control processes ensure comparability of results across laboratories, organs, and donors, while externally processed community-contributed datasets provide complementary perspectives. Here we describe portal functionality, infrastructure, and design, and highlight its role as a platform for large-scale spatial single-cell research across diverse data types, organs, and scales.

title: Majorana edge reconstruction and the ν = 5/2 non-Abelian thermal Hall puzzle
summary_zh: 研究探讨ν = 5/2非阿贝尔热霍尔效应的机制。方法上，进行热传输测量。实验表明，实验结果与数值模拟存在分歧。
summary_en: This study explores the mechanism of the ν = 5/2 non-Abelian thermal Hall effect. The method involves thermal transport measurements. Experiments show that the experimental results are in tension with numerical studies.
insights: 创新点：揭示ν = 5/2非阿贝尔热霍尔效应的新机制
方法亮点：进行精确的热传输测量
关键发现：实验结果与数值模拟的分歧
insights_en: Novelty: Unveiling a new mechanism of the ν = 5/2 non-Abelian thermal Hall effect
Method highlight: Precise thermal transport measurements
Key finding: Discrepancy between experimental results and numerical studies
abstract: Pioneering thermal transport measurements on two-dimensional electron gases in high magnetic fields have demonstrated that the quantized Hall state at filling factor ν = 5/2 has a thermal Hall conductance κ quantized in half-integer multiples of κ 0 = π 2 k B 2 T / 3 h . Half-integer κ / κ 0 is a signature of neutral Majorana edge modes, in turn linked to the presence of non-Abelian anyon excitations in the bulk. However, the experimentally observed value of κ corresponds to the “PH-Pfaffian” state, in tension with numerical studies which instead favor either the Pfaffian or the AntiPfaffian. A variety of mechanisms have been invoked to explain this discrepancy, but have been either ruled out by further experiments or else involve fine-tuning. Building on density-matrix-renormalization group studies of physically realistic edges and analytic calculations of edge structure, we propose an alternative resolution of this puzzle involving an “edge reconstruction” solely involving the neutral Majorana sector of the theory. Such a Majorana edge reconstruction can “screen” a Pfaffian or AntiPfaffian bulk, so that transport signatures become indistinguishable from those of the PH-Pfaffian. We argue that this physically natural scenario is consistent with experiment.

title: Tracing the spread of Celtic languages using ancient genomics
summary_zh: 研究通过古代基因组学追踪凯尔特语系的传播。方法上，分析4,587个古代个体的基因组数据。实验表明，凯尔特语的早期分布与三个主要过程相关。
summary_en: This study traces the spread of Celtic languages using ancient genomics. The method involves analyzing genome-wide data from 4,587 ancient individuals. Experiments show that the early distribution of Celtic languages is related to three main processes.
insights: 创新点：利用古代基因组学追踪语言传播
方法亮点：分析大量古代个体基因组数据
关键发现：凯尔特语分布与三个主要过程相关
insights_en: Novelty: Tracing language spread using ancient genomics
Method highlight: Analyzing genome-wide data from a large number of ancient individuals
Key finding: Celtic language distribution related to three main processes
abstract: Abstract Celtic languages are today restricted to Europe’s Atlantic fringes but were widely spoken across the continent during the Iron Age 1–3 . How Celtic achieved this early distribution remains contested 4 , with alternative archaeological and linguistic models proposing different homelands and dispersal routes. Here we analyse genome-wide data from 4,587 ancient individuals, focusing on Bronze and Iron Age Europe, to test the extent to which these models fit reconstructed demographic histories. We identify three main processes shaping European population structure that are relevant to the Celtic dispersal. First, the arrival of Steppe-related ancestry with Bell Beaker-associated groups after around 4400 bp (calibrated years before present or 1950 ce ) across the region in which Celtic and related languages were later spoken. Second, a movement from southwestern Europe into Britain during the Bronze Age (3800–3200 bp ), consistent with scenarios in which Celtic formed along the Atlantic façade. Third, a westward expansion of ancestry related to Late Bronze Age Knovíz–Urnfield-associated populations from eastern central Europe (3200–2800 bp ), affecting France, the British Isles, northeastern Iberia and Italy and later associated with Iron Age Hallstatt and La Tène contexts 5–8 . Although all three movements have parallels with proposed models, we argue that the final movement, from eastern central Europe, is most parsimonious for the spread of Celtic. Although human history does not necessarily follow a parsimonious trajectory 9 and language shifts need not track genetic change, these results delimit the demographic scenarios that are plausible for the emergence of Celtic in prehistoric Europe.

title: Multimodal X-ray imaging reveals hierarchical fibre mechanics
summary_zh: 研究通过多模态X射线成像揭示纤维力学层次结构。方法上，引入TomoSAXS技术映射纤维到纤维的力学。实验表明，分子预应变与纤维组织相关。
summary_en: This study reveals hierarchical fiber mechanics using multimodal X-ray imaging. The method involves introducing TomoSAXS technology to map fibril-to-fiber mechanics. Experiments show that molecular pre-strain is related to fiber organization.
insights: 创新点：多模态X射线成像揭示纤维力学
方法亮点：TomoSAXS技术映射纤维力学
关键发现：分子预应变与纤维组织相关
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing fiber mechanics with multimodal X-ray imaging
Method highlight: TomoSAXS technology mapping fibril-to-fiber mechanics
Key finding: Molecular pre-strain related to fiber organization
abstract: Abstract Fibrous materials, ranging from connective tissues 1–4 to engineered composites 5–8 , are vital to many biological and man-made systems, optimized to withstand complex in operando or in vivo loading. The load-bearing capacity of intervertebral discs (IVDs) of the spine depends on a hierarchical extracellular matrix, where plywood-like lamellae of collagen fibres in the annulus fibrosus contain nanometre-scale fibrils built from staggered triple-helical monomers 4,9,10 . How intact IVDs couple fibril-scale mechanics to fibre-scale organization under load remains unresolved. Here we introduce TomoSAXS, a full-field 3D small-angle X-ray scattering tomography that maps fibril-to-fibre mechanics across an intact tissue. We show that intrafibrillar molecular pre-strain (D-period stagger) is lamellar textured and tightly correlated with microscale fibre strain. Pre-strain is inversely related to fibril strain and its variability, consistent with load-sharing through molecular unwinding. Radial strain bridges and high-curvature zones at the annulus fibrosus–nucleus pulposus interfaces emerge as critical regulators of local mechanics. These findings reveal concerted fibril–fibre interactions that sustain mechanical equilibrium in the IVD, preserving elasticity and shape. More broadly, TomoSAXS establishes a platform to visualize nanoscale-to-microscale matrix mechanics across biological and synthetic fibrous materials, with applications in ageing and disease, therapeutic evaluation and the design of bio-based and bio-inspired materials.

title: Seagrass sediment organic carbon burial rates are globally significant
summary_zh: 研究评估全球海草有机碳埋藏速率。综合332个沉积物芯数据。结果显示海草每年埋藏25±3克有机碳。
summary_en: This study assesses global seagrass organic carbon burial rates. A synthesis of 332 sediment cores reveals that seagrasses bury 25 ± 3 g OC m−2 yr−1 annually.
insights: 创新点：首次综合全球海草有机碳埋藏速率数据。
方法亮点：使用多源数据综合分析。
关键发现：海草有机碳埋藏速率对全球碳循环至关重要。
insights_en: Novelty: First comprehensive assessment of global seagrass organic carbon burial rates.
Method highlight: Multi-source data synthesis analysis.
Key finding: Seagrass organic carbon burial rates are crucial for global carbon cycling.
abstract: Abstract Crucial for coastal carbon sequestration, global seagrass organic carbon (OC) burial rates remain uncertain as early estimates were derived from mixed methodologies across geographically and taxonomically biased datasets. Here, we present a data-driven reassessment from a synthesis of 332 sediment cores spanning the last century. Results show that seagrasses bury OC at 25 ± 3 g OC m −2 yr −1 (geometric mean), with an area-weighted global average of 33 ± 9 g OC m −2 yr −1 . Rates reflect a balance between sediment OC content and sediment accumulation, which share a negative exponential relationship driven by mineral dilution. Based on a revised mapped seagrass extent (247,700–366,400 km 2 ), global burial scales to 6–15 Tg C yr −1 . Although one-fourth of earlier benchmarks, seagrasses account for 3–4% to 3–6% of total oceanic OC burial despite covering <0.1% of the seafloor. Combined with mangroves and tidal marshes, vegetated coastal ecosystems contribute 8–13% of oceanic OC burial.

title: Building a pre-trained model for single-cell multi-omics analysis beyond highly variable feature selection
summary_zh: 研究提出scPMMI，用于单细胞多组学数据的整合分析。scPMMI通过特征分组提高分析效率。
summary_en: This study presents scPMMI, a pre-trained multimodal model for integrative analysis of single-cell multi-omics data. scPMMI improves analysis efficiency by grouping features.
insights: 创新点：提出scPMMI模型进行单细胞多组学分析。
方法亮点：通过特征分组提高分析效率。
关键发现：scPMMI有效整合多组学数据。
insights_en: Novelty: Proposing scPMMI model for single-cell multi-omics analysis.
Method highlight: Improving analysis efficiency by feature grouping.
Key finding: scPMMI effectively integrates multi-omics data.
abstract: Abstract Single-cell multi-omics technologies enable simultaneous measurement of transcriptomic, epigenomic, and proteomic modalities in individual cells, offering a unique opportunity to dissect cellular identity and regulation. The heterogeneity of multi-omics data, together with the wide range of downstream analytical tasks, underscores the need for a versatile computational framework for integrative analysis. However, current multi-omics analysis approaches typically rely on task-specific training and highly variable feature selection, which can hinder effective knowledge transfer across datasets and discard biologically informative signals. Here, we present scPMMI, a pre-trained multimodal model for integrative analysis of single-cell multi-omics data. By grouping features into patches according to genomic coordinates, scPMMI processes tens of thousands of features per cell with reduced reliance on prior feature selection, thereby preserving more complete biological information. Our results demonstrate that scPMMI learns biologically coherent cell representations by jointly modeling multi-omics data. Through further transfer learning, the model can be readily adapted to achieve superior performance across diverse downstream tasks, including multi-omics integration, cell type annotation, protein abundance prediction, transcriptomic enhancement, and trajectory reconstruction.

title: Convergent genomic evolution of human gut bacteria along an industrialization gradient
summary_zh: 研究调查工业化梯度上人类肠道细菌的基因组适应性。方法上，收集了来自不同地区、生活方式和菌株的基因组。实验表明，工业化宿主的菌株经历蛋白质组大小的扩张和更大的泛基因组流动性。
summary_en: This study investigates the genomic adaptation of human gut bacteria along an industrialization gradient. The method involves collecting genomes from diverse host geographies, lifestyles, species, and strains. Experiments show that strains from industrialized hosts experience an expansion of proteome size and greater pangenome fluidity.
insights: 创新点：揭示了工业化对肠道细菌基因组的影响
方法亮点：收集了广泛样本的基因组
关键发现：工业化宿主菌株蛋白质组扩张和泛基因组流动性增加
insights_en: Novelty: Reveals the impact of industrialization on the gut bacteria genome
Method highlight: Collected genomes from a wide range of samples
Key finding: Strains from industrialized hosts show expanded proteome size and increased pangenome fluidity
abstract: To what extent gut bacteria respond to the distinct ecological pressures imposed by human lifestyle remains unclear. Here, we investigate how genomic adaptation in gut bacteria differ between industrialized and non-industrialized human populations. We generated a broad collection of isolate genomes spanning diverse host geographies, lifestyles, species, and strains. We first found that compared to MAGs, paired isolate genomes recover more functional elements and signals of horizontal gene transfers (HGTs). Leveraging isolate genomes from multiple species, we find that strains from industrialized hosts experience an expansion of proteome size and harbor greater pangenome fluidity, driven by recent events of HGTs. Gene- and variant-level analyses reveal convergent patterns of lifestyle-specific adaptation in functions that are critical for ecological adaptation, such as stress response, cell envelope remodeling and central metabolism. Our results demonstrate that industrialization imprints evolutionary signatures on gut bacterial genomes, illuminating the effects of rapidly changing environments on human biology.

title: Ecological and social cues orchestrate concerted courtship in Drosophila
summary_zh: 研究揭示生态和社会线索如何协调果蝇的求偶行为。方法上，观察果蝇在食物斑密集聚集时的求偶。实验表明，食物挥发物促进雄性性唤起，形成多感官反馈循环。
summary_en: This study reveals how ecological and social cues orchestrate concerted courtship in Drosophila. The method involves observing courtship in flies densely aggregating on a food patch. Experiments show that food volatiles promote male sexual arousal, leading to a multisensory feedback loop.
insights: 创新点：揭示生态和社会线索协调求偶
方法亮点：观察果蝇求偶行为
关键发现：食物挥发物促进性唤起
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing orchestration of courtship by ecological and social cues
Method highlight: Observing courtship behavior in Drosophila
Key finding: Food volatiles promote sexual arousal
abstract: Abstract Mating decisions are often attributed to the sensory signalling between prospective sexual partners. Yet these interactions are also shaped by the broader environmental context in which they unfold, to appropriately align sexual arousal with reproductive opportunities 1–6 . Here we show that in Drosophila erecta mating is strictly contingent on the ecological and social environment generated as flies densely aggregate in groups on a food patch. We find that food volatiles directly promote male sexual arousal, triggering individuals to sample and pursue potential mates, giving rise to dynamic interactions across the group. The ensuing visual motion transforms each male’s visual field, which in turn further amplifies his arousal, generating a multisensory feedback loop that coordinately promotes courtship across individuals. D. erecta ’s strict dependence on environmental cues appears latent in related species, such as Drosophila melanogaster , where food odour can promote arousal 7 but is dispensable for vigorous courtship. Comparative circuit analyses show that species-specific thresholds for sexual arousal reflect variation in how olfactory input modulates conserved nodes controlling courtship drive, rendering food volatiles a strict sensory gate only in D. erecta . Together, our findings highlight how environmental cues not directly tied to sexual signalling can profoundly influence reproductive behaviour and reorganize the social landscape to ensure mating occurs in contexts where reproductive opportunities are abundant.

title: Microbiome-wide PheWAS links gut microbial SNVs to health and exposures
summary_zh: 研究通过微生物组全表型关联研究将肠道微生物SNVs与健康和环境暴露联系起来。方法上，分析1270万肠道微生物SNVs与244个宿主健康表型和环境暴露。实验表明，发现至少两个队列支持的3,018个关联。
summary_en: This study links gut microbial single nucleotide variants (SNVs) to health and environmental exposures through microbiome-wide PheWAS. The method involves analyzing 12.7 million gut microbial SNVs with 244 host health phenotypes and environmental exposures. Experiments show that 3,018 associations supported by at least two cohorts were found.
insights: 创新点：将肠道微生物SNVs与健康联系
方法亮点：分析大量微生物组数据
关键发现：发现多个队列支持的关联
insights_en: Novelty: Linking gut microbial SNVs to health
Method highlight: Analyzing a large amount of metagenomic data
Key finding: Associations supported by multiple cohorts identified
abstract: Abstract The importance of the gut microbiome in human health has been widely recognized, with alterations in species abundances now reported for many different diseases. In recent years, observations of within-species genetic diversity and strain-level functional differences have urged the field to transition to analyzing microbes at the genetic level, taking advantage of genetic variants in the metagenome to pinpoint relevant genes and pathways. Here, we conducted a phenome-wide association study (PheWAS) of 12.7 million gut microbial single nucleotide variants (SNVs) with 244 host health phenotypes and environmental exposures in 10,781 individuals from six independent cohorts from Europe and Africa. We found 3,018 associations supported by at least two cohorts for 105 host factors, including age, sex and cardiovascular and metabolic parameters. Moreover, we found 34,927 significant associations in single-cohort analyses where SNV–phenotype pairs were only available for one cohort. All identified associations are detailed in an online catalog (https://fulab.web.rug.nl/SNV-MWAS/). The associated microbial SNVs inform mechanistic hypotheses about microbial functionality in human health and provide insights into microbial adaptation and evolution in response to changes in the environment and host physiology. For example, we identified 718 age-associated gut microbial SNVs across multiple cohorts and used these microbial SNVs to accurately predict host age. We also identified SNVs in microbial genes associated with lipid concentrations and BMI, including SNVs in the isoleucine-tRNA synthetase gene of Clostridium phoceensis and an α-Melanocyte-stimulating hormone-mimicking clpB gene of Alistipes ihumii. Mediation analysis provided evidence that microbial genetic variations may be under selection enforced by environmental factors, but also that they mediate the effects on the host, e.g. the isoleucyl-tRNA synthetase gene of C. phoceensis mediated dietary effects on four phenotypes. Overall, this study identifies new biological connections between human host and microbial genetic variants, exposing the functional layer of gut microbiome data hidden at base pair resolution and revealing microbial adaptation and evolution in relation to host lifestyle and physiology.

title: Chromosomal location reprograms genetic circuit function
summary_zh: 研究通过染色体位置重编程遗传电路功能。使用细菌作为底盘，构建了多种遗传电路。
summary_en: This study shows that genetic circuit function can be reprogrammed by chromosomal location. Various genetic circuits were engineered using bacteria as the chassis.
insights: 创新点：发现染色体位置可重编程遗传电路。
方法亮点：利用细菌底盘构建多种遗传电路。
关键发现：重编程无需改变DNA序列。
insights_en: Novelty: Discovery of chromosomal location reprogramming genetic circuits.
Method highlight: Engineering various genetic circuits using bacterial chassis.
Key finding: Reprogramming without altering DNA sequence.
abstract: Abstract Genetic circuits confer computing abilities to living cells, performing novel transformations of input stimuli into output responses. Circuit editing often focuses on substituting DNA components, such as RBSs, regulators, or promoters, from part libraries to achieve desired performance. However, this approach is inherently limited by the availability of DNA components. Here, we show that circuit performance can be reprogrammed without altering its DNA sequence by using a library of positions: a set of physical locations within the cell’s volume. Using bacteria as the living chassis, we engineer 219 spatially unique genetic circuits of four different types—three regulatory cascades and a toggle switch—by either inserting the entire circuit in a specific chromosomal position or separating and distributing circuit modules. Their analysis, together with a mathematical model, reveals that spatial positioning can be used not only to optimize circuits but also to switch circuits between modes of operation, giving rise to new functions as circuit complexity increases. We provide foundational insights into leveraging intracellular space for circuit design.

title: Energy-guided combinatorial co-optimization of antibody affinity and stability
summary_zh: 提出LAffAb策略，通过晶体结构优化抗体亲和力和稳定性。实验显示，亲和力提高30倍，稳定性优化。
summary_en: The LAffAb strategy is proposed to co-optimize antibody affinity and stability through crystallographic structure optimization. Experiments show a 30-fold increase in affinity and stability optimization.
insights: 创新点：LAffAb策略优化抗体特性
方法亮点：晶体结构指导优化
关键发现：亲和力和稳定性同时提升
insights_en: Novelty: LAffAb strategy for antibody property optimization
Method highlight: Crystallographic structure-guided optimization
Key finding: Simultaneous improvement in affinity and stability
abstract: Affinity maturation is an essential process in antibody engineering. Although powerful, it is iterative, time-consuming, and can result in trade-offs, where affinity is gained at the cost of important properties, such as specificity and stability. We present a scalable strategy, called LAffAb, that starts from a crystallographic structure of the antibody-antigen complex and introduces combinations of mutations to optimize its energy. A combinatorial library comprising 7,000 variants with up to nine mutations results in gains of up to 30-fold in affinity while co-optimizing stability. Surprisingly, the library does not converge on a single solution, instead favoring diverse variants with a high mutational load. Small-scale screening of 10 designs against a potential drug target results in an order-of-magnitude improvement in affinity while maintaining high developability. We also apply LAffAb to improve the developability of a therapeutic antibody without degrading affinity. We envision that LAffAb can be used to design stable, specific, and high-affinity binders and to improve our understanding of sequence, structure, and function relationships in antibodies.

title: Bayesian knockoff filter for controlling false discovery rate
summary_zh: 研究控制错误发现率的贝叶斯方法，开发贝叶斯敲除滤波器。方法上，结合敲除程序与贝叶斯框架。实验表明，该方法有效控制错误发现率。
summary_en: Studies Bayesian methods for controlling false discovery rates, developing the Bayesian knockoff filter. The method combines the knockoff procedure with a Bayesian framework. Experiments show the effectiveness of the method in controlling false discovery rates.
insights: 创新点：结合敲除程序与贝叶斯框架控制错误发现率
方法亮点：提出贝叶斯敲除滤波器
关键发现：有效控制错误发现率
insights_en: Novelty: Combined the knockoff procedure with a Bayesian framework to control false discovery rates
Method highlight: Proposed the Bayesian knockoff filter
Key finding: Effectively controlled false discovery rates
abstract: In many scientific fields, researchers are interested in discovering features with substantial effects on the response from a large number of candidate features while controlling the proportion of false discoveries. By incorporating the knockoff procedure in a Bayesian framework, we develop the Bayesian knockoff filter (BKF) for selecting important features. The BKF is built upon a tight upper bound for the posterior probability of the null hypothesis, which is derived under the Bayesian “flip-sign” property implied by our procedure. In contrast to the standard knockoff methods in the frequentist paradigm, we allow the knockoff variables to be generated in every iteration of the Markov chain Monte Carlo procedure, which removes the unwanted variability of the single-knockoff generation (knockoff is typically generated only once before the model fitting). Compared with multi-knockoffs, the BKF is more principled and natural in incorporating side information through prior distributions under a fully Bayesian framework. We further develop an e-value BKF approach to theoretically guarantee the frequentist false discovery rate (FDR) control. Numerical experiments on both synthetic and real data demonstrate the advantages of the BKF over existing knockoff methods and Bayesian variable selection approaches, i.e., the BKF possesses comparable power, yields a lower FDR and more stable selection sets.

title: Intratumoral cDC1–T cell clusters serve as sites of local costimulation to enhance CTL-mediated tumor rejection
summary_zh: 研究肿瘤内cDC1-T细胞簇作为局部共刺激位点，增强CTL介导的肿瘤排斥。采用STAMP模型，发现cDC1s和T细胞的分布决定肿瘤是否被排斥。
summary_en: This study investigates intratumoral cDC1–T cell clusters as sites of local costimulation to enhance CTL-mediated tumor rejection. Using the STAMP model, we found that the spatial distribution of cDC1s and T cells determines whether a tumor can be rejected.
insights: 创新点：揭示了肿瘤内cDC1-T细胞簇在肿瘤排斥中的作用
方法亮点：采用STAMP模型研究肿瘤免疫反应
关键发现：cDC1s和T细胞的分布决定肿瘤排斥
insights_en: Novelty: Reveals the role of intratumoral cDC1–T cell clusters in tumor rejection
Method highlight: Utilizes the STAMP model to study tumor immune responses
Key finding: The distribution of cDC1s and T cells determines tumor rejection
abstract: Summary T cells are essential for anti-tumor immunity, but their ability to eliminate tumors depends on coordinated interactions with type 1 conventional dendritic cells (cDC1s). While cDC1s are known for cross-presenting tumor-derived antigens in lymph nodes to prime CD8+ T cells, their role within the tumor itself remains less well understood. Here, we use the Skin Tumor Array by Micro-Poration (STAMP) model to investigate how cDC1-T cell interactions shape immune responses and influence tumor fate. Our data reveal that it is the spatial distribution of both cDC1s and T cells that determines whether a tumor can be rejected. We defined three primary immunotypes based on the spatial distribution of T cells and cDC1s: T cell-inflamed/dendritic cell-inflamed (TC-In/DC-In) tumors, where T cells and cDC1s co-infiltrate the tumor; T cell-inflamed/dendritic cell-excluded (TC-In/DC-Ex) tumors, where T cells infiltrate but cDC1s remain at the periphery; and T cell-excluded/dendritic cell-excluded (TC-Ex/DC-Ex) tumors, which lack both cDC1 and T cell infiltration. Notably, TC-In/DC-In tumors are more likely to undergo rejection, whereas TC-In/DC-Ex tumors persist despite T cell infiltration. Within TC-In/DC-In tumors, cDC1s engage in direct interactions with T cells, upregulate co-stimulatory molecules, and sustain effector T cell responses, while cDC1s in TC-In/DC-Ex tumors express higher migration-associated genes, suggesting a propensity to exit the tumor. We further show that chemokine modulation, particularly through CXCL9, CCL5, and XCL1, can reshape immune infiltration patterns to promote intra-tumoral cDC1-T cell clustering and improve tumor rejection. These findings underscore the unexpectedly important role of cDC1 positioning and function in sustaining effective anti-tumor immunity and highlight spatially organized cDC1-T cell clusters as critical hubs for local T cell activation.

title: Transcranial magnetic stimulation to the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex modulates single-neuron activity in humans
summary_zh: 经颅磁刺激dlPFC调节人类单神经元活动。研究发现TMS可引发神经元时间锁定的放电响应。
summary_en: Transcranial magnetic stimulation to the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex modulates single-neuron activity in humans. The study finds that TMS elicits time-locked firing responses in neurons.
insights: 创新点：揭示TMS对人类神经元活动的影响
方法亮点：使用颅内微电极记录技术
关键发现：TMS引发神经元放电响应
insights_en: Novelty: Reveals the effect of TMS on human neuron activity
Method highlight: Utilizes intracranial microelectrode recording technology
Key finding: TMS elicits neuron firing responses
abstract: Abstract Transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS) to the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (dlPFC) is an FDA-cleared treatment for depression, yet how cortical stimulation influences single neurons in deep brain circuits remains unknown. Using intracranial microelectrode recordings in four neurosurgical patients, we resolved single-neuron spikes as early as 8 ms from 185 single neurons after single-pulse left dlPFC TMS. TMS elicited time-locked firing responses in 46% of neurons across deep cortical and subcortical structures bilaterally. TMS facilitated putative interneuron spiking in striato-thalamic regions from ∼8 ms, peaking at ∼80-100 ms, and lasting to ∼1000 ms, while suppressing putative pyramidal cell spiking with a delayed and slower time course. Trial-by-trial single-neuron modulations were positively correlated with cortico-striato-thalamic network activity and anti-correlated with limbic network activity. These findings reveal that dlPFC TMS facilitates inhibitory firing in executive control networks while suppressing limbic excitatory drive, providing a cellular mechanism for how cortical stimulation modulates distributed brain networks.

title: Senescent CD8 T effector memory cells are functionally impaired, enriched in aging and disease, and a barrier to immunotherapy
summary_zh: 研究揭示了衰老的CD8 T效应记忆细胞在衰老和疾病中富集，并成为免疫治疗的障碍。单细胞RNA测序揭示了这些细胞的功能受损。
summary_en: This study reveals that senescent CD8 T effector memory cells are enriched in aging and disease and act as a barrier to immunotherapy. Single-cell RNA sequencing reveals the functional impairment of these cells.
insights: 创新点：揭示了衰老的CD8 T效应记忆细胞在衰老和疾病中的富集
方法亮点：单细胞RNA测序揭示了这些细胞的功能受损
关键发现：衰老的CD8 T效应记忆细胞成为免疫治疗的障碍
insights_en: Novelty: Revealed the enrichment of senescent CD8 T effector memory cells in aging and disease
Method highlight: Single-cell RNA sequencing reveals the functional impairment of these cells
Key finding: Senescent CD8 T effector memory cells act as a barrier to immunotherapy
abstract: Senescent cells play important roles in various biological processes that promote fitness and health; however, their timely elimination by immune cells is critical to maintain tissue homeostasis and prevent disease. Despite this, senescent cells accumulate systemically with age, suggesting that certain immune cells also become senescent and dysfunctional during aging. In support of this, we previously demonstrated that CD8 T cells, immune cells capable of targeting senescent cells, increasingly develop characteristics of senescence with advancing age in humans. Here, we characterized the senescence state of human SA-βGal-expressing (SA-βGal high ) CD8 T effector memory (EM) cells, their functional capabilities, and their enrichment in aging and disease. Single-cell RNA sequencing revealed that SA-βGal high CD8 T cells with unique transcriptional signatures develop in all stages of T cell differentiation, including in CD8 T EM cells, which increased in abundance with human aging. SA-βGal high CD8 T EM cells expressed various classical markers of senescence and were significantly impaired in their ability to proliferate, produce cytokines, and eliminate senescent human stromal cells. Gene signatures of senescent SA-βGal high CD8 T EM cells were enriched in CD8 T cells from older human donors, patients with age-related disorders, cancer, and in smokers. Furthermore, we show that T cell senescence is distinct from and dominant over T cell exhaustion, limiting the response of CD8 T EM cells to immune checkpoint blockade. Collectively, our study demonstrates that senescence impairs CD8 T EM cell function and reveals the involvement of senescent and dysfunctional CD8 T EM cells in aging, disease, smoking, and responses to immunotherapy.

title: Cooling fast and slow: Characterizing the effects of vitrification in cryo-EM and the subsequent recovery of equilibrium populations
summary_zh: 研究冷冻电镜中玻璃化对生物分子集合的影响。通过分子动力学模拟分析不同冷却速率。发现冷却速率影响蛋白质结构。
summary_en: Investigates the impact of vitrification on biomolecular ensembles in cryo-EM. Conducts molecular dynamics simulations at various cooling rates. Finds cooling rate affects protein structure.
insights: 冷却速率影响蛋白质结构
分子动力学模拟揭示冷却效应
玻璃化过程对生物分子集合有显著影响
insights_en: Cooling rate affects protein structure
Molecular dynamics simulations reveal cooling effects
Vitrification process significantly affects biomolecular ensembles
abstract: Abstract Single-particle cryogenic electron microscopy (cryo-EM) has enabled near-atomic resolution structure determination of diverse biomolecules. Because the high vacuum required for electron microscopy prevents the imaging of liquid-phase samples, cryo-EM samples are prepared by plunging the sample into a cryogen, rapidly cooling the sample and suspending the ensemble of biomolecules in a matrix of water glass. However, the effects of this vitrification on the biomolecular ensemble are unknown, complicating efforts to use cryo-EM to derive conformational ensembles of biomolecules. To study these effects, we carried out extensive molecular dynamics simulations (over 50 milliseconds) of the Trp-cage miniprotein at equilibrium and undergoing rapid cooling. We simulated seven cooling rates spanning three orders of magnitude, with the slowest coolings matching experimental rates. By inspecting molecular mobility and density-temperature equations of state for water with and without protein, we found that water vitrification is unaltered by the protein. To track protein conformation changes, and to relate them to conformational kinetics, we made a Markov State Model (MSM) of Trp-cage from 5.4 milliseconds of equilibrium sampling at 277 K. We observed that MSM states with a characteristic time longer than the duration of the non-equilibrium cooling, tend to be more robust to artefacts induced by such cooling. Critically, although we observe that some states vanish in the equilibrium ensemble at 230 K, none do in our nonequilibrium cooled ensembles. However, to account for perturbations induced by nonequilibrium cooling for more labile states, we developed a thermodynamic inference framework for recovering equilibrium populations from the measured vitrified ensembles. These results indicate that cryo-EM has the capacity to be a reliable and accurate biophysical technique for the study of biomolecular ensembles. Significance Cryogenic electron microscopy images biomolecules trapped in vitreous ice. To vitrify the sample, it must be cooled over the course of 22 microseconds. However, the degree to which this cooling causes the ensemble of the molecules to be perturbed from equilibrium is unknown. Here we present extensive molecular dynamics simulations to quantify the equilibrium dynamics of the Trp-cage miniprotein and the effects of cooling on its conformational ensemble. By simulating cooling at seven different rates, including the slowest experimental rates that still result in vitrification, we connect the kinetic properties of a protein’s conformational state to the change in state population from cooling. We show that cooling-induced population shifts are small but observable. We further introduce a thermodynamic-inference method to recover equilibrium populations from the cooled ensembles.

title: Synergy in viral–bacterial co-infection expedites algal bloom demise
summary_zh: 研究发现病毒-细菌共感染加速藻华消亡。使用自然浮游生物群落的微生物，量化了病毒-细菌相互作用。
summary_en: This study finds that viral-bacterial co-infection accelerates algal bloom demise. Microbial communities from natural coccolithophore blooms were used to quantify viral-bacterial interactions.
insights: 创新点：揭示病毒-细菌共感染在藻华消亡中的作用。
方法亮点：使用自然浮游生物群落进行实验。
关键发现：细菌增强病毒介导的藻类死亡率。
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing the role of viral-bacterial co-infection in algal bloom demise.
Method highlight: Using natural coccolithophore bloom microbial communities for experiments.
Key finding: Bacteria enhance viral-mediated algal mortality.
abstract: Algal blooms are hotspots for diverse microbial interactions affecting bloom dynamics. Viral infections often regulate the demise of these blooms, recycling >25% of oceanic fixed carbon. Although these blooms collapse synchronously, only 10-30% of algal cells show active viral infection, suggesting additional mortality agents. Using microbial communities from natural coccolithophore blooms, we discovered that bacteria significantly enhanced virus-mediated algal mortality. We quantified this interaction using two novel metrics: the Synergy Index (SI) measuring viral-bacterial interaction strength, and the Benefit Index (BI) assessing changes in bacterial fitness. We identified Alteromonas bacteria as drivers of viral-bacterial coinfection, with consistently high SI and BI. In natural communities, Alteromonas exhibited chemoattraction towards infected algal cells, leading to their enrichment in bloom demise particles. This viral-bacterial synergy represents a previously unrecognized mortality agent controlling bloom termination, modulating the balance between the carbon-recycling viral shunt and the carbon-exporting viral shuttle pathways, likely influencing global carbon cycling.

title: PrinTE: a forward simulation framework for studying the role of transposable elements in genome expansion and contraction
summary_zh: 研究提出PrinTE，模拟全基因组序列以研究转座元件的作用。PrinTE在模拟中表现出高精度。
summary_en: This study proposes PrinTE, a forward-time simulator of whole-genome sequences for studying the role of transposable elements. PrinTE demonstrates high accuracy in simulations.
insights: 创新点：开发PrinTE模拟全基因组序列。
方法亮点：PrinTE在模拟中表现出高精度。
关键发现：PrinTE适用于研究转座元件的基因组变化。
insights_en: Novelty: Development of PrinTE for simulating whole-genome sequences.
Method highlight: High accuracy of PrinTE in simulations.
Key finding: PrinTE is suitable for studying transposable element genome changes.
abstract: Abstract Genome expansion and contraction are driven by transposable element activity, but the underlying dynamics remain enigmatic due to a lack of historical records tracing these changes. Here, we present PrinTE, a forward-time simulator of whole-genome sequences with customizable transposon dynamics for identifying the evolutionary parameters most consistent with an observed genome. Across simulations spanning four orders of magnitude, PrinTE recovers transposon insertion and deletion rates with less than 6% error. We demonstrate PrinTE on Arabidopsis and the fungal subdivision Pucciniomycotina, including myrtle rust ( Austropuccinia psidii ), which expanded its genome size to 1,018 Mb through transposon amplifications. Our simulations show that recombination-based removal of LTR retrotransposons alone cannot prevent genome obesity, and that preventing their invasion in the first place is more effective. We hypothesize that A. psidii might have experienced a prolonged expansion phase followed by a potent and ongoing period of contraction.

title: Small-molecule targeting of kinesin-13 KIF2C enhances double-strand break DNA repair and slows down aging
summary_zh: 研究显示KIF2C激动剂增强DNA修复并减缓衰老。KIF2C激动剂改善DNA双链断裂修复。
summary_en: This study shows that a KIF2C agonist enhances DNA repair and slows down aging. The KIF2C agonist improves the repair of DNA double-strand breaks.
insights: 创新点：发现KIF2C激动剂对DNA修复和衰老的影响。
方法亮点：使用小分子激动剂进行实验。
关键发现：KIF2C激动剂改善HGPS和DS综合征的DNA修复。
insights_en: Novelty: Discovery of the effect of KIF2C agonists on DNA repair and aging.
Method highlight: Experimental use of small-molecule agonists.
Key finding: KIF2C agonists improve DNA repair in HGPS and DS syndromes.
abstract: Abstract DNA damage is a central driver of the aging process. We previously found that KIF2C, known to play a role in DNA repair, is repressed in aged cells. Here, we investigated if increased KIF2C activity counteracts DNA damage and its effects on aging phenotypes. We show that a small-molecule agonist of KIF2C enhances DNA repair in two distinct genetic disorders exhibiting DNA damage and accelerated aging, the Hutchinson-Gilford progeria (HGPS) and Down (DS) syndromes. Mechanistically, the KIF2C agonist improves the repair of DNA double-strand breaks by inducing nuclear envelope invaginations poked by cytoplasmic microtubules, which translated into amended epigenetic and transcriptional signatures of HGPS and DS. Moreover, subcutaneous administration of the KIF2C agonist in progeria mice mitigated aging phenotypes, extending their healthspan. Our study discloses a unique geroprotective pharmacological approach targeting DNA damage.

title: Ca2+ signature gates responsiveness to exogenous auxin in Arabidopsis roots
summary_zh: 研究揭示Ca2+信号调控外源生长素响应。使用光遗传学方法在拟南芥根部施加Ca2+信号。
summary_en: This study reveals that Ca2+ signatures gate responsiveness to exogenous auxin in Arabidopsis roots. Light-gated optogenetic Ca2+ signals were imposed on Arabidopsis root cells.
insights: 创新点：揭示Ca2+信号在生长素响应中的作用。
方法亮点：使用光遗传学方法研究Ca2+信号。
关键发现：Ca2+信号调控细胞分裂和伸长。
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing the role of Ca2+ signals in auxin responsiveness.
Method highlight: Using optogenetic methods to study Ca2+ signals.
Key finding: Ca2+ signals regulate cell division and elongation.
abstract: Abstract Plants must continually balance growth with arrest, especially under stress. Auxin signaling acts as a central regulatory hub in this process, yet the mechanisms that dynamically tune early auxin signalling in real time remain unknown. Here, we used the light-gated, Ca 2+ -permeable Channelrhodopsin 2 variant XXM2.0 to optogenetically impose defined Ca 2+ signatures on Arabidopsis root cells. Repetitive light activation triggered cytosolic Ca 2+ signals that in turn suppressed auxin-induced membrane depolarization and Ca 2+ transients. Moreover, prolonged optogenetic Ca 2+ stimulation affects auxin-responsive transcriptional reprogramming. As phenotypic output, reversible inhibition of root growth by suppressing cell division and elongation was observed. We further identify a candidate CaM7–CNGC14 module that likely mediates Ca 2+ -dependent gating of early auxin signalling. Our study thus introduces a synthetic biology approach to decompose calcium–auxin crosstalk in plant cells, and demonstrates that optogenetically imposed cytosolic Ca 2+ signals act as dynamic regulators of auxin susceptibility in roots.

title: Distributed range adaptation in human parietal encoding of numbers
summary_zh: 研究显示，人类顶叶皮层在数字编码中动态调整以适应环境。神经群体调整以实现实时高效编码。
summary_en: The study shows that the human parietal cortex dynamically adjusts in number encoding to adapt to the environment, with neural populations adjusting for real-time efficient coding.
insights: 创新点：顶叶皮层动态调整编码
方法亮点：神经群体行为分析
关键发现：实时高效编码
insights_en: Novelty: Dynamic adjustment of encoding in parietal cortex
Method highlight: Neural population behavior analysis
Key finding: Real-time efficient coding
abstract: Abstract The brain’s representations are encoded in the collective activity of neural populations whose non-monotonic tuning properties define the population code. Adaptive behavior calls for flexible retuning of this code as stimulus statistics change across contexts. Yet how such adaptation occurs is unknown. Using fMRI during a numerosity-estimation task with variable number ranges, we show that number representations in human parietal cortex dynamically recalibrate to context, enabling context-sensitive behavioral accuracy. The tuning properties of neural populations collectively shift and rescale with the range. This distributed range adaptation achieves efficient coding in real time: neural precision scales with the range and predicts corresponding changes in behavioral precision. Individuals with stronger neural adaptation show larger behavioral adjustments. These findings extend static sensory efficient coding to adaptive representations of abstract magnitudes. Such flexible population tuning may constitute a canonical mechanism of encoding networks that enables the brain to sustain precise, adaptive behavior.

title: RobPicker: a meta-learning framework for robust identification of macromolecules in cryo-electron tomograms
Denoising the US Census: Succinct block hierarchical regression
summary_zh: 本文研究美国人口普查数据去噪问题。提出BlueDown算法，结合线性回归和约束优化。实验表明，算法显著降低分组误差。
summary_en: This paper investigates denoising in the US Census data. The proposed BlueDown algorithm combines linear regression and constrained optimization. Experiments show the algorithm significantly reduces grouping errors.
insights: 创新点：提出BlueDown算法，有效去噪并保护隐私。
方法亮点：结合线性回归和约束优化，提高效率。
关键发现：显著降低分组误差，提升数据有效性。
insights_en: Novelty: Proposes the BlueDown algorithm for effective denoising and privacy protection.
Method highlight: Combines linear regression and constrained optimization to enhance efficiency.
Key finding: Significantly reduces grouping errors, improving data validity.
abstract: The 2020 United States Census adopted differential privacy to protect individual confidentiality, adding calibrated noise to summary demographic measurements that are then reconciled into population tables. We developed BlueDown, a postprocessing algorithm that combines techniques from linear regression and constrained optimization while exploiting measurement structure for efficiency. On 2020 Census data, BlueDown reduced the error of groupings by race at the county level by 21 to 36% and of all county-level groupings by 9 to 58%; at the tract level, it reduced error of groupings by housing type by 38 to 61%. These gains came at no cost to confidentiality or computational efficiency and would improve the validity of research relying on this definitive dataset and analyses used to guide the distribution of more than $1.5 trillion in annual federal spending.

title: The first 1000 days: Modeling language learning from individual children’s everyday speech
summary_zh: 本文利用First 1,000 Days数据集，研究儿童语言学习。通过学习代理，将自然语言输入与内部学习机制相联系。实验表明，代理能识别语音单元并学习大量词汇。
summary_en: This paper uses the First 1,000 Days dataset to study language learning in children. By using a learning agent, it links natural language input with internal learning mechanisms. Experiments show the agent can identify speech units and learn a large vocabulary.
insights: 创新点：利用First 1,000 Days数据集，提供儿童语言学习的新视角。
方法亮点：结合认知学习代理，实现自然语言与学习机制的连接。
关键发现：学习代理能识别语音单元并学习大量词汇。
insights_en: Novelty: Utilizes the First 1,000 Days dataset to provide a new perspective on children's language learning.
Method highlight: Combines a cognitive learning agent to connect natural language with learning mechanisms.
Key finding: The learning agent can identify speech units and learn a large vocabulary.
abstract: Abstract A longstanding challenge in developmental science is to understand how children learn language from naturalistic everyday input. To study this process, we leveraged the First 1,000 Days (1kD) dataset, which provides longitudinal, ultra-dense daily audiovisual recordings for individual children in their home environments. This unusually detailed, child-specific record of early experience enabled us to pair each child’s rich language input with a cognitively grounded learning agent, linking naturalistic experience (“nurture”) to internal learning mechanisms (“nature”). Trained incrementally on each child’s input without prior linguistic knowledge, the learning agent discovered speech units corresponding to the English phoneme inventory and acquired thousands of words, closely mirroring individual developmental trajectories. Learning generalized across children while preserving individual differences in rate and timing. Interestingly, learning relied not only on linguistic input but also on the rehearsal of past experiences at the end of each training day. These findings demonstrate that everyday environments provide sufficient structure for language acquisition and establish a unified mechanistic framework for studying development in real-world contexts.

title: Genome-anchored foundation model embeddings improve molecular prediction from histology images
summary_zh: 研究通过基因组锚定的基础模型嵌入提高从组织学图像中预测分子特征。方法为PathLUPI模型，在多个任务中评估。
summary_en: This study improves molecular prediction from histology images using genome-anchored foundation model embeddings. Methods involve the PathLUPI model, evaluated across multiple tasks.
insights: 创新点：提出基因组锚定的基础模型嵌入方法。
方法亮点：PathLUPI模型在多个任务中表现优异。
关键发现：PathLUPI在分子预测中优于传统方法。
insights_en: Novelty: A genome-anchored foundation model embedding method is proposed.
Method highlight: The PathLUPI model performs excellently across multiple tasks.
Key finding: PathLUPI outperforms conventional methods in molecular prediction.
abstract: Precision oncology requires accurate molecular insights, yet obtaining these directly from genomics is costly and time-consuming for broad clinical use. Predicting complex molecular features and patient prognosis directly from routine whole-slide images (WSIs) remains a major challenge for current deep learning methods. Here we introduce PathLUPI, which uses transcriptomic privileged information during training to extract genome-anchored histological embeddings, enabling effective molecular prediction using only WSIs at inference. Through extensive evaluation across 49 molecular oncology tasks using 11,361 cases from 20 cohorts, PathLUPI demonstrates superior performance compared to conventional methods trained solely on WSIs. Crucially, it achieves an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve of at least 0.80 across 18 biomarker prediction and molecular subtyping tasks, and a concordance index of at least 0.70 across survival cohorts spanning five major cancer types. Moreover, PathLUPI embeddings reveal distinct cellular morphological signatures associated with specific genotypes, whose spatial fidelity is substantiated in representative high-resolution spatial transcriptomics samples. By effectively encoding molecular context to refine WSI representations, PathLUPI offers a strategy to bridge molecular insights with routine pathology workflows for wider clinical application. Obtaining accurate molecular insights for precision oncology remains costly and time consuming. Here, the authors develop PathLUPI, a deep learning method to enable effective molecular prediction in cancer using only routine whole-slide images, with evaluation across 49 molecular oncology tasks in 20 different cohorts.

title: Selective profiling of translationally active tRNAs and their dynamics under stress
summary_zh: 开发tRIBO-seq方法，选择性分析翻译活跃的tRNA及其在压力下的动态变化。研究发现压力下ribo-tRNA显著改变。
summary_en: Develops tRIBO-seq method for selective profiling of translationally active tRNAs and their dynamics under stress. Finds that ribo-tRNAs are significantly altered under stress.
insights: 创新点：开发tRIBO-seq方法分析tRNA动态
方法亮点：使用tRIBO-seq分析翻译活跃的tRNA
关键发现：压力下ribo-tRNA显著改变
insights_en: Novelty: Develops tRIBO-seq method for tRNA dynamics analysis
Method highlight: Uses tRIBO-seq to analyze translationally active tRNAs
Key finding: Significant changes in ribo-tRNAs under stress
abstract: ABSTRACT During translation, transfer RNAs (tRNAs) deliver specific amino acids to the ribosome in a coordinated manner with the sequence encoded by the mRNA. Despite their central role in protein synthesis, their precise contribution to the modulation of translation remains poorly understood, primarily due to lack of methods to characterise tRNA abundances and their modifications from actively translating ribosomes. Here we develop tRIBO-seq, a simple and robust nanopore-based method to selectively capture ribosome-associated native tRNA populations (ribo-tRNAs) from actively translating ribosomes, providing tRNA abundance, modification and fragmentation information from a single experiment. Using tRIBO-seq, we find that ribo-tRNAs, but often not total tRNAs, are significantly altered upon stress. Notably, we find that tRNAome alterations strongly vary depending on the stress type: while viral infection and leucine deprivation leads to changes in ribo-tRNA abundances, methionine starvation causes a dramatic loss of methyl-based tRNA modifications. By contrast, we find that arsenite exposure does not alter tRNA abundances nor modification patterns, but rather causes major fragmentation events in selected subsets of ribo-tRNAs. Altogether, tRIBO-seq offers a robust and reproducible approach to map the full tRNA landscape –capturing tRNA abundance, modification and fragmentation patterns–, across both total and actively translating tRNA populations, revealing the dynamics of the tRNAome with unprecedented resolution, in a single experiment.

title: The limits of scaling in aggregation-driven patterning of cell collectives
summary_zh: 研究细胞聚集驱动图案化中缩放的限制。发现小系统允许快速、稳健的图案缩放，而大系统则延迟缩放。
summary_en: Studies the limits of scaling in aggregation-driven patterning of cell collectives. Finds that small systems allow rapid, robust pattern scaling, while large systems delay scaling.
insights: 创新点：研究细胞聚集驱动图案化中的缩放限制
方法亮点：结合细胞隔离、成像和化学扰动
关键发现：小系统快速缩放，大系统延迟缩放
insights_en: Novelty: Studies scaling limits in aggregation-driven cell patterning
Method highlight: Combines cell confinement, imaging, and chemical perturbations
Key finding: Small systems allow rapid scaling, large systems delay scaling
abstract: Abstract Robust development requires maintaining correct proportions as overall size varies. What controls and limits this scaling remains poorly understood due to the complex interplay of mechanical and biochemical embryonic factors. Combining confinement of dissociated embryonic presomitic mesoderm cells with imaging and chemical perturbations, we identified cell aggregation as the initial event in de novo posterior pole formation. Using a continuum model based solely on cell-cell attraction, we quantitatively map how the time available for aggregation-driven patterning limits the maximum scalable system size. Small systems allow rapid, robust pattern scaling, whereas coarsening dynamics substantially delay scaled patterns in large systems. Our experiments quantitatively confirm these predicted scaling regimes. Together, our results reveal a developmental time-size tradeoff governing the scaling of aggregation-driven patterns.

title: Heme signatures in mineralized red blood cells within vascular canals of a 115-million-year-old dinosaur bone
summary_zh: 在1.15亿年古恐龙骨骼血管通道中发现血红素特征。研究发现血红素B是主要四吡咯，支持内源性起源。
summary_en: Heme signatures found in mineralized red blood cells within vascular canals of a 115-million-year-old dinosaur bone. The study finds that heme B is the principal tetrapyrrole, supporting an endogenous origin.
insights: 创新点：在古恐龙骨骼中发现血红素特征
方法亮点：使用液相色谱-质谱联用和拉曼光谱分析
关键发现：血红素B支持内源性起源
insights_en: Novelty: Heme signatures found in ancient dinosaur bone
Method highlight: Uses HPLC-MS and Raman spectroscopy analysis
Key finding: Heme B supports an endogenous origin
abstract: Detection of endogenous biomolecules in vertebrate fossils remains controversial because labile compounds degrade quickly and are highly susceptible to contamination. Here, we present data on the preservation of heme-derived tetrapyrroles, and vascular canal-constrained ellipsoidal microstructures, inferred to be red blood cells, in limb bones of Aratasaurus museunacionali , a 115-million-year-old theropod dinosaur. High-performance liquid chromatography–mass spectrometry identified parent and diagenetically altered heme B as the principal tetrapyrroles of bone extract, contrasting the chlorophyll and bacteriochlorophyll porphyrin signatures of the surrounding matrix supporting an endogenous origin. Separate spatially resolved analyses by Raman spectroscopy and transmission electron microscopy confirmed the ellipsoid microstructure localization of i) porphyrin signals of heme and ii) key elements of heme (Fe, N, and C) and mineral stabilizing hausmannite (Mn 3 O 4 ), respectively. These results demonstrate blood-derived biomolecules in mineralized red blood cells of a dinosaur.

title: Fatty acid desaturation controls cellular fate decisions between senescence and ferroptosis
summary_zh: 研究细胞衰老和铁死亡决策。发现DGLA水平降低与细胞死亡相关。
summary_en: Studies cellular fate decisions between senescence and ferroptosis. Finds reduced DGLA levels associated with cell death.
insights: 创新点：DGLA与细胞命运关系
方法亮点：分析脂肪酸水平变化
关键发现：DGLA与铁死亡相关
insights_en: Novelty: DGLA and cellular fate relationship
Method highlight: Analysis of fatty acid levels
Key finding: DGLA associated with ferroptosis
abstract: Summary When subject to damage or stress, cells develop responses in order to maintain tissue homeostasis. Two such decisions are ferroptosis and cellular senescence, but how cells decide between these outcomes remains unclear. Here we show that senescent cells increase levels of multiple membrane-bound polyunsaturated fatty acids (PUFAs), but a specific PUFA, dihomo-gamma-linolenic acid (DGLA, 20:3 ω -3) is reduced. Exogenous repletion of DGLA or inhibition of delta-5-desaturase, the enzyme that metabolizes DGLA, instead results in cell death by ferroptosis. Senescent cells had elevated levels of other fezzroptosis sensitizers, including labile iron and expression of lipoxygenases – but also increased Gpx4 levels to prevent ferroptosis. Oral DGLA lowered senescent cell burden in aged mice and improved age-related functional outcomes. Finally, obese humans with lowered DGLA desaturation rates showed lower markers of adipose tissue senescence. Together, our data implicate DGLA and its desaturation as a major driver of decisions between senescence and ferroptosis.

title: Added Value of Preoperative Contrast Enhanced Mammography in Staging of Malignant Breast Lesions (PROCEM): A Randomized Controlled Trial
summary_zh: PROCEM试验评估术前对比增强乳腺摄影在乳腺癌分期中的附加价值。随机对照试验显示，CEM可显著改变治疗方案。
summary_en: The PROCEM trial assesses the added value of preoperative contrast-enhanced mammography in breast cancer staging. A randomized controlled trial shows that CEM can significantly alter treatment plans.
insights: CEM可显著改变治疗方案
随机对照试验证明CEM价值
术前CEM对乳腺癌分期有重要影响
insights_en: CEM can significantly alter treatment plans
Randomized controlled trial proves the value of CEM
Preoperative CEM has a significant impact on breast cancer staging
abstract: Background: Contrast-enhanced mammography (CEM) is increasingly used in breast cancer diagnostics. This is the first randomised trial assessing the additional value of CEM in preoperative staging of breast cancer.Method: This prospective randomised controlled trial, with two arms and a 1:1 allocation ratio, was performed at two hospitals in Sweden. In all, 440 patients with breast cancer, scheduled for primary surgery, were randomised to preoperative CEM or not (control). The primary outcome measure was a 10% treatment change due to CEM findings. Secondary outcome measures included the difference in reoperation/mastectomy rates between the randomisation arms, and estimation of malignant extent by CEM was compared with standard imaging (mammography/tomosynthesis and ultrasound) with histopathological extent as a reference, using Bland-Altman statistics and a concordance analysis.
