Aging-related cellular and molecular changes reveal a role for Bglap3+ neurons in MEC spatial cognition
summary_zh: 研究揭示了衰老相关的细胞和分子变化在MEC空间认知中的作用，发现Bglap3+神经元在空间认知中起重要作用。
summary_en: This study reveals the role of aging-related cellular and molecular changes in MEC spatial cognition, finding that Bglap3+ neurons play a significant role in spatial cognition.
insights: 创新点：揭示了衰老与空间认知的关系
方法亮点：采用10x Genomics Visium技术进行转录组分析
关键发现：Bglap3+神经元在空间认知中起重要作用
insights_en: Novelty: Reveals the relationship between aging and spatial cognition
Method highlight: Using 10x Genomics Visium technology for transcriptomic analysis
Key finding: Bglap3+ neurons play a significant role in spatial cognition
abstract: Abstract Aging-related cognitive decline, including impairments in spatial orientation and memory, has been linked to dysfunction within the hippocampus and medial entorhinal cortex (MEC). However, the cellular and molecular alterations underlying MEC aging remain poorly understood. Here we show that old mice exhibit a reduced proportion of grid cells and decreased spatial stability. Transcriptomic profiling of the MEC using 10x Genomics Visium technology reveals 1664 differentially expressed genes between young and old mice. Among these, Bglap3 is identified as a marker gene for a subpopulation of Layer III neurons that showed an age-associated reduction in cell number. Chemogenetic silencing of Bglap3 + neurons in young mice impairs spatial tuning of MEC neurons. Together, these findings elucidate cellular and molecular mechanisms contributing to age-related MEC dysfunction and suggest that the loss of Bglap3 + neurons may underlie spatial coding deficits in aging.

title: Enhancing salivary gland siRNA activity through transgenic Dicer-2 overexpression restricts arbovirus transmission in Aedes aegypti
summary_zh: 研究通过过表达Dicer-2增强唾液腺siRNA活性，限制埃及伊蚊传播的蚊媒病毒。
summary_en: This study enhances salivary gland siRNA activity through transgenic Dicer-2 overexpression, restricting arbovirus transmission in Aedes aegypti.
insights: 创新点：通过过表达Dicer-2增强siRNA活性
方法亮点：研究蚊媒病毒传播机制
关键发现：siRNA活性增强可限制病毒传播
insights_en: Novelty: Enhancing siRNA activity through transgenic Dicer-2 overexpression
Method highlight: Studying the mechanism of arbovirus transmission
Key finding: Enhanced siRNA activity can restrict virus transmission
abstract: Abstract Arboviruses, including dengue virus (DENV), Zika virus (ZIKV), and chikungunya virus (CHIKV), pose a significant global health and economic burden, with Aedes aegypti serving as their primary vector. Arbovirus infection in Ae. aegypti progresses sequentially through the midgut (MG), carcass (CA), and salivary glands (SG), with each tissue exhibiting distinct antiviral responses. Here, we investigate tissue-specific antiviral mechanisms, focusing on the small interfering RNA (siRNA) pathway in SGs. Our results reveal that SGs possess weaker antiviral defense and are more susceptible to arboviral infection compared to MGs and CAs. Notably, overexpression of Dicer2 ( Dcr2 ), a key component of the siRNA pathway, in SGs leads to a significant decrease in arboviral replication. Conversely, Dcr2 overexpression in fat bodies, the primary tissue in CAs, only moderately suppresses DENV2 infection and has no notable effect on Mayaro virus (MAYV) infection. Remarkably, the simultaneous overexpression of Dcr2 in both MGs and SGs enhances antiviral activity, effectively blocking the transmission of multiple arboviruses. These findings reveal the tissue-specific dynamics of mosquito antiviral immunity and underscore the potential for targeting SG-specific immunity to disrupt arbovirus transmission, providing a promising approach for controlling mosquito-borne diseases.

title: Single-cell pharmacogenomic landscapes of epigenetic therapy revealed by gastric cancer Perturb-seq
summary_zh: 研究通过胃癌Perturb-seq揭示了表观遗传疗法的单细胞药基因组学景观，发现了基因剂量与分子表型之间的关系。
summary_en: This study reveals the single-cell pharmacogenomic landscapes of epigenetic therapy through gastric cancer Perturb-seq, identifying the relationship between gene dosage and molecular phenotypes.
insights: 创新点：揭示表观遗传疗法的单细胞药基因组学景观
方法亮点：采用Perturb-seq技术
关键发现：基因剂量与分子表型之间存在关系
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing the single-cell pharmacogenomic landscapes of epigenetic therapy
Method highlight: Using Perturb-seq technology
Key finding: There is a relationship between gene dosage and molecular phenotypes
abstract: Gene expression signatures (“molecular phenotypes”) are extensively utilized in cancer research. To study how gastric cancer molecular phenotypes are regulated by cell-intrinsic genetic alterations interacting with cell-extrinsic therapeutic pressures, we performed direct capture Perturb-seq to interrogate >200 gastric cancer-related genes against 4 distinct epigenetic therapies in normal gastric and gastric cancer lines. We identify 17.7 million pharmocogenomic expression interactions in 625,866 cells representing baseline and post-therapeutic molecular phenotypes. This single-cell pharmacogenomic compendium confirms previously known gene-driven molecular phenotypes, elucidating both poorly characterized genes and gene dosage-molecular phenotype relationships. Molecular phenotypes in post-therapeutic surviving cells capture perturbation-associated pathways associated with drug resistance (epithelial–mesenchymal transition, cell cycle alterations, metabolic reprogramming). Mapping of in vitro molecular phenotypes to primary human gastric cancers uncovers prognostic and spatial variability. Comparative analysis of gene perturbations across therapies and lines reveals both conserved and context-specific molecular alterations. Our results provide a community resource for exploring how Perturb-seq molecular phenotypes are influenced by context dependencies across different drug exposures and cell line backgrounds. Gene expression signatures are widely used in cancer research. This study applies single-cell Perturb-seq to gastric cancer models under epigenetic therapies and reveals gene- and treatment-specific molecular phenotypes and drug-response pathways that have prognostic significance in primary tumours.

title: Microglia-dependent PDGFB regulation of neuronal KCND2 in the hypothalamic paraventricular nucleus determines propofol anesthesia induction
summary_zh: 研究揭示微胶质PDGFB调控神经元KCND2，影响丙泊酚麻醉诱导。方法为小鼠模型，观察PVN Glu神经元兴奋性。
summary_en: This study identifies a microglia-dependent PDGFB pathway modulating propofol anesthesia sensitivity in mice. Methods involve a mouse model to observe PVN Glu neuron excitability.
insights: 创新点：发现微胶质PDGFB调控丙泊酚麻醉敏感性的新机制。
方法亮点：采用小鼠模型研究神经机制。
关键发现：PDGFB调节PVN Glu神经元兴奋性。
insights_en: Novelty: A new mechanism of microglia-dependent PDGFB regulation of propofol anesthesia sensitivity is identified.
Method highlight: A mouse model is used to study the neural mechanism.
Key finding: PDGFB regulates the excitability of PVN Glu neurons.
abstract: Abstract Understanding the neural mechanisms underlying anesthetic-induced unconsciousness remains a central question in both anesthesia research and neuroscience. However, the role of non-neuronal components in modulating anesthetic sensitivity is poorly understood. In this study, we identify a microglia-dependent platelet-derived growth factor subunit B (PDGFB) signaling pathway that modulates propofol anesthesia sensitivity and contributes to the induction of anesthesia in mice. We demonstrate that PDGFB signaling regulates the potassium voltage-gated channel subfamily D member 2 (KCND2) in the hypothalamic paraventricular nucleus (PVN) in mice, thereby orchestrating the excitability of PVN glutamatergic neurons (PVN Glu ) and the activity of their projections to lateral hypothalamic glutamatergic neurons (LH Glu ). Microglia deprivation induces PDGFB deficiency and downregulates KCND2, resulting in PVN hyperexcitability and hyperactivation of the PVN → LH arousal circuit, which contributes to resistance to anesthesia induction in mice. Our findings identified non-neuronal molecular mechanism that governs anesthetic sensitivity, complementing the classical γ-aminobutyric acid type A receptor-centric model and providing insights into the regulation of anesthesia induction.

title: Structural basis for N-glycopeptide preference in an infant-derived Bifidobacterium bifidum PNGaseA
summary_zh: 研究婴儿双歧杆菌PNGaseA对N-糖肽的偏好性。方法为生物化学和结构表征，揭示其作用机制。
summary_en: This study characterizes the N-glycopeptide preference of an infant-derived Bifidobacterium bifidum PNGaseA. Methods include biochemical and structural characterization to reveal its mechanism.
insights: 创新点：揭示婴儿双歧杆菌PNGaseA对N-糖肽的特异性。
方法亮点：结合生物化学和结构分析。
关键发现：PNGaseA对N-糖肽有显著偏好。
insights_en: Novelty: The specificity of infant-derived Bifidobacterium bifidum PNGaseA for N-glycopeptides is revealed.
Method highlight: Biochemical and structural analysis are combined.
Key finding: PNGaseA shows a marked preference for N-glycopeptides.
abstract: N-glycans are abundant nutrient sources for human gut bacteria, which deploy peptide: N-glycosidases to release them from glycoproteins. Breast milk is comprised of a high proportion of N-glycosylated bioactive proteins that can be accessed by infant colonic microbes. Here, we biochemically and structurally characterize a PNGaseA-family enzyme from infant-associated Bifidobacterium bifidum LMG13195. This enzyme acts on a broad range of N-glycan structures but shows a marked preference for N-glycans attached to glycopeptides rather than to denatured or native proteins, highlighting a specialized route for N-glycan acquisition in infant-associated Bifidobacterium species. Structures of the apo enzyme, an unliganded E236Q mutant, and a D107N-E236Q complex with a G2-peptide reveal a canonical two-β-sandwich PNGase core plus an additional ten-strand β-sheet cradle and are the first structures of this superfamily. Comparison of these states, combined with molecular dynamics simulations, indicates that glycopeptide binding is coupled to β-sheet cradle-loop movements that close against β-sandwich 1 over the peptide C terminus. The complex defines recognition of the two core GlcNAc residues and the central mannose, reveals that peptide contacts are concentrated around the +2 Thr residue of the NXT sequon, and positions the scissile amide at the active site. These findings, together with mutational and computational analyses, provide a structural basis for N-glycopeptide preference by linking glycopeptide binding to cradle closure and catalysis, thereby expanding the host-glycan nutrient landscape accessible to infant-gut Bifidobacterium species.

title: Overconsumption of low-digestible sugars can increase susceptibility to Salmonella Typhimurium infection
summary_zh: 研究发现，某些低消化性糖（如阿拉伯糖、乳果糖和聚糖）的过量摄入会降低对沙门氏菌的抵抗力，导致粪便病原体负荷增加和结肠炎。
summary_en: It is found that overconsumption of certain low-digestible sugars, such as arabinose, lactulose, and polyols, can reduce resistance to Salmonella Typhimurium infection, leading to increased fecal pathogen loads and colitis.
insights: 创新点：低消化性糖过量摄入降低沙门氏菌抵抗力
方法亮点：分析低消化性糖对肠道环境的影响
关键发现：发酵导致肠道环境酸化，微生物群失调
insights_en: Novelty: Overconsumption of low-digestible sugars reduces resistance to Salmonella Typhimurium infection
Method highlight: Analysis of the impact of low-digestible sugars on the intestinal environment
Key finding: Fermentation leads to acidification of the intestinal environment and dysbiosis of the microbiota
abstract: Abstract Low-digestible carbohydrates (LDCs), including dietary fibers and sugars that resist absorption, are generally considered beneficial for the gut microbiota. However, we show that acute overconsumption of certain LDCs, particularly low-digestible sugars (LDSs), such as arabinose, lactulose, and polyols commonly used as sugar substitutes, can compromise colonization resistance against the common foodborne pathogen Salmonella enterica serovar Typhimurium. LDS overconsumption results in elevated fecal pathogen loads, systemic dissemination, and colitis in infected mice. Mechanistic analysis of arabinose overconsumption revealed that rapid fermentation acidifies the intestinal environment, perturbs the microbiota, alters gut-luminal short-chain fatty acid levels and elevated amino acid availability, which can support pathogen growth. Additionally, this perturbation impacts virulence by broadening tissue tropism (e.g. expansion to small intestine) and selecting for invasive Salmonella . Unlike antibiotic perturbations, Salmonella colonization requires SPI-1 and SPI-2 Type-III-secretion systems, linking virulence to pathogen fitness. These findings reveal how dietary perturbations can impact the gut ecosystem in ways that not only compromise colonization resistance but also enhance pathogen virulence.

title: Isoform-resolved spatial transcriptomics on a lab-made high-density array via a single-chip NGS-TGS workflow
summary_zh: 开发低成本高密度芯片进行空间转录组学。单芯片NGS-TGS流程实现全长cDNA分割测序。
summary_en: A low-cost, high-density array for spatial transcriptomics is developed. A single-chip NGS-TGS workflow achieves full-length cDNA splitting and sequencing.
insights: 创新点：低成本高密度芯片实现空间转录组学。
方法亮点：三部分组合长条形码策略解码。
关键发现：识别番茄辣椒嫁接界面相关剪接重编程。
insights_en: Novelty: Low-cost, high-density array for spatial transcriptomics.
Method highlight: Tri-part combinatorial long-barcode strategy for decoding.
Key finding: Identification of interface-associated splicing reprogramming in tomato-pepper grafts.
abstract: Abstract High-resolution spatial transcriptomics is still cost-prohibitive and dominated by short-read sequencing, limiting in situ detection of transcript structures. Here we present a low-cost, lab-made, high-density bead-in-microwell chip assembled by routine centrifuge and decoded by a tri-part combinatorial long-barcode strategy. The design provides 5.6×10 7 barcode combinations across 4.1×10□ capture sites, reducing collisions while remaining tolerant to third-generation sequencing raw errors. Using a single-chip, dual-platform workflow, we split full-length cDNA for next-generation and third-generation sequencing within the same spatial coordinates. In an incompatible tomato-pepper graft, we identified interface-associated splicing reprogramming, including thousands of unannotated isoforms, enriched novel CaGRP1 isoforms, and SlPIP2 intron retention, supported by individual long-read sequences. In mouse embryos, we further demonstrate cross-species applicability by resolving unannotated Col1a2 isoforms in oligodendrocyte progenitors and spatially restricted Dalrd3 intron retention. This cost-efficient system broadens access to spatial full-length transcriptomics and may support diverse biological studies.

title: In vivo ultrasound–MRI 3D mapping of neuromuscular compartments reveals the neuromechanical architecture of finger-specific control
summary_zh: 结合超声和MRI技术揭示手指特定控制的神经肌肉结构。动态超声估计组织运动方向。
summary_en: A multimodal imaging framework combining ultrasound and MRI reveals the neuromechanical architecture of finger-specific control. Dynamic ultrasound estimates tissue movement directions.
insights: 创新点：超声和MRI结合成像技术。
方法亮点：动态超声估计组织运动。
关键发现：生成手指特定控制的3D纤维轨迹。
insights_en: Novelty: Multimodal imaging combining ultrasound and MRI.
Method highlight: Dynamic ultrasound for tissue movement estimation.
Key finding: Generation of 3D fiber trajectories for finger-specific control.
abstract: Abstract Neuromuscular compartments provide the functional substrate for finger-specific motor control, yet their in vivo three-dimensional (3D) architecture remains unresolved because of the absence of clear fascial landmarks for imaging. Here, we present a multimodal imaging framework combining ultrasound and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) to provide volumetric compartment segmentation and in vivo architectural reconstruction of the flexor digitorum superficialis. During isolated finger flexion, tissue movement directions estimated from dynamic ultrasound delineate compartment contours, which are mapped into a 3D MRI reference to generate volumetric compartment masks. Using these masks as constraints, tractography reconstructs 3D fiber trajectories and yields compartment-specific architectural measurements. In ten healthy individuals, compartment topology and fiber orientations were consistent with classic cadaveric anatomy, and estimated compartments accurately predicted surface electromyography amplitude distributions. This framework provides 3D fiber trajectories and quantitative parameters for finger-specific computational models, establishing a foundation for subject-specific neuromuscular digital twins and next-generation neuromuscular interfaces.

title: The CCCH-type zinc-finger PfMD3 promotes translation for malaria parasite transmission
summary_zh: 研究CCCH型锌指蛋白PfMD3在疟原虫传播中的作用。PfMD3与mRNA结合促进雄性配子发育。
summary_en: This study characterizes the role of the CCCH-type zinc-finger protein PfMD3 in malaria parasite transmission. PfMD3 binding to mRNA transcripts promotes male gamete development.
insights: 创新点：CCCH型锌指蛋白PfMD3在疟原虫传播中起关键作用。
方法亮点：研究PfMD3与mRNA结合。
关键发现：PfMD3促进雄性配子发育。
insights_en: Novelty: The CCCH-type zinc-finger protein PfMD3 plays a critical role in malaria parasite transmission.
Method highlight: Study of PfMD3 binding to mRNA transcripts.
Key finding: PfMD3 promotes male gamete development.
abstract: Abstract Sexual maturation and fertility of the malaria-causing parasite, Plasmodium spp., are critical to transmission between hosts. This developmental process involves an intricate gene expression regulatory network that drives gametocyte commitment, development, and the production of male and female gametes. Here, we characterize the role of the CCCH-type zinc-finger protein Plasmodium falciparum Male Development 3 ( Pf MD3) in the formation of gametes. Genetic disruption of Pf MD3 reveals a male fertility defect that decreases infectivity to mosquitoes. Molecular characterization of Pf MD3 reveals its binding to mRNA transcripts is associated with male gamete development through a specific RNA sequence. Gametocyte proteins encoded by these Pf MD3-bound transcripts decrease significantly in Pf MD3 knockout parasites, suggesting that Pf MD3 impacts translation. In addition to RNA-binding, Pf MD3 also interacts with proteins involved in mRNA processing and nuclear export that influence translational regulation. This study establishes Pf MD3 as an RNA-binding protein that impacts lineage-specific translation and male gamete fertility.

title: Visual LLM-guided consensus spatial domain detection with L-STAR
summary_zh: 空间转录组学中，现有方法性能差异大。L-STAR框架利用LLM视觉推理能力，自适应排名和整合方法，实现稳健提升。
summary_en: Existing spatial transcriptomics methods show high variability. The L-STAR framework leverages LLM's visual reasoning to adaptively rank and integrate methods, achieving robust improvement.
insights: 创新点：LLM视觉推理在空间转录组学中的应用
方法亮点：自适应排名和整合方法
关键发现：L-STAR在多个数据集上优于单一方法
insights_en: Novelty: Application of LLM visual reasoning in spatial transcriptomics
Method highlight: Adaptive ranking and integration of methods
Key finding: L-STAR outperforms single methods across diverse datasets
abstract: ABSTRACT Spatial domain detection is a central task in spatial transcriptomics, yet existing methods exhibit highly variable performance across datasets. We introduce L-STAR, a visual LLM-guided, consensus-based framework that leverages the visual reasoning capacity of large language models to adaptively rank and integrate spatial domain detection methods. L-STAR achieves robust and consistently improved performance, outperforming single spatial domain detection methods across diverse datasets.

title: Foodborne disease outbreaks in the USA and the need for prevention
Head-mounted camera for reconstructing outdoor behavior in freely flying birds
summary_zh: 研究提出一种头戴式相机系统，用于捕捉自由飞翔的鹰类行为细节。方法上，结合高分辨率环境扫描，实现三维测量。实验表明，该系统能够重建自然环境中的飞行轨迹。
summary_en: This study proposes a head-mounted camera system for capturing the detailed behaviors of freely flying raptors. The method combines high-resolution environmental scanning to achieve three-dimensional measurements. Experiments show that the system can reconstruct flight trajectories in natural environments.
insights: 创新点：头戴式相机系统捕捉鹰类行为细节
方法亮点：结合高分辨率环境扫描实现三维测量
关键发现：系统能够重建自然环境中的飞行轨迹
insights_en: Novelty: Head-mounted camera system captures detailed behaviors of raptors
Method highlight: Combines high-resolution environmental scanning for three-dimensional measurements
Key finding: System can reconstruct flight trajectories in natural environments
abstract: Abstract Capturing the fine details of behavior when animals perform complex tasks, such as prey pursuit and capture, in natural environments is a challenging endeavor. For birds of prey, commonly used tracking approaches, such as lightweight GPS and inertial measurement units, cannot simultaneously track the bird’s position and the fine details of body part motion or moving external objects. Here we designed a head-mounted, tetherless, 4π camera system which, combined with a high-resolution environmental scan, enabled detailed three-dimensional measurement of both head position and orientation in freely flying Harris’s hawks ( Parabuteo unicinctus ) performing aerial pursuit in the wild. This stable head-mounted imaging approach enabled reconstruction of flight trajectories in natural environments, detailed quantification of head motion, optic flow and target position, while the bird tracked and captured airborne targets.

title: Reconstructing a predatory bird’s aerial pursuit behavior in the wild
Coacervate droplets as a liquefier for the solid-to-liquid transition of RNA aggregates
summary_zh: 研究提出利用复杂凝聚体作为RNA聚集体的液化剂。方法上，通过系统实验和全原子模拟，解码多尺度机制。实验表明，凝聚体渗透介导分子缓冲，使网络流体化。
summary_en: This study suggests using complex coacervates as a liquefier for the solid-to-liquid transition of RNA aggregates. The method involves systematic experiments and all-atom simulations to decode a multiscale mechanism. Experiments show that coacervate infiltration mediates molecular buffering, fluidizing the crosslinked network.
insights: 创新点：利用复杂凝聚体作为RNA聚集体的液化剂
方法亮点：系统实验与全原子模拟解码多尺度机制
关键发现：凝聚体渗透介导分子缓冲，使网络流体化
insights_en: Novelty: Using complex coacervates as a liquefier for RNA aggregates
Method highlight: Systematic experiments and all-atom simulations decode a multiscale mechanism
Key finding: Coacervate infiltration mediates molecular buffering, fluidizing the crosslinked network
abstract: Abstract Biomolecular condensates are functionally gated by their material properties. While RNA is a primary structural scaffold, its sequence-specific interactions can aberrantly drive condensates into dysfunctional solid aggregates. Yet, actively reversing this solidification to restore function remains a fundamental challenge, impeding progress in synthetic biology and therapeutics interventions. Here, we establish that complex coacervates can be engineered as liquefiers to actively remodel solid RNA-peptide aggregates into functional liquid droplets. Integrating systematic experiments with all-atom simulations, we decode a multiscale mechanism: coacervate infiltration at the micrometer scale mediates molecular buffering at the nanometer scale, which fluidizes the crosslinked network to drive macroscopic liquefaction. This capability is governed by a design rule, where coacervates formed by small-molecular anions exhibit optimal efficacy. We deploy this principle to functionally rescue silenced RNA within a model of pathologically solidified ribonucleoprotein assemblies. Our work provides a general framework for the active, compositional control of biomolecular phase behavior, with direct implications for managing pathological aggregation and engineering functional condensates in synthetic and living systems.

title: Dissociation of gravity and limb dynamics in motor control
summary_zh: 研究通过抛物飞行实验分离重力加速度和肢体动力学。方法上，记录参与者在不同重力条件下的运动。实验表明，肌肉扭矩的动态成分在不同重力下保持不变。
summary_en: This study dissociates gravitational acceleration from limb dynamics using parabolic flight experiments. The method involves recording participants' movements under different gravitational conditions. Experiments show that the dynamic component of muscle torques remains largely invariant across different gravities.
insights: 创新点：抛物飞行实验分离重力加速度和肢体动力学
方法亮点：记录不同重力条件下的运动数据
关键发现：肌肉扭矩的动态成分在不同重力下保持不变
insights_en: Novelty: Parabolic flight experiment dissociates gravitational acceleration from limb dynamics
Method highlight: Recording movement data under different gravitational conditions
Key finding: The dynamic component of muscle torques remains largely invariant across different gravities
abstract: Abstract Human movements remain accurate and stable despite changes in external forces, yet it is unclear how the nervous system separates and compensates for gravitational loads and intrinsic limb dynamics when generating motor commands. This question is difficult to address under terrestrial conditions, where these forces are inherently coupled. Here we dissociated gravitational acceleration from limb dynamics using parabolic flight. Nine participants performed visually guided pointing movements during alternating microgravity (0g), normogravity (1g), and hypergravity (2g), while upper-limb kinematics and shoulder muscle activity were recorded. Inverse-dynamics analysis revealed that the gravity-independent dynamic component of muscle torques remained largely invariant across gravitational conditions, whereas gravity-related torques scaled proportionally with gravitational acceleration. In contrast, muscle activation exhibited systematic gravity-dependent modulation in both agonist and antagonist muscles, including increased co-contraction consistent with elevated shoulder stiffness. Critically, the dynamic component of EMG-derived torques increased with gravitational load despite minimal changes in the corresponding mechanical torques, particularly during movement deceleration. This dissociation indicates that muscle activity is not solely determined by inverse-dynamics requirements but reflects additional control objectives. A regression-based reconstruction showed that muscle activation patterns can be predicted from a compact set of biomechanical variables, primarily gravity-related torque and movement velocity. Together, these findings demonstrate that motor commands combine predictive compensation for gravitational and inertial forces with gravity-dependent modulation of limb impedance. Scaling joint stiffness with gravitational load provides a robust control strategy for stabilizing movement under variable mechanical conditions. This principle offers a biologically grounded framework for the design of adaptive controllers in prosthetics, wearable robotics, and rehabilitation systems operating in uncertain environments.

title: Forcing dataset updates impact regional but not global Earth radiation budget trends in the GFDL AM4 climate model
summary_zh: 研究评估了使用更新后的强迫数据集对模拟辐射收支的影响。方法上，使用CMIP7强迫数据集进行系统评估。实验表明，更新后的强迫数据集未改善模拟全球平均顶空气辐射趋势与卫星观测趋势的一致性。
summary_en: This study evaluates the impact of using updated forcing datasets on simulated radiation budgets. The method involves a systematic evaluation using the newly released CMIP7 forcing dataset. Experiments show that the updated forcing dataset does not improve the agreement between the simulated global-mean top-of-the-atmosphere radiation trends and satellite-observed trends.
insights: 创新点：评估更新后的强迫数据集对模拟辐射收支的影响
方法亮点：使用CMIP7强迫数据集进行系统评估
关键发现：更新后的强迫数据集未改善模拟全球平均顶空气辐射趋势与卫星观测趋势的一致性
insights_en: Novelty: Evaluating the impact of updated forcing datasets on simulated radiation budgets
Method highlight: Systematic evaluation using the CMIP7 forcing dataset
Key finding: The updated forcing dataset does not improve the agreement between the simulated global-mean top-of-the-atmosphere radiation trends and satellite-observed trends
abstract: Abstract The availability of up-to-date forcing datasets is critical for reconciling Earth system model simulations with contemporary observations. With the newly released CMIP7 forcing dataset, which extends the historical record through 2021, this study provides the first systematic evaluation of how using updated forcings over the “middle-of-the-road” SSP2-4.5 scenario forcings influences the simulated radiation budget. The updated forcing dataset used in the atmosphere model does not improve the agreement between the simulated global-mean top-of-the-atmosphere radiation trends and the satellite-observed trends. Regionally, we identify pronounced shifts in radiative energy partitioning between atmosphere and surface. Specifically, during 2001 ~ 2021, accelerated reductions in sulfate and black carbon aerosols over East Asia drive a significant decline in atmospheric solar absorption that matches observations, while a substantial increase in organic aerosols at higher latitudes induces a localized increase in atmospheric absorption that does not match observations. The substantial influence of localized forcing changes on simulated regional climate underscores the necessity for routine updates of forcing datasets.

title: Subcellular compartment determines signal dominance: Endosomal cAMP overrides concurrent plasma membrane RhoA activation from a single receptor
summary_zh: 研究揭示了细胞内信号的空间差异如何影响细胞输出。方法上，以G蛋白偶联受体为模型，展示内质网和质膜信号的功能对立。实验表明，内质网信号占主导地位，逆转细胞输出。
summary_en: This study reveals how spatially distinct signals from a single activated receptor influence cellular output. The method uses a G-protein-coupled receptor as a model system, demonstrating functional opposition between endosomal and plasma membrane signals. Experiments show that endosomal signaling predominates to reverse the net cellular output.
insights: 创新点：揭示细胞内信号的空间差异影响细胞输出
方法亮点：以G蛋白偶联受体为模型研究信号对立
关键发现：内质网信号占主导地位，逆转细胞输出
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing how spatially distinct signals from a single activated receptor influence cellular output
Method highlight: Using a G-protein-coupled receptor as a model to study signal opposition
Key finding: Endosomal signaling predominates to reverse the net cellular output
abstract: Cells convey information not only via the identity of activated signaling pathways but also through the subcellular location where those signals originate. Whether spatially distinct signals from a single activated receptor compete to determine net cellular output has remained unclear. Here, we demonstrate this principle for a G-protein-coupled receptor (GPCR), showing that endosomal and plasma membrane signals from a single activated receptor are not merely distinct but functionally opposed, with endosomal signaling predominating to reverse the net cellular output. Using the adhesion GPCR GPR64/ADGRG2 as a model system, we show that ligand activation engages two spatially distinct G-protein pathways that are not just additive but functionally opposed: plasma membrane G 13 /RhoA activation and Gs/cAMP production that persists from endosomes following receptor internalization. The endosomal cAMP pool actively overrides concurrent plasma membrane RhoA activation, resulting in net RhoA inactivation, an outcome that is completely reversed by pharmacological blockade of endocytosis or endosomal G s inactivation. In parathyroid cells, where GPR64 is highly expressed, this endosomal signal dominance suppresses parathyroid hormone secretion independently of extracellular Ca 2+ levels. These findings support a model in which the subcellular compartment, rather than pathway identity, determines the dominant signal and the overall cellular response of a single activated receptor, with implications for understanding the complexity of GPCR signaling.

title: Geochemical signatures of magnetite are conserved in diverse populations of environmental magnetotactic bacteria
summary_zh: 研究报道了磁铁细菌中磁铁矿的地球化学特征。方法上，通过实验室培养和混合种群分析，验证了磁铁矿的地球化学特征。实验表明，这些特征在不同种群中保持一致。
summary_en: This study reports the geochemical signatures of magnetite in diverse populations of environmental magnetotactic bacteria. The method involves laboratory culturing and analysis of mixed populations to verify the geochemical signatures. Experiments show that these signatures are consistent across different populations.
insights: 创新点：报道磁铁细菌中磁铁矿的地球化学特征
方法亮点：实验室培养和混合种群分析验证特征
关键发现：特征在不同种群中保持一致
insights_en: Novelty: Reporting the geochemical signatures of magnetite in environmental magnetotactic bacteria
Method highlight: Laboratory culturing and analysis of mixed populations to verify the signatures
Key finding: Signatures are consistent across different populations
abstract: Magnetotactic bacteria (MTB) synthesize intracellular magnetite nanoparticles in a genetically controlled manner. They may represent some of the earliest biomineralizing organisms on Earth, and a unique window into ancient life and the environments that hosted it. Yet, identification of their mineralogical remains in ancient rocks is highly challenging due to the lack of reliable and lasting proxies. Previous results obtained from laboratory cultures of single strains of MTB revealed trace element and Fe isotope patterns that are not shared by any other source of magnetite, which could be used as reliable proxies for the identification of ancient MTB. However, the environmental relevance of these previous findings for environmental and mixed population of MTB is unknown. We report the trace element and Fe isotope compositions of magnetite extracted from environmental MTB collected in the water column of Lake Pavin, France, and show that the most distinctive geochemical traits (enrichment in Mo, Se, Sn, and light Fe isotopes) of magnetite produced by MTB cultivated in the laboratory are conserved in environmental populations. They represent potential biological signatures that can be searched in ancient rocks and coupled with magnetic and mineralogical tracers to support the presence of MTB and reconstruct their emergence and evolution.

title: Spontaneous gas film expansion at an oil–water interface
summary_zh: 研究揭示了油水界面自发形成气膜的现象。方法上，通过微结构限制和气泡引入，实现气膜形成。实验表明，气膜的形成降低了局部压力，促进了溶解空气的吸收。
summary_en: This study reveals the spontaneous formation of a gas film at an oil-water interface. The method involves microstructural confinement and bubble introduction to achieve gas film formation. Experiments show that the formation of the gas film lowers local pressure, promoting the uptake of dissolved air.
insights: 创新点：揭示油水界面自发形成气膜的现象
方法亮点：微结构限制和气泡引入实现气膜形成
关键发现：气膜的形成降低了局部压力，促进了溶解空气的吸收
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing the spontaneous formation of a gas film at an oil-water interface
Method highlight: Microstructural confinement and bubble introduction to achieve gas film formation
Key finding: The formation of the gas film lowers local pressure, promoting the uptake of dissolved air
abstract: Spontaneous interfacial separation of oil and water, by inserting a gas film between the two liquids, is thermodynamically unfavorable because the oil–water interface is replaced by oil–gas and water–gas interfaces with a higher combined interfacial energy. Here, we demonstrate that microstructural confinement enables this transition after bubble introduction through the coupling of wetting, capillarity, and gas transport. Spontaneous oil imbibition into a water-submerged micropillar array, together with local contact-line pinning, deforms the oil–water interface into a metastable meniscus and generates a local pressure deficit in the confined oil. This deficit, combined with the bubble’s interfacial configuration, lowers its air partial pressure and promotes dissolved-air uptake from the surrounding water. Geometric confinement, reduced oil pressure, and low oil–gas interfacial tension favor bubble lateral invasion of adjacent oil-filled cells over vertical extrusion. As the gas front advances, meniscus relaxation and oil redistribution promote further wetting, renewing the capillary conditions that support gas film propagation. We develop a coupled transport-capillarity framework that captures these morphological transitions and predicts a characteristic timescale for gas film evolution, determined by the interaction among geometry, capillarity, and gas-phase transport. Spatially varying the microstructure further controls the propagation pathway and morphology of the gas film. These findings show how favorable wetting can support an energetically costly interfacial transformation through a confinement-induced capillary pressure field, providing a general mechanism for gas-mediated separation in confined multiphase systems.

title: Hepatocyte-derived exosomal miR-122 mediates liver-to-brain crosstalk and neuroinflammation in alcohol-exposed Alzheimer’s disease mice
summary_zh: 研究提出肝细胞来源的miR-122在酒精暴露的阿尔茨海默病小鼠中介导肝脑通讯和神经炎症。方法上，评估了反复暴饮对肝脏和大脑的影响。实验表明，酒精暴露导致肝脏损伤和神经炎症。
summary_en: This study proposes that hepatocyte-derived exosomal miR-122 mediates liver-to-brain crosstalk and neuroinflammation in alcohol-exposed Alzheimer's disease mice. The method involves evaluating the effects of repeated binge drinking on the liver and brain. Experiments show that alcohol exposure leads to liver injury and neuroinflammation.
insights: 创新点：提出miR-122介导肝脑通讯和神经炎症
方法亮点：评估反复暴饮对肝脏和大脑的影响
关键发现：酒精暴露导致肝脏损伤和神经炎症
insights_en: Novelty: Proposing miR-122 mediates liver-to-brain crosstalk and neuroinflammation
Method highlight: Evaluating the effects of repeated binge drinking on the liver and brain
Key finding: Alcohol exposure leads to liver injury and neuroinflammation
abstract: Neuroinflammation and microglial activation are common features in Alzheimer’s disease (AD) and excessive alcohol consumption. Alcohol induces liver damage and inflammation, and altered serum aminotransferases have been reported in patients with AD. Small extracellular vesicles (sEVs) and their cargo are emerging as mediators of intercellular communication in AD and alcohol-induced liver injury. However, the effects of alcohol use on AD progression remain to be elucidated. In this study, we evaluated the effects of repeated binge drinking on the liver and brain in the APP/PS1 mouse model of AD. Alcohol-exposed APP/PS1 mice showed elevated serum alanine aminotransferase levels, indicating liver injury absent in controls, along with increased pro-inflammatory cytokine expression in both liver and brain. Alcohol increased the biogenesis and release of sEVs in AD mice and in mouse hepatocytes. These sEVs were enriched in mature miR-122-5p that is predominant in hepatocytes. In vivo, miR-122-5p was detected in the brain of alcohol-exposed AD mice suggesting EV-mediated miR-122-5p transfer to the brain. Microglial uptake of hepatocyte-derived sEVs was confirmed in vitro. sEVs from alcohol-treated hepatocytes sensitized BV-2 microglia to LPS stimulation, significantly enhancing CCL2, CXCL2, CCL3, and TNF-α production. Transfection of microglia with a miR-122-5p mimic partially recapitulated the pro-inflammatory sensitization by sEVs from alcohol-exposed hepatocytes, which was reversed by miR-122-5p inhibitor delivery. ADAM10, a miR-122-5p target, was reduced in both wild-type and AD brains after alcohol exposure, with cell-specific effects. These results suggest that alcohol-induced hepatocyte-derived sEVs may modulate liver-to-brain signaling via miR-122-5p and contribute to neuroinflammation in AD.

title: Rising cell-free DNA level tracks cancer-associated methylation signal and improves multicancer detection
summary_zh: 研究癌症患者循环cfDNA水平。方法：分析480名参与者数据。结果显示cfDNA水平与癌症相关甲基化信号相关。
summary_en: Study on cancer patients' circulating cfDNA levels. Method: Analyze data from 480 participants. Results show cfDNA levels correlate with cancer-associated methylation signals.
insights: 创新点：cfDNA水平与癌症相关甲基化信号相关。
方法亮点：大规模参与者数据。
关键发现：cfDNA水平随癌症类型和阶段变化。
insights_en: Novelty: cfDNA levels correlate with cancer-associated methylation signals.
Method highlight: Large-scale participant data.
Key finding: cfDNA levels vary with cancer type and stage.
abstract: Cancer patients carry more circulating cell-free DNA (ccfDNA)—small DNA fragments shed into the blood—than healthy people. Most of this excess comes not from the tumor itself but from immune cells, suggesting that it would simply dilute the much smaller amount of tumor-derived DNA in a blood sample. Using a study of 1,480 previously untreated participants across 43 hospitals—including patients with 14 cancer types spanning all stages, patients with benign growths, and healthy volunteers—we show the opposite: as total ccfDNA rises, it becomes enriched, not diluted, in fragments carrying cancer-associated DNA methylation signatures, independent of cancer type, disease stage, and a broad panel of demographic, clinical, and technical covariates. In fact, total ccfDNA explains more variance in cancer-associated methylation signal than the disease stage itself. This basic biological finding suggests a coupling between immune cell activity and tumor methylation. It also has a practical implication: we show that rising ccfDNA concentration is associated with higher cancer detection sensitivity, even within disease stages and particularly in early-stage disease—stage I sensitivity varied from 0.55 in the lowest ccfDNA concentration tertile to 0.85 in the highest, and stage II from 0.59 to 0.86. This suggests that ccfDNA concentration should be considered as a stage-independent stratification variable for benchmarking cancer-detection tests. Interestingly, similar behavior was observed in patients with symptomatic benign lesions, suggesting a broader biological response to abnormal tissue growth and not something unique to malignancy.

title: Rapid target engagement of KRAS G12C tricomplex inhibitor RO3903 overcomes resistance and drives durable tumor regression
summary_zh: 研究KRAS G12C三复合体抑制剂RO3903。方法：比较多种KRAS G12C抑制剂。结果显示RO3903有效克服耐药性。
summary_en: Study on KRAS G12C tricomplex inhibitor RO3903. Method: Compare various KRAS G12C inhibitors. Results show RO3903 effectively overcomes resistance.
insights: 创新点：RO3903克服KRAS G12C耐药性。
方法亮点：结构优化抑制剂。
关键发现：RO3903抑制RTK介导的KRAS再激活。
insights_en: Novelty: RO3903 overcomes KRAS G12C resistance.
Method highlight: Structurally optimized inhibitors.
Key finding: RO3903 inhibits RTK-mediated KRAS reactivation.
abstract: The clinical durability of first-generation KRAS G12C inhibitors is constrained by resistance mechanisms, primarily the rapid, receptor tyrosine kinase (RTK)-mediated reactivation of KRAS to its drug-insensitive, guanosine triphosphate (GTP)-bound (ON) state. Here, we perform a systematic comparative characterization of clinical and investigational KRAS G12C inhibitors, including Sotorasib, Adagrasib, Divarasib, and Elironrasib, and our structurally optimized tricomplex ON inhibitor, RO7783903 (RO3903). We demonstrate that the covalent tricomplex inhibitors RO3903 and Elironrasib effectively outpace dynamic nucleotide cycling, conferring resilience to potent RTK stimulation and overcoming the secondary KRAS mutations that drive clinical resistance to guanosine diphosphate (GDP)-bound (OFF) state inhibitors. Notably, RO3903 potently inhibits tumor growth in a dose-dependent manner across multiple preclinical models, including an orthotopic intracranial model. Furthermore, RO3903 exhibits synergistic efficacy when combined with inhibitors targeting OFF-state KRAS G12C, YAP-TEAD, EGFR/MET, or FAK, as well as with anti-PD1 antibody and anti-PD1/VEGF bispecific antibody immunotherapies. The high potency, fast target engagement, and brain tumor inhibition of RO3903 position this molecule as a valuable tool reagent and a promising partner for combination strategies to achieve durable tumor regression.

title: Thermodynamic stabilization of substrate protein within the GroEL:ES chaperonin cage
summary_zh: 研究GroEL:ES伴侣蛋白腔内底物蛋白的热力学稳定性。方法：通过MBP变体研究。结果显示伴侣蛋白腔对蛋白折叠有重要影响。
summary_en: Study on the thermodynamic stability of substrate protein within the GroEL:ES chaperonin cage. Method: Investigate through MBP variant. Results show the chaperonin cavity has a significant impact on protein folding.
insights: 创新点：伴侣蛋白腔影响蛋白折叠。
方法亮点：MBP变体研究。
关键发现：伴侣蛋白腔稳定底物蛋白。
insights_en: Novelty: Chaperonin cavity affects protein folding.
Method highlight: MBP variant study.
Key finding: Chaperonin cavity stabilizes substrate protein.
abstract: The adenosine triphosphate (ATP)-regulated GroEL/ES chaperonin of Escherichia coli promotes protein folding by transiently encapsulating unfolded substrate protein in a nano-cage formed by the cylindrical GroEL and the lid-shaped GroES. How this confinement modulates the folding energy landscape, allowing accelerated protein folding unimpaired by aggregation, remains incompletely understood. Prompted by recent observations suggesting that the chaperonin cavity may favor unfolding [I. Korobko et al. , Proc. Natl. Acad. Sci. U.S.A. 119 , e2213170119 (2022)], here we reinvestigated the effect of encapsulation on protein thermodynamic stability. To allow thermal unfolding of an encapsulated substrate protein, we generated a destabilized variant of maltose-binding protein (MBP) by introducing four mutations, quadruple mutant-MBP (QM-MBP), lowering the melting temperature ( T m ) from 63.6 °C to 44.3 °C. GroEL/ES accelerated the slow spontaneous folding of QM-MBP ~20-fold. The protein reached a native-like structure while encapsulated inside GroEL:ES, as demonstrated using hydrogen/deuterium exchange and single molecule fluorescence resonance energy transfer analyses in presence and absence of the ligand maltose. Importantly, confinement in the thermally stable chaperonin shifted the cooperative unfolding transition of QM-MBP to a T m of 52.4 °C, corresponding to a stabilization by 4.6 kcal mol −1 . In-cage thermal unfolding was reversible, indicating that the environment of the chaperonin cavity is conducive to folding. These findings suggest that a thermodynamically stabilizing effect of the GroEL:ES cage contributes to promoting protein folding.

title: In This Issue
How 20th-century immigrants did not have to change their last names in order to become American
summary_zh: 研究20世纪移民保留姓氏现象。方法：分析社保申请记录。结果显示大部分移民保留了姓氏。
summary_en: Study on the phenomenon of 20th-century immigrants retaining their last names. Method: Analyze Social Security Application records. Results show most immigrants retained their last names.
insights: 创新点：移民保留姓氏不改变身份。
方法亮点：社保申请记录分析。
关键发现：姓氏变化与社区网络密度相关。
insights_en: Novelty: Immigrants retaining their last names do not change their identity.
Method highlight: Social Security Application records analysis.
Key finding: Name changes relate to community network density.
abstract: Reports of parents’ names in Social Security Application records allow us to quantify at a population level the extent and nature of historical last name changes by immigrants. Our analysis of European, Middle Eastern, and Asian immigrants of the early to mid-20th-century finds that more than 80% kept their last names. Computational linguistic analysis shows that most of those who did change preserved their surname’s ethnic signal, leaving only about 5% of all immigrants trying to disguise their foreign origins. Of these, Jewish immigrants had the highest rate of ethnicity-concealing last name changes; Italian, Japanese, and Chinese immigrants all had the lowest. Our proposed framework helps understand the variation: name changes were rarest where ethnic community networks were densest and where passing as unmarked was least credible—as among visibly non-White immigrants. Our findings challenge the dominant assimilationist narrative that immigrants in this era had to shed their foreign identities to enter the American mainstream. “Becoming White” by adopting an English surname was not a large part of historical immigrant experience. Rather, the overwhelming majority of immigrants chose to openly preserve their ethnic origins. Our results also suggest that nominal record linkage of historical immigrant populations may be more feasible than previously assumed.

title: Engineered T cell–agonist chimera for logic-gated STING activation and augmented cancer immunotherapy
summary_zh: 研究工程化T细胞-激动剂嵌合体增强癌症免疫治疗。方法：设计T细胞靶向纳米激动剂。结果显示嵌合体实现STING激活。
summary_en: Study on engineered T cell-agonist chimera for augmented cancer immunotherapy. Method: Design TAM-targeted nanoagonist. Results show the chimera achieves STING activation.
insights: 创新点：T细胞-激动剂嵌合体增强免疫治疗。
方法亮点：T细胞靶向纳米激动剂。
关键发现：嵌合体实现AND逻辑门控的STING激活。
insights_en: Novelty: T cell-agonist chimera enhances immunotherapy.
Method highlight: TAM-targeted nanoagonist.
Key finding: Chimera achieves AND logic-gated STING activation.
abstract: The efficacy of adoptive T cell therapy against solid tumors is markedly hindered by the immunosuppressive microenvironment. Here, we demonstrate that stimulator of interferon genes (STING) activation in tumor-associated macrophages (TAM) enhances the intratumoral infiltration and cytotoxicity of adoptive T cells. We next design a TAM-targeted nanoagonist and engineer a T cell – agonist chimera (SNTC) via covalent surface anchoring, to achieve synchronized biodistribution of STING agonist with adoptive T cells. The nanoagonist is locally released in tumor tissue in response to the elevated reduction potential on T cell surface, followed by intracellular glutathione-mediated restoration of STING agonist in TAM, thereby enabling AND logic-gated STING activation. SNTC not only reshapes tumor stroma and immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment to augment adoptive T cell function but also enhances the antigen presentation ability of TAM to activate endogenous T cells. SNTC elicits robust antitumor efficacy in melanoma tumor-bearing mice, resulting in over 40% survival beyond 60 d. Moreover, combining tumor-infiltrating T lymphocyte (TIL)-based SNTC with immune checkpoint blockade therapy leads to sustained tumor regression in mouse model of orthotopic pancreatic tumor. Collectively, SNTC holds translational potential to optimize STING activation for adoptive T cell therapy of cancer.

title: Hypothalamic lncRNA Synage prevents age-related sperm quality decline by suppressing A-type potassium currents in GnRH neurons
summary_zh: 研究下丘脑lncRNA Synage抑制GnRH神经元钾电流。方法：通过Synage补充和基因敲除研究。结果显示Synage改善精子质量。
summary_en: Study on hypothalamic lncRNA Synage suppressing A-type potassium currents in GnRH neurons. Method: Through Synage supplementation and gene knockout studies. Results show Synage improves sperm quality.
insights: 创新点：Synage改善年龄相关精子质量下降。
方法亮点：Synage补充和基因敲除研究。
关键发现：Synage增加血清睾酮和精子数量。
insights_en: Novelty: Synage improves age-related sperm quality decline.
Method highlight: Synage supplementation and gene knockout studies.
Key finding: Synage increases serum testosterone and sperm count.
abstract: Age-related decline in male fertility, including diminished sperm quality, poses significant risks to offspring health and is exacerbated by modern trends toward delayed parenthood. Focusing on the hypothalamus–pituitary–testis axis, which governs hormonal control of male reproduction, we identified Synage , a long noncoding RNA expressed in the hypothalamic medial preoptic area (mPOA). We found that Synage expression in gonadotropin-releasing hormone (GnRH) neurons decreases with age, correlating with reduced sperm quality and male fertility. mPOA-targeted Synage _B (brain-specific isoform) supplementation increases serum testosterone and improves sperm count and progressive motility in 12-mo-old mice. Conversely, conditional deletion of Synage in GnRH neurons in young mice reduces GnRH neuron firing, decreases serum LH and testosterone levels, impaires sperm quality, and reduces male fertility. Mechanistically, Synage interacts with the heat shock protein HSPA8 and stabilizes the HSPA8–KCHIP4 interaction. Synage loss increases KCHIP4 abundance and its association with the Kv4.2 channel, promoting Kv4.2 membrane recruitment and enhancing A-type potassium currents ( I A ), thereby reducing GnRH neuronal excitability. Consistent with this model, GnRH neurons from 12-mo-old mice also exhibit reduced excitability. Together, these findings support a role for age-dependent Synage loss in reproductive decline, at least in part through dysregulation of the HSPA8–KCHIP4–Kv4.2 pathway and reduced GnRH neuron excitability. These findings identify Synage as a candidate regulator of reproductive aging and motivate further investigation of its translational potential.

title: Unpacking transatlantic income inequality
summary_zh: 研究跨大西洋收入不平等。方法：分析17国收入和劳动力市场数据。结果显示收入不平等存在收敛趋势。
summary_en: Study on transatlantic income inequality. Method: Analyze income and labor market data from 17 countries. Results show a trend of convergence in income inequality.
insights: 创新点：跨大西洋收入不平等收敛。
方法亮点：跨国家收入和劳动力市场数据分析。
关键发现：收入不平等随时间收敛。
insights_en: Novelty: Convergence of transatlantic income inequality.
Method highlight: Cross-country income and labor market data analysis.
Key finding: Income inequality converges over time.
abstract: This paper uses newly harmonized survey and register data on incomes and labor market outcomes as the basis for consistent comparisons of inequalities across 17 North American and European countries over the period 1995–2021. We examine trends in disposable income inequality in the working-age population, defined as persons aged 25 to 60, as well as its component parts of market income inequality and redistribution through government tax and transfer systems. We adjust incomes to allow for changes in education, population aging, and household structure in each country. We test for convergence across countries in demographically-adjusted disposable income inequality, along with market income inequality and redistribution. There is strong evidence of convergence over time in disposable income inequality across the 17 countries, despite a divergence in the dispersion of market income inequality driven by very heterogeneous trends for hours of work and the number of workers in households across countries. Consistent with this we find a strong convergence across countries in the dispersion of our measure of redistribution. There are reductions over time in inequality-reducing redistribution in the Nordic countries and increases in some other European and North American countries, with the net effect being more similarity across countries, a lower average level of redistribution, and a higher average level of disposable income inequality. These trends are being driven by the bottom 95% of the income distribution. Our results are robust to a variety of alternative specifications including the measure of inequality, trimming of data outliers, and sample period.

title: Core effectors of the Fusarium pan-effectome contribute to host specificity
summary_zh: 研究Fusarium泛效应因子与宿主特异性。方法：构建FUSEC数据库。结果显示效应因子家族具有保守性。
summary_en: Study on core effectors of the Fusarium pan-effectome and host specificity. Method: Construct FUSEC database. Results show effector families have conservation.
insights: 创新点：Fusarium效应因子家族保守。
方法亮点：FUSEC数据库构建。
关键发现：效应因子影响宿主特异性。
insights_en: Novelty: Conservation of Fusarium effector families.
Method highlight: Construction of FUSEC database.
Key finding: Effectors contribute to host specificity.
abstract: Fusarium fungi cause economically important diseases of cereal crops, including Fusarium head blight, ear blight, and root rot. Central to these interactions are secreted effector proteins that manipulate host biology to promote infection. In turn, plants have evolved to recognize effector activity to activate immune responses and restrict disease. Despite their importance, the diversity, conservation, and evolution of Fusarium effectors remain poorly understood. Here, we present the Fusarium sambucinum Species complex Effector Compendium (FUSEC), a sequence-defined pan-effectome constructed from 188 high-quality genomes representing 27 species. FUSEC comprises 4,057 sequence-defined effector families, including a conserved soft-core repertoire of 235 families present in at least 95% of isolates. Structure-guided comparisons reorganized these conserved families into 184 structure-defined groups, revealing relationships that extend beyond sequence similarity and identifying similarities to numerous experimentally characterized fungal (a)virulence factors. Despite their broad conservation, soft-core families exhibited substantial within-family sequence diversity, and analyses of diversifying selection identified 44 candidate families undergoing adaptive evolution. Functional screening revealed that the majority of these candidates altered wheat immune responses, and CRISPR-Cas9-mediated gene deletions in Fusarium graminearum demonstrated that multiple conserved effectors contribute to cultivar-dependent Fusarium head blight severity.

title: Coupled outward and inward oxide growth during metal oxidation
summary_zh: 本文研究金属氧化过程中氧化层生长模式。方法上采用原位环境透射电子显微镜监测铜氧化。实验表明氧化层内外生长模式并非互斥，而是内在耦合。
summary_en: This paper investigates the growth modes of oxide scales during metal oxidation. The method employs in situ environmental transmission electron microscopy to monitor copper oxidation. Experiments show that the outward and inward growth modes of the oxide layer are not mutually exclusive but intrinsically coupled.
insights: 创新点：揭示氧化层内外生长模式耦合机制
方法亮点：原位环境透射电子显微镜监测技术
关键发现：氧化层内外生长模式非互斥
insights_en: Novelty: Unveiling the intrinsic coupling mechanism of outward and inward oxide growth modes
Method highlight: In situ environmental transmission electron microscopy monitoring technology
Key finding: The outward and inward growth modes of the oxide layer are not mutually exclusive
abstract: Metal oxidation is traditionally described as a dichotomy: oxide scales grow either outward via cation diffusion or inward via anion diffusion, with the dominant pathway determined by the prevailing point defects in the oxide lattice. Here, we demonstrate that these two modes are not mutually exclusive but intrinsically coupled within a single oxidation process. Using in situ environmental transmission electron microscopy to monitor the oxidation of copper—a canonical cationic system—we directly visualize simultaneous oxide propagation at both the O 2 /Cu 2 O surface interface and the buried Cu 2 O/Cu interface. Complementary simulations reveal the mechanistic origin of this behavior. Outward cation transport during surface oxide growth injects a sustained flux of vacancies into the underlying metal lattice, which facilitates inward oxygen incorporation and drives oxide growth at the buried interface. This vacancy-mediated feedback couples cationic and anionic transport process, providing a unified framework in which surface cationic growth directly enables inward anionic-driven growth. By identifying vacancy injection as a key mediator of interfacial mass transport, this work provides a mechanistic basis for predicting oxidation kinetics and defect-regulated solid-state transformation pathways in reactive environments.

title: Venousization enables angiogenesis in the absence of VEGFR signalling
summary_zh: 研究发现，在没有VEGFR信号的情况下，静脉化可以促进血管生成。
summary_en: The study finds that venousization can promote angiogenesis in the absence of VEGFR signaling.
insights: 创新点：揭示了VEGFR信号非依赖性血管生成的机制
方法亮点：使用基因敲除小鼠研究VEGFR信号的作用
关键发现：静脉化可以促进血管生成
insights_en: Novelty: Revealed the mechanism of angiogenesis independent of VEGFR signaling
Method highlight: Studied the role of VEGFR signaling using knockout mice
Key finding: Venousization can promote angiogenesis
abstract: Abstract The VEGF ligand and its main receptor VEGFR2 are considered to be essential for endothelial differentiation, proliferation, sprouting and survival. Blood vessels cannot form in growing embryos or tissues when VEGF/VEGFR2 signalling is compromised in all cells. The Anti-VEGF blocking antibody is one of the most widely used antibodies in the clinics, blocking angiogenesis in cancer, wound healing or in ischemic diseases. However, vascular resistance to Anti-VEGF has been reported. Here we used iFlpMosaics and iSuRe-HadCre to induce and track genetic mosaics of endothelial cells (ECs) lacking VEGFR2 during the entire embryonic and postnatal development. Surprisingly, Vegfr2 KO ECs adapt, proliferate normally and compete with wild-type cells over time, ultimately forming a substantial portion of the capillary network in most organs. We found that Vegfr2 KO ECs are not able to sprout during the first wave of angiogenesis in most tissues, because it is highly VEGF-dependent and favours the growth and mobilization of wild-type ECs. However, due to their inability to respond to VEGF, over time Vegfr2 KO ECs become dominant in veins, which provide for a long term and continuous source of ECs for subsequent waves of VEGF-independent angiogenesis. Comparative scRNAseq analysis of ECs with acute and long-term loss of VEGFR2, revealed both common and organ-specific molecular mechanisms of adaptation and resistance to VEGF signalling loss. This included significant endothelial venousization and the upregulation of ligands for VEGFR1 and VEGFR3. VEGFR1 only partially compensated for VEGFR2 loss in capillary ECs, whereas VEGFR3 only compensated in arterial ECs. Loss of the three VEGF receptors did not compromise venous growth. This work changes our understanding of the role of VEGF signaling and its receptors in angiogenesis and reveals mechanisms of adaptation and resistance to their loss.

title: Nectin-4 mediates rubella virus entry in airway and placental cells
summary_zh: 研究确定了Nectin-4是风疹病毒进入呼吸道和胎盘细胞的受体。
summary_en: The study identifies Nectin-4 as a functional receptor for rubella virus entry into airway and placental cells.
insights: 创新点：发现了Nectin-4作为风疹病毒受体的作用
方法亮点：使用蛋白质组学和CRISPR/Cas9技术进行验证
关键发现：Nectin-4与麻疹病毒有共同进化特征
insights_en: Novelty: Identified the role of Nectin-4 as a rubella virus receptor
Method highlight: Validated using proteomics and CRISPR/Cas9 technologies
Key finding: Nectin-4 shares convergent evolutionary features with measles virus
abstract: Abstract Rubella virus (RuV) causes rubella and, when acquired during pregnancy, congenital rubella syndrome (CRS). Despite its clinical significance, the cellular entry mechanism of RuV remains poorly characterized owing to limited knowledge of host receptors, hampering pathogenesis studies and therapeutic development. Here, we identify Nectin-4 as a functional RuV entry receptor through proximity biotin labeling-based proteomics coupled with CRISPR/Cas9 validation. Notably, Nectin-4 is shared with measles virus, revealing convergent evolution in viral entry despite the different viral families. Nectin-4 directly interacts with the RuV envelope glycoproteins through its ectodomain, facilitating receptor-mediated endocytosis following initial calcium-dependent viral attachment. In polarized respiratory epithelial cells, Nectin-4 mediates basolateral viral entry and subsequent apical release of progeny virions, enabling efficient respiratory transmission. Using human placental organoid models, we demonstrate that syncytiotrophoblasts serve as primary targets for transplacental RuV infection, with viral entry significantly inhibited by Nectin-4 blockade. These findings establish Nectin-4 as critical for both horizontal respiratory transmission and vertical maternal–fetal transmission of RuV. Our results provide fundamental insights into RuV pathogenesis and identify Nectin-4 as a promising therapeutic target for CRS. Importantly, the discovery of shared receptor utilization between RuV and measles virus opens new avenues for integrated elimination strategies targeting both pathogens.

title: Comprehensive mapping of essential-gene interactions in M. tuberculosis
summary_zh: 研究开发了一种高吞吐量基因互作图谱构建平台，用于结核分枝杆菌中关键基因的互作研究。
summary_en: This study develops a high-throughput gene interaction mapping platform for essential gene interactions in Mycobacterium tuberculosis.
insights: 创新点：开发了高吞吐量基因互作图谱构建平台。
方法亮点：采用独特的sgRNA对条形码。
关键发现：揭示了结核分枝杆菌中关键基因的互作。
insights_en: Novelty: Develops a high-throughput gene interaction mapping platform.
Method highlight: Implements unique barcodes for each sgRNA pair.
Key finding: Reveals essential gene interactions in Mycobacterium tuberculosis.
abstract: Abstract Mycobacterium tuberculosis , the causative agent of tuberculosis, remains the world’s deadliest pathogen 1 . Despite intensive study, many of its genes remain uncharacterized, which limits the insight that can be gained into tuberculosis biology and constrains drug development. Genetic interaction (GI) mapping is a powerful strategy to define functional relationships between genes by quantifying how the phenotypic effects of combined perturbations deviate from expectations based on single-gene perturbations 2,3 . Here we develop a dual-sgRNA CRISPR-interference platform that enables high-throughput GI mapping in mycobacteria. We address key technical challenges in library construction and data interpretation by incorporating unique barcodes for each sgRNA pair and implementing a robust statistical pipeline for GI detection. Focusing on essential genes, we generate comprehensive GI maps in the model mycobacterium Mycobacterium smegmatis and the pathogen M. tuberculosis . These maps recapitulate known biology, uncover thousands of previously unrecognized interactions and identify functional connections between essential genes and drug targets. By generating AlphaFold3-based protein–protein interaction predictions 4 for all gene pairs in our GI maps, we show that a subset of GIs is likely to reflect underlying physical associations. Validation of selected GIs confirms both novel biological relationships and opportunities for synergistic targeting. Overall, this work establishes a generalizable framework for dual-gene perturbation and defines the architecture of essential-gene networks in mycobacteria, advancing both our understanding of tuberculosis biology and the rational design of combination therapies.

summary_en: A nonrandomized phase 2 trial was conducted to evaluate perioperative ivonescimab with or without chemotherapy in resectable non-small cell lung cancer. 方法亮点：进行了一项非随机性II期试验。
