abstract: In a nonrandomized phase 2 trial, patients with resectable non-small cell lung cancer received perioperative ivonescimab as monotherapy or with chemotherapy, leading to encouraging pathological response rates in both cohorts, and sustained circulating tumor DNA negativity throughout neoadjuvant therapy may be predictive of response.

title: A tumor transcriptomic atlas across eight decades of life reveals distinct features of early-onset colorectal cancer
An aggregation-prone region in talin controls talin self-interactions and regulates integrin adhesion complex dynamics
summary_zh: 研究揭示talin R11区域存在隐蔽的结合位点，机械展开后暴露出聚集易感区域（APR），调控整合素粘附复合体动态。
summary_en: Research reveals a hidden binding site in talin R11, which, upon mechanical unfolding, exposes an Aggregation Prone Region (APR) to regulate integrin adhesion complex dynamics.
insights: 创新点：发现talin R11的隐蔽结合位点
方法亮点：通过机械展开研究APR
关键发现：APR调控整合素粘附复合体动态
insights_en: Novelty: Discovery of the hidden binding site in talin R11
Method highlight: Study of APR through mechanical unfolding
Key finding: APR regulates integrin adhesion complex dynamics
abstract: Abstract The tight regulation of the integrin family of extracellular matrix (ECM) receptors is essential for the coordination of most cellular processes. Talin regulates integrin function by binding to the cytoplasmic tail of the integrin beta subunit. Two integrin-binding sites (IBS) in talin have been reported, one in the talin head domain (IBS1), and a second in the C-terminal rod region of talin (IBS2), mapped to the R11-R12 domains. Whilst the structural details of integrin binding to IBS1 are well understood, IBS2’s mode of binding integrin is less clear, and the biochemical details of this site have been elusive. Here we report that talin R11 contains a cryptic high affinity talin-binding site. We show that mechanical unfolding of R11 exposes an Aggregation Prone Region (APR) in Helix50 that oligomerizes with other talin R11s. Our data support a model whereby the process of mechanically unfolding one R11, exposes and maintains the APR in a high affinity conformation that drives unfolding of other R11 domains and oligomerisation. Atomic Force Microscopy confirms that the APR region alone forms micron long amyloid-like fibres, via a beta-sheet amyloid arrangement which can be abolished using a canonical “gatekeeper” point mutation, V2078K, that prevents APR interactions. Introducing this gatekeeper mutant in talin eliminates recruitment of talin IBS2 to integrin adhesion sites. The APR region in talin overlaps with a vinculin-binding site in Helix50, and we show a novel role for vinculin as a mechano-chaperone for talin, able to resolve the talin large species by binding to the VBS in Helix50. In light of this new information, we propose that the ability of R11-R12 to target to integrin adhesion complexes and enhance integrin activation can be better explained by a model where functional aggregation of talin serves to recruit and activate more talin molecules at the adhesion site leading to enhanced integrin activation. Whilst further work is required to fully exclude integrin binding to R11 we suggest that the name IBS2 might be a misnomer and propose the name Aggregation Prone Region 1 (APR1) for this talin oligomerisation motif.

title: Maize genetic diversity is largely unstructured by human ethnolinguistic diversity in its center of origin
summary_zh: 研究显示，玉米遗传多样性在起源地主要不受人类族群语言多样性影响。
summary_en: The study shows that maize genetic diversity in its center of origin is largely unaffected by human ethnolinguistic diversity.
insights: 创新点：量化人类活动对玉米遗传多样性的影响
方法亮点：结合基因型和护照数据
关键发现：玉米遗传多样性不受族群语言多样性影响
insights_en: Novelty: Quantifying the impact of human activity on maize genetic diversity
Method highlight: Combining genotyping and passport data
Key finding: Maize genetic diversity is unaffected by ethnolinguistic diversity
abstract: Abstract Population structure and environmental features often capture major axes of genetic variation in many species. Yet the impacts of human activity often remain unquantified. For domesticated species that rely on human activity for survival and dispersal, human movements and cultural differences may play key roles patterning genetic diversity. Maize is a staple crop of enormous cultural importance to indigenous peoples of the Americas, but cannot survive or disperse without farmers. Using publicly available genotyping and passport data from approximately 2,000 traditional maize varieties, more than 500 whole genome sequences of humans from Mexico, and indigenous linguistic maps, we quantify anthropogenic effects on maize genetic diversity in the Americas. Maize shows very little overall structure, highlighting the effectiveness of indigenous farmers in moving and mixing maize populations. While principal components of maize diversity show meaningful correlations to human genetic diversity, our linear modeling suggests little additional impact of human population structure beyond shared geography. Though differences in maize diversity are often patterned by language locally, we find only weak genome-wide effects at larger spatial scales. Despite the relatively weak global signal of anthropogenic effects, linguistic GWAS, outlier F ST analyses, and selection scans identified loci associated with specific languages. Leveraging landscape-level sequencing data, we highlight how anthropogenic factors have shaped patterns of maize genetic diversity across Mesoamerica.

title: Amphipathic helices repurpose a Patched/NPC1-like cholesterol transporter to function at Plasmodium –erythrocyte membrane contact sites
summary_zh: 研究揭示两亲性螺旋重用Patched/NPC1样胆固醇转运蛋白，在疟原虫-红细胞膜接触位点发挥作用。
summary_en: The study reveals that amphipathic helices repurpose a Patched/NPC1-like cholesterol transporter to function at Plasmodium-erythrocyte membrane contact sites.
insights: 创新点：发现两亲性螺旋在膜接触位点的作用
方法亮点：研究PfNCR1蛋白定位
关键发现：PfNCR1蛋白与宿主-寄生虫界面相关
insights_en: Novelty: Discovery of the role of amphipathic helices at membrane contact sites
Method highlight: Study of PfNCR1 protein localization
Key finding: PfNCR1 protein is associated with the host-parasite interface
abstract: Abstract The Niemann-Pick Type C1-Related protein of the malaria parasite Plasmodium falciparum , PfNCR1, is a promising anti-malarial drug target facilitating cholesterol homeostasis at the interface of the malaria parasite with its host-red blood cell. PfNCR1 is localized to otherwise functionally uncharacterized regions covering ∼half of the host-parasite interface. These regions are defined by exceptionally narrow membrane contact sites, leaving only ∼3-4 nm vertical aqueous space in between the membranes. Determining the origin and functional consequence of localization to the closely apposed membrane is central for our understanding of PfNCR1 as drug target but also offers a window into the mechanism of the group of homologous proteins, associated with congenital conditions and cancer. Here we define the mechanism of PfNCR1’s membrane contact site localization and its implication for cholesterol transport. We identified a 141 amino acid long (amphipathic) helix - linker - (amphipathic) helix domain (“HLH domain”) unique to Plasmodium spp. , that is necessary for efficient localization of PfNCR1 to the narrow membrane contact sites. Mechanistically, we show that this localization relies on the HLH domain’s physicochemical properties. GPI-anchoring the isolated HLH domain or a version of the HLH domain in which the helices are replaced by the amphipathic helix of human ATG3 are sufficient to target a fluorescent protein to regions of endogenous PfNCR1. Functionally, we demonstrate that the degree of PfNCR1 localization to narrow contact sites qualitatively correlates with its ability to maintain cholesterol homeostasis, linking PfNCR1’s membrane contact to its recognized transport function. Collectively, the results establish the HLH domain as key element for PfNCR1’s localization and effectiveness in cholesterol transport while also opening avenues to probe the narrow membrane contact site regions with engineered proteins.

title: A DPY19L2/FAM209-associated protein–Arp complex–CAPZA3 scaffold is essential for perinuclear theca assembly and fertilization
summary_zh: 研究证明DPY19L2/FAM209相关蛋白-Arp复合体-CAPZA3支架对核周细胞组装和受精至关重要。
summary_en: The study demonstrates that a DPY19L2/FAM209-associated protein-Arp complex-CAPZA3 scaffold is essential for perinuclear theca assembly and fertilization.
insights: 创新点：揭示DPY19L2/FAM209相关蛋白在受精中的作用
方法亮点：研究ACTRT2/3/10蛋白的功能
关键发现：ACTRT2/3/10蛋白影响核周细胞组装
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing the role of DPY19L2/FAM209-associated protein in fertilization
Method highlight: Study of ACTRT2/3/10 protein function
Key finding: ACTRT2/3/10 proteins affect perinuclear theca assembly
abstract: Fertilization is a fundamental biological process that enables the fusion of a spermatozoon with an oocyte to initiate embryonic development. However, the underlying mechanisms leading to fertilization failure remain poorly understood. Here, we demonstrated that the actin-related protein (Arp) family members ACTRT2 and ACTRT3 are essential for fertilization in both humans and mice, whereas ACTL10 is dispensable for fertility and the human-specific ACTL8 may play a role in early spermatogenesis. Ultrastructural and immunofluorescence analyses revealed that, during spermatogenesis, ACTRT2 or ACTRT3 deficiency disrupts the assembly of subacrosomal layer of the perinuclear theca (SAL-PT), leading to acrosome detachment and subsequent manchette abnormalities, which in turn impairs the formation of the postacrosomal sheath of the PT. These structural defects were accompanied by reduced abundance of the candidate sperm-borne oocyte-activating factors PAWP and PLCζ. Moreover, knockout of Actrt2 or Actrt3 severely impaired spermatozoa’s ability to penetrate the zona pellucida during in vitro fertilization. Mechanistically, ACTRT2, ACTRT3, ACTL7A, ACTL7B, and ACTL9 form a testis-enriched Arp complex in the SAL-PT and maintain the stability of one another. This complex interacts with the PT protein CAPZA3, which subsequently binds and stabilizes PLCζ. Additionally, the Arp complex interacts with DPY19L2/FAM209-associated proteins to mediate acrosome anchoring to the nuclear envelope. Therefore, these findings established a sequential DPY19L2/FAM209-associated protein–Arp complex–CAPZA3 scaffold extending from the nuclear envelope to the acrosome that is indispensable for fertilization. Collectively, we defined a previously unidentified structural and molecular framework for fertilization and provided insights into the diagnosis and treatment of fertilization failure.

title: Dynamic virulence decomposition disentangles host and pathogen contributions over the course of infection
summary_zh: 研究开发动态致病力分解框架，量化宿主和病原体在感染过程中的贡献。
summary_en: The study develops a dynamic virulence decomposition framework to quantify host and pathogen contributions throughout the course of infection.
insights: 创新点：开发动态致病力分解框架
方法亮点：结合疾病空间分析
关键发现：量化感染过程中的贡献变化
insights_en: Novelty: Development of a dynamic virulence decomposition framework
Method highlight: Integration of disease space analysis
Key finding: Quantification of changing contributions throughout infection
abstract: Decomposing virulence into host and pathogen effects is key to understanding how virulence is generated during infection, and how host and pathogen contributions evolve over time. Conventional virulence decomposition is, however, not designed to quantify how these contributions vary throughout an infection. Building on conventional virulence decomposition, we developed a dynamic framework that integrates disease space analysis to quantify these changing contributions. We applied this framework to existing data from house finches ( Haemorhous mexicanus ) experimentally infected with the emerging bacterial pathogen, Mycoplasma gallisepticum , examining two biologically meaningful infection phases: an early phase dominated by innate immune responses and a later phase in which the adaptive immune response is fully activated. Our analyses revealed that virulence components evolved differently across infection phases, with pathogen exploitation, per-parasite-pathogenicity (PPP), and host resistance each exhibiting distinct trajectories. These findings corroborated several known evolutionary patterns, while also revealing the evolution of increased PPP in this system. In contrast, the apparent evolution of host tolerance inferred from aggregated peak measurements was not supported by phase-specific analyses, demonstrating that aggregated and phase-specific measures can provide different mechanistic insights into virulence. By linking conventional virulence decomposition with disease space analysis, our dynamic virulence decomposition framework provides a general approach for quantifying how host and pathogen processes shape virulence over the course of infection.

title: Codfishes survived essential gene loss by functionally co-opting freshwater ovulatory pathways to marine egg hydration
summary_zh: 研究显示，鳕鱼通过功能性地利用淡水排卵途径来适应海洋卵的保湿。
summary_en: The study shows that codfishes have survived essential gene loss by functionally co-opting freshwater ovulatory pathways for marine egg hydration.
insights: 创新点：发现鳕鱼适应海洋环境的机制
方法亮点：研究aqp1ab基因的丢失
关键发现：利用淡水排卵途径保湿
insights_en: Novelty: Discovery of the mechanism of codfish adaptation to marine environments
Method highlight: Study of the loss of aqp1ab genes
Key finding: Utilization of freshwater ovulatory pathways for egg hydration
abstract: Adaptive evolution associated with dispensable gene loss is widespread in the animal kingdom. However, loss of genes essential for embryonic survival and the mechanisms that evolved to bypass negative selection and extinction are less well known. Here, we show that all Gadiformes, an ecologically dominant order of codfishes, lost the aqp1ab -type genes that are essential for the formation of hydrated pelagic eggs and embryonic survival of marine teleosts in oceanic environments. Despite such gene loss, codfishes produce some of the most highly hydrated pelagic eggs of all marine teleosts. To resolve this apparent paradox, we initially confirmed that the mechanisms of osmotic drive are conserved with other pelagic-egg-producing marine teleosts, and then conducted comparative transcript analyses of aquaporin water channels in distantly-related freshwater and marine teleosts. This uncovered Aqp4-type channels that have been chromosomally linked to the Aqp1-type channels in jawed vertebrate genomes for >450 million years as the primary candidates. Using immunolocalization, functional assays, and inhibition experiments with zebrafish and Atlantic cod as model organisms, we show that short isoforms of Aqp4 are required for egg ovulation in more ancestral lineages of freshwater teleosts and were recruited to the oocyte hydration pathway of codfishes. By contrast, the oldest and most modern lineages of marine teleosts producing pelagic eggs still utilize the aqp1ab genes for egg hydration. Our data thus reveal that codfishes survived essential gene loss by functionally co-opting freshwater ovulatory pathways to marine egg hydration.

title: Lead impairs long-term memory by disrupting mitochondrial redox homeostasis in Drosophila
summary_zh: 研究揭示铅暴露通过破坏果蝇线粒体氧化还原稳态来损害长期记忆。
summary_en: The study reveals that lead exposure impairs long-term memory by disrupting mitochondrial redox homeostasis in Drosophila.
insights: 创新点：发现铅暴露损害长期记忆的机制
方法亮点：使用线粒体靶向氧化还原生物传感器
关键发现：铅破坏线粒体氧化还原稳态
insights_en: Novelty: Discovery of the mechanism by which lead exposure impairs long-term memory
Method highlight: Use of a mitochondria-targeted redox biosensor
Key finding: Lead disrupts mitochondrial redox homeostasis
abstract: Lead (Pb) exposure remains a major environmental risk factor for cognitive dysfunction, yet the cellular mechanisms underlying Pb-induced memory impairment are poorly understood. Here, we show that both developmental and adult-onset Pb exposure selectively disrupts protein-synthesis-dependent long-term memory (LTM) in Drosophila melanogaster while sparing other memory forms. Using a mitochondria-targeted redox biosensor (mito-roGFP2-Orp1), we found that Pb elevates mitochondrial oxidative stress and disrupts redox homeostasis in cholinergic neurons and in dorsal-anterior-lateral (DAL) neurons, a critical locus for LTM consolidation. Pb-induced redox imbalance suppresses training-induced de novo protein synthesis in DAL neurons, thereby impairing memory consolidation. Antioxidant treatment with epigallocatechin gallate restores mitochondrial redox balance and rescues LTM by reinstating activity-dependent protein synthesis in DAL neurons. These findings identify mitochondrial redox dysregulation as a key mechanism linking environmental Pb exposure to impaired memory consolidation. Our results further establish a genetically tractable platform for dissecting neurotoxic mechanisms and for evaluating antioxidant-based strategies to mitigate Pb-induced cognitive dysfunction.

title: QnAs with Alison Gopnik
Patterns of implicit and explicit attitudes V: Increases in bias from 2021 to 2025
summary_zh: 研究显示，2021至2025年间，偏见程度有所增加。
summary_en: The study shows that there has been an increase in bias from 2021 to 2025.
insights: 创新点：发现偏见程度的增加趋势
方法亮点：分析大量数据
关键发现：偏见在多个领域增加
insights_en: Novelty: Discovery of the increasing trend in bias
Method highlight: Analysis of large-scale data
Key finding: Bias increased in multiple domains
abstract: Between 2007 and 2020, implicit and explicit intergroup attitudes declined in bias steadily and were forecasted to continue toward attitude neutrality. But, since 2020, 5 y of new data (2021–2025) from 2.8 million U.S. respondents reveal that past trends have stalled or, in some cases, even reversed. The largest reversals in bias emerged for sexuality, transgender, race, and skin-tone bias which increased by 12 to 22% on implicit measures and by 24% to more than tripling on explicit measures. Age, disability, and body weight bias also increased, but at relatively slower rates. Breakpoint analyses showed that implicit attitudes were early indicators of change, reversing trend ~1 y earlier than explicit reports. For most topics, reversals were widespread across demographic groups and even extended to an international sample of 274,884 non-U.S. respondents. However, younger respondents (<20-y-old)—who had previously shown the largest decreases in bias—now showed the largest increases in bias; these trends also interacted with politics and gender (e.g., young conservative men were the most likely to increase). Exploratory analyses ruled out various single-cause explanations. Instead, we suggest that the best explanation is that 2020–2021 marked a turning point in the sociopolitical climate, whereby co-occurring existential threats from the COVID-19 pandemic, amplified economic insecurity, political sectarianism, and online toxicity prompted increases in intergroup bias. These data underscore how large populations of individual-level attitudes are continually shaped and altered by macro, societal-level events.

title: Multifunctional multiphysics metamaterials via decomposition-based multiobjective optimization design
summary_zh: 研究提出分解式多目标优化设计框架，解决多功能多物理场超材料设计难题。方法上，采用动态归一化探索Pareto前沿。结果表明，优化设计有效实现功能优先级选择。
summary_en: This study proposes a decomposition-based multiobjective optimization framework to address the challenges in designing multifunctional multiphysics metamaterials. The method employs dynamic normalization to uniformly explore the Pareto front. Results show that the optimized design effectively achieves the selection of functional priorities.
insights: 创新点：分解式多目标优化设计框架
方法亮点：动态归一化探索Pareto前沿
关键发现：优化设计实现功能优先级选择
insights_en: Novelty: Decomposition-based multiobjective optimization design framework
Method highlight: Dynamic normalization to explore the Pareto front
Key finding: Optimized design achieves functional priority selection
abstract: Metamaterials offer unprecedented control over physical fields through their microstructure, but current design methods cannot meet the demands of scenarios involving active sources, multiphysics field coupling, and multifunctional requirements. Moreover, existing approaches are generally developed for specific functions, making it difficult to integrate different functionalities and select the functional priorities within a single structure. To overcome these limitations, this study presents a systematic inverse design framework for multifunctional multiphysics metamaterials via multiobjective optimization. To uniformly explore the Pareto front, which clearly exhibits trade-offs among functionalities and facilitates the selection of functional priorities, we employ dynamic normalization into the decomposition-based multiobjective evolutionary algorithm. A robust anisotropic unit-cell database is constructed and used for generating metamaterials with optimized microstructures for multifunctionality. Three complex cases are studied that can simultaneously achieve mechanical cloaking plus stress minimization, thermal cloaking plus stress minimization, and direct current cloaking plus thermal stress minimization. Furthermore, the proposed framework is employed in potential engineering problems, for example, to realize mechanical cloaking by embedding functional components in structural materials, while minimizing the surrounding stress on functional components for mechanical protection when the assembled structures are compressed, thereby decoupling the interaction between functional and structural components. This systematic framework expands the capabilities of metamaterials in complex multiphysics coupling, offering a robust blueprint for future intelligent, structurally and functionally integrated systems.

title: Profile of Françoise Combes
summary_zh: 介绍天文学家Françoise Combes的生平和成就，包括其在星系形成、演化和暗物质研究方面的贡献。
summary_en: This profile introduces the life and achievements of astrophysicist Françoise Combes, including her contributions to the study of galaxy formation, evolution, and dark matter.
insights: 创新点：探索暗物质替代方案
方法亮点：导师指导下的学术成长
关键发现：在星系动力学和暗物质研究中的杰出贡献
insights_en: Novelty: Exploring alternatives to dark matter
Method highlight: Academic growth under mentorship
Key finding: Distinguished contributions in galaxy dynamics and dark matter research
abstract: Françoise Combes’s childhood curiosity motivated her to pursue a career in science. Her studies in physics at the École Normale Supérieure in Paris eventually led her to focus on astrophysics. With help from mentors, such as astrophysicists Evry Schatzman and Pierre Encrenaz, Combes has had a distinguished career in astrophysics. She is renowned for her work studying the formation and evolution of galaxies and their dynamics and her research on dark matter. In her Inaugural Article, she describes her latest work exploring alternatives to dark matter.

title: Progressive shifts in soil respiration response to long-term nitrogen enrichment across global forests and grasslands
summary_zh: 研究全球森林和草地土壤呼吸对长期氮富集的响应，发现响应从短期增加转为长期抑制。
summary_en: This study investigates the response of soil respiration to long-term nitrogen enrichment across global forests and grasslands, finding a shift from transient increase to sustained suppression over time.
insights: 创新点：全球尺度土壤呼吸响应研究
方法亮点：长期实验数据集分析
关键发现：土壤呼吸响应的非线性轨迹
insights_en: Novelty: Global-scale soil respiration response study
Method highlight: Analysis of long-term experimental datasets
Key finding: Nonlinear trajectories of soil respiration response
abstract: Soil stores the largest pool of actively cycling carbon (C) on land, and its dynamics under global changes are critical for projecting climate feedbacks. Global nitrogen (N) deposition has more than doubled since the 1860s; however, the temporal dynamics of soil C emissions under prolonged N deposition are poorly understood. Here, using a global time-series dataset compiled from 38 long-term experiments in forests and grasslands, we find that the response of soil respiration (Rs) to N addition systematically shifts from a transient increase persisting for approximately 2 y to a sustained suppression over time (mean effect = −6%; 95% CI = [−10%, −3%]). Rs in forests and grasslands followed consistent nonlinear trajectories, characterized by a rapid initial decline in the magnitude of the response, which progressively leveled off. Notably, suppression of Rs emerged when cumulative N inputs exceeded a threshold of ~100 kg N ha −1 . Consequently, the suppression was both stronger and occurred more rapidly under high-level N additions (>50 kg N ha −1 y −1 ). These temporal dynamics were associated with N-induced soil acidification and related changes in microbial properties. Overall, these findings indicate that accurate prediction of land–atmosphere C fluxes under global change requires models to capture the reported temporal dynamics.

title: Municipal sludge disposal emerges as a major, hidden, and rapidly growing atmospheric mercury source
summary_zh: 研究指出，城市污泥处理成为大气汞的重要来源，排放量巨大，需纳入环境评估。
summary_en: This study identifies municipal sludge disposal as a significant and rapidly growing atmospheric mercury source, with substantial emissions, necessitating inclusion in environmental assessments.
insights: 创新点：污泥处理与大气汞排放关联研究
方法亮点：中国污泥处理排放数据分析
关键发现：跨媒体污染转移问题
insights_en: Novelty: Linkage study between sludge disposal and atmospheric mercury emissions
Method highlight: Analysis of Chinese sludge disposal emission data
Key finding: Cross-media pollution transfer issue
abstract: Wastewater treatment greatly reduces mercury pollution in aquatic ecosystems but does not eliminate it. Here, we identify municipal sludge disposal as a major, long-overlooked atmospheric mercury source. In China, sludge disposal emitted 42 - 10 + 18 Mg in 2024, exceeding 10% of national anthropogenic emissions and ranking third after cement production and nonferrous metal smelting. These emissions have increased by nearly a thousandfold since the 1970s and are concentrated in densely populated urban areas, driven by the rapid expansion of sludge incineration, codisposal, and composting. Our findings reveal a cross-media pollution transfer embedded in sustainability transitions and call for sludge disposal to be incorporated into UNEP mercury budget and Minamata Convention assessments.

title: USP46 restrains K63-linked polyubiquitination–dependent aggregation and activation of the NLRP3 inflammasome in lupus nephritis
summary_zh: 研究揭示USP46蛋白在狼疮性肾炎中通过限制K63连接多泛素化抑制NLRP3炎症小体聚集和激活。
summary_en: This study reveals that USP46 protein inhibits the aggregation and activation of the NLRP3 inflammasome in lupus nephritis by restricting K63-linked polyubiquitination.
insights: 创新点：USP46蛋白在NLRP3炎症小体中的作用
方法亮点：NLRP3聚集和激活的调控机制研究
关键发现：USP46限制K63连接多泛素化
insights_en: Novelty: Role of USP46 protein in NLRP3 inflammasome
Method highlight: Study on the regulatory mechanisms of NLRP3 aggregation and activation
Key finding: USP46 restricts K63-linked polyubiquitination
abstract: The activation of the NLRP3 inflammasome necessitates its aggregation within the dispersed trans-Golgi network (dTGN) and subsequent transport from the dTGN to the microtubule organizing center (MTOC), a process facilitated by HDAC6. However, the regulatory mechanisms governing the formation of NLRP3 aggregates remain insufficiently understood. In this study, we demonstrate that proteasome impairment induces polyubiquitination and aggregation of NLRP3 at the MTOC. We demonstrate ubiquitin-specific protease 46 (USP46) as a key factor that recognizes NLRP3 as a substrate and restricts nondegradative K63-linked polyubiquitination at lysine residue K930, thereby preventing excessive aggregation, transport to the MTOC, and inflammasome activation. Furthermore, myeloid-specific knockout of USP46 exacerbates renal injury and inflammation in both lipopolysaccharide-induced-induced endotoxic shock and pristane-induced lupus nephritis models. Our findings provide insights into the regulatory mechanisms underlying the aggresomal activation of the NLRP3 inflammasome.

title: A tetravalent bispecific protein enables targeted degradation of VCAM-1 and VEGFR for treatment of choroidal neovascularization
summary_zh: 研究开发了一种四价双特异性蛋白RHV，用于治疗脉络膜新生血管。
summary_en: This study develops a tetravalent bispecific protein, RHV, for the targeted degradation of VCAM-1 and VEGFR in the treatment of choroidal neovascularization.
insights: 创新点：四价双特异性蛋白RHV的开发
方法亮点：结合VCAM-1和VEGFR的靶向降解
关键发现：治疗脉络膜新生血管的新策略
insights_en: Novelty: Development of the tetravalent bispecific protein RHV
Method highlight: Targeted degradation of VCAM-1 and VEGFR
Key finding: New strategy for treating choroidal neovascularization
abstract: Wet age-related macular degeneration (AMD), a leading cause of irreversible vision loss, is driven by pathological choroidal neovascularization (CNV). Although anti-vascular endothelial growth factor (anti-VEGF) therapies remain the clinical standard, their utility is constrained by incomplete responses in nearly 50% of patients and off-target risks—such as geographic atrophy—stemming from non-specific VEGF blockade. Here, we identify a robust correlation between vascular cell adhesion molecule-1 (VCAM-1) and VEGF/VEGF receptor (VEGFR) expression in aqueous humor from AMD patients and in murine CNV models. Thus, we engineered a tetravalent bispecific protein, RHV, by functionalizing an L-rhamnulose-1-phosphate aldolase scaffold with peptides that selectively bind VCAM-1 and the VEGFR on neovessels. The tetravalent design confers high apparent affinity, enhancing pathological endothelial targeting while sparing healthy retinal vasculature. RHV induces concurrent internalization and lysosomal degradation of both VCAM-1 and VEGFR via a head-to-tail binding mode, leading to sustained inhibition of the VEGF/VEGFR, PI3K/AKT and Apelin/APJ signaling pathways. In murine CNV models, a single intravitreal injection of RHV exhibits superior ocular retention and lesion penetration, achieving therapeutic efficacy comparable to aflibercept [a ligand-trap fusion protein for VEGF-A, VEGF-B and placental growth factor (PIGF)] at one-quarter of the molar dose. This dual-receptor degradation-based strategy represents a targeted and durable approach for treating ocular neovascularization.

title: Entropic tightening of knots in granular chains under vibration
summary_zh: 研究振动下颗粒链中结的熵紧缩现象，解释了结自发紧缩的动力学。
summary_en: This study investigates the entropic tightening of knots in granular chains under vibration, explaining the dynamics of spontaneous knot tightening.
insights: 创新点：颗粒链中结的熵紧缩研究
方法亮点：颗粒链振动实验观察
关键发现：结紧缩的动力学机制
insights_en: Novelty: Study on entropic tightening of knots in granular chains
Method highlight: Granular chain vibration experiment observation
Key finding: Dynamics mechanism of knot tightening
abstract: Knots are common in long chains, from DNA and proteins to everyday strings, yet direct observation of knot dynamics is difficult. Using granular chains on vibrating platforms, we directly visualize knot dynamics and find that knot cores spontaneously tighten, a behavior observed across different knot types. We quantitatively explain spontaneous knot tightening using knot-tube theory: segments confined within the knot core experience entropic loss and tend to escape the core to gain conformational entropy. Although driven granular chains are not in thermodynamic equilibrium, their steady-state knot-size statistics are approximately captured by equilibrium statistical mechanics and Monte Carlo simulations. Analyses of state-transition probabilities and time-reversal asymmetry suggest a weak violation of detailed balance when the granular dynamics are projected onto the knot-size coordinate. Finally, we discuss the possible relevance of knot tightening to topoisomerase-mediated DNA unknotting.

title: Digital readiness for cardiovascular care in high-burden US communities with cardiology workforce constraints
Opposing microbiome-mediated axes link modifiable lifestyles to health and chronic diseases
summary_zh: 分析肠道微生物组在生活方式与健康状况之间的联系。识别两种相互对立的微生物组轴。
summary_en: An analysis of the gut microbiome's role in linking lifestyle factors to health outcomes identifies two opposing microbiome-mediated axes.
insights: 创新点：分析肠道微生物组与生活方式联系
方法亮点：识别两种对立微生物组轴
关键发现：与健康和慢性病相关
insights_en: Novelty: Analyzing the gut microbiome's link to lifestyle
Method highlight: Identifying two opposing microbiome axes
Key finding: Associated with health and chronic diseases
abstract: Analyses disentangling the role of the gut microbiome in linking lifestyle factors to health outcomes remain limited. Here, using fecal shotgun metagenomics from 6,803 adults in the Japanese 4D cohort, we identified two opposing microbiome-mediated axes linking lifestyle to health and 15 diseases. A health-associated axis enriched in microbial metabolism of dietary components was linked to plant-based, soy and dairy intake. In contrast, a disease-associated axis, enriched in oral-derived bacteria and pathobionts, was linked to refined carbohydrates and sedentary behavior. Starter culture microorganisms used to ferment foods did not show statistically significant mediation of the observed health effects. Alcohol was associated with both health- and disease-oriented mediation patterns involving microbial host-glycan utilization. Microbiome-defined health- and disease-oriented mediator axes were supported by fecal short-chain fatty acids and plasma cytokines from >1,700 individuals, revealing butyrate-associated anti-inflammatory and pro-inflammatory host profiles, respectively. Microbiome-based prediction (MADE) scores captured lifestyle–microbiome–disease mediation patterns and distinguished individual diseases across 13 independent external cohorts from the United States, China, Sweden, Russia and Australia. We identify the gut microbiome as a key mediator linking lifestyle to health and disease, providing a framework for microbiome-based assessment to guide lifestyle interventions for health promotion and disease prevention. Fecal shotgun metagenomics from 6,803 adults in the Japanese 4D cohort and microbiome-based prediction scores validated across 13 independent and geographically diverse cohorts revealed two opposing microbiome-mediated axes linking lifestyle to health and 15 diseases.

title: The Menopause Gap in Medicine
summary_zh: 讨论更年期研究历史和护理差距。探讨医学中的更年期问题。

title: Nonreceipt of Newborn Vitamin K and Risk of Bleeding
summary_zh: 研究新生儿维生素K未接种趋势及出血风险。分析接种与未接种婴儿出血及死亡率差异。发现未接种婴儿出血风险显著增加。

It analyzes the differences in bleeding and mortality rates between infants who received and did not receive newborn intramuscular vitamin K. abstract: Importance Refusal of newborn prophylactic vitamin K has been increasing in the US, placing more infants at risk for vitamin K deficiency bleeding. Objective To describe US trends in nonreceipt of newborn vitamin K and infant bleeding, and to compare risks of bleeding and mortality with concurrent bleeding among infants who did and did not receive newborn intramuscular (IM) vitamin K. Design, Setting, and Participants This retrospective cohort study included infants born at 35 to 43 weeks’ gestation between January 1, 2017, and December 31, 2025, at hospitals and health systems from 50 states contributing to the Epic Cosmos dataset. Exposure Nonreceipt of newborn IM vitamin K. Main Outcomes and Measures The primary outcome was bleeding within the first 6 months of life based on International Statistical Classification of Diseases and Related Health Problems, Tenth Revision codes. Secondary outcomes were bleeding during the birth hospitalization and after discharge, intracranial bleeding, and mortality with concurrent bleeding during the birth hospitalization. Robust Poisson regression was used to estimate relative risks while adjusting for covariates. Results Among 5 240 780 infants, the rate of vitamin K nonreceipt increased from 3.1% in 2017 to 6.8% in 2025. Between 2017 and 2025, the incidence of bleeding by 6 months increased from 225.3 to 394.0 per 10 000 births in infants who did not receive newborn IM vitamin K, compared with 136.6 to 221.8 per 10 000 in infants who received vitamin K. Infants who did not receive vitamin K had significantly higher risk of bleeding by 6 months than infants who did receive vitamin K (288.0 vs 185.9 per 10 000; adjusted risk ratio [ARR], 1.47; 95% CI, 1.43-1.51). They also had higher risk of intracranial bleeding (33.0 vs 13.2 per 10 000; ARR, 2.43; 95% CI, 2.26-2.62) and mortality with concurrent bleeding during the birth hospitalization (2.9 vs 1.1 per 10 000; ARR, 2.69; 95% CI, 2.09-3.47). Conclusions and Relevance Nonreceipt of vitamin K and infant bleeding incidence have increased in the US, and newborns who did not receive vitamin K were at significantly higher risk of bleeding during their first 6 months.

abstract: Abstract Differentiating arginine vasopressin (AVP) deficiency from primary polydipsia is challenging. The most accurate test, hypertonic saline–stimulated copeptin, requires intensive monitoring. Intravenous mannitol stimulates AVP release and may provide a simpler alternative. In a randomized double-blind crossover trial, 22 healthy adults received mannitol and placebo in random order, of whom 21 were included in the primary analysis. In a pilot study, 10 patients with AVP deficiency and 10 with primary polydipsia received mannitol. The primary outcome was copeptin after mannitol infusion. Mannitol resulted in a 2.29-fold higher copeptin at 90 minutes (+6.4 pmol/L (95% CI: +5.2, +7.7; p <0.001)) than after placebo at mean baseline copeptin levels in healthy adults. In patients, copeptin after 30 minutes was 11.7 pmol/L (95% CI: 6.5, 17.0) higher in primary polydipsia than in AVP deficiency. Mannitol infusion shows promise as a new diagnostic approach. Larger confirmatory studies are required to validate both the optimal diagnostic cut-off and patient safety. Trial Registration number: NCT06542198 .

title: Resident cardiac macrophage-like cells induced by an ILC2 cytokine cocktail confer cardioprotection through enhanced efferocytosis in a mouse model of myocardial infarction

summary_en: This study demonstrates that resident cardiac macrophage-like cells induced by an ILC2 cytokine cocktail confer cardioprotection through enhanced phagocytosis in a mouse model of myocardial infarction.

abstract: Resident cardiac macrophages (RCM) are essential for myocardial repair following acute myocardial infarction (AMI); however, their therapeutic application is hindered by limited availability. Here, we show that RCM transplantation from healthy mice markedly attenuates cardiac injury in mice. Importantly, we identify a pro-reparative CD301b⁺ RCM population profoundly depleted after AMI and show that adoptive transfer of this subset alone mitigates cardiac injury following myocardial infarction. To overcome the scarcity of native RCMs and favour their replenishment, we expand ex vivo a CD301b+ macrophage-like population (RCML) by polarizing bone marrow-derived macrophages with an ILC2-derived cytokine cocktail, and show that RCML transplantation confers robust post-AMI cardioprotection. Mechanistically, CD301b promotes efferocytosis by enhancing TFEB-mediated lysosomal function via a GATM-AMPK-mTOR axis, a pathway conserved in human macrophages. Thus, our findings identify a key pro-reparative macrophage subset and establish a feasible cell-based strategy for cardiac repair. Resident cardiac macrophages (RCM) contribute to cardiac repair after myocardial infarction (MI); however, their number is reduced upon injury. Here, the authors identify a population of efferocytosing CD301b+ macrophages that promote post-ischemic cardiac repair and develop an ex vivo protocol to generate RCM-like cells induced with enhanced efferocytic potential for post-MI cardioprotection.

abstract: Molecules that modulate protein-protein interactions, including through ternary complex formation, have been established as key therapeutics. Yet they can be challenging to discover, as standard screening approaches often lack throughput or fail to directly assay multibody interactions. We addressed this by combining DNA nanoswitch–based selection of nucleotide-encoded libraries with next-generation sequencing to create FIND (Functional Interaction–based Nanoswitch Discovery), which enables ultrahigh-throughput discovery of compounds that induce or increase protein-protein interactions. We demonstrate FIND by discovering nanobodies that stabilize the interaction between angiotensin-converting enzyme 2 and the receptor-binding domain of severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 and by discovering agonists of peroxisome proliferator–activated receptor gamma from a DNA-barcoded small-molecule library. By enabling rapid discovery of molecular modulators, FIND could lead to new therapeutics across many conditions.

abstract: Adipose tissue undergoes extensive remodeling to adapt to changing physiological demands. This plasticity encompasses changes in adipocyte metabolism and number, extracellular matrix organization, vascularization, immune composition, and innervation. When coordinated, these processes preserve energy buffering, thermogenesis, endocrine function, and local tissue support. Pathological adipose tissue remodeling drives obesity-related complications and contributes to many diseases involving organ-associated adipose depots throughout the body. In cancer, tumor-associated fat can develop a metabolic and fibroinflammatory niche that promotes tumor growth and invasion, and remodeling of other depots can directly disrupt neighboring tissues. Recent studies have identified mesenchymal, immune, vascular, and adipocyte states that govern adaptive or pathological outcomes. These findings broaden therapeutic goals beyond reducing fat mass toward restoring adipogenesis, substrate turnover, thermogenic capacity, and tissue-niche function.

abstract: Ultracold atom platforms enable low temperatures and long free evolution times, which are crucial for fundamental physics tests and atom interferometry. The lowest equivalent temperature reported in such a system is 38 pK with a free expansion time of 2 s, achieved in atom-chip-based magnetic traps in microgravity. Optical dipole trap (ODT) systems offer better optical access and the flexibility to condense both magnetic and non-magnetic atoms, but have not been used to prepare quantum degenerate gases under microgravity conditions. Here we report an ODT-based Bose-Einstein condensate created aboard the China Space Station, containing 2.0 × 10 4 atoms, reaching an equivalent temperature of 9.7 − 2.7 + 3.2 pK with a free expansion time of 7.0 s. This record-low temperature could stimulate a new generation of ODT-based experiments in quantum simulation and precision measurements in space.

abstract: Anthropogenic noise is a rapidly expanding global pollutant, but its effects across biological levels from individuals to ecosystems remain unquantified. We conducted phylogenetically controlled meta-analyses of 214 experimental studies on 177 aquatic and terrestrial species with ranges that span six continents. Noise altered at least one physiological, developmental, or behavioral trait in 80% of species studied, with declines in fitness and abundance and disruptions of predator-prey interactions. Effects occurred in every habitat, although response mechanisms varied for some traits and species, creating winners and losers. Only multispecies analyses can reveal such species- and ecosystem-level impacts of anthropogenic stressors. Our results establish noise as a novel selection pressure reshaping ecosystem dynamics and as a pervasive stressor requiring soundscape protection alongside habitat conservation.

abstract: As the use of generative and agentic artificial intelligence (AI) increases, alarms are being raised about how the technology could replace human contribution, override human supervision, ignore ethical and technical guardrails, and cause increasingly irreparable harm to the environment. This creates potentially destructive outcomes for life on Earth. From a traditional Indigenous science perspective, such possibilities in themselves would be enough to immediately stop presently configured AI releases. In a Lakota context, science must ensure as little harm as possible is done to life. Therefore, AI as presently configured simply would not qualify to advance further from an ethical and scientific standpoint. Indigenous science asks something fundamentally different than what AI presently seeks to, or can, answer. But that does not mean that future forms of AI can never align with Indigenous science.

abstract: Pharmacotherapies for obesity and type 2 diabetes are increasingly being evaluated for their effects on cognition and brain health. Evidence from preclinical models, observational cohorts, and clinical trials has intensified interest, but findings remain mixed. A central challenge is to determine whether potential cognitive effects arise from direct actions on neural circuits, indirect consequences of improved cardiometabolic health, or both. This Review examines the evidence across cardiometabolic disease, aging, and Alzheimer’s disease, focusing on glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1)–based therapies and combination approaches that engage glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide, glucagon, and amylin pathways. We assess how receptor pharmacology, brain exposure, metabolic context, and disease stage shape cognitive outcomes and discuss how mechanistic clarity could guide therapies aimed at preserving or improving cognition.

abstract: Cannabis is the world’s most-used illicit psychoactive plant, yet direct prehistoric evidence for its consumption is rare. In this study, we present the earliest direct evidence of cannabis use: offerings of plant parts and chemical compounds in ancient human hair recovered from a monumental tomb in Siberia. The findings suggest that the plant was used for its psychoactive qualities across Eurasia, where specific wild populations might have had naturally higher active compound levels. We show that the practice of cannabis consumption dates back at least 2800 years, anchoring debates around contemporary usage and informing discussions on cannabis in medicine, public health, law, and industry.

abstract: Excessive androgens serve as a primary driver for many phenotypic features of polyendocrine metabolic ovarian syndrome (PMOS). Although dietary fiber has been shown to alleviate PMOS, its effects on androgen concentrations and the underlying mechanisms remain unclear. In a clinical trial, we demonstrated that a dietary fiber combination consisting of inulin, resistant starch, and β-glucan reduces androgen concentrations in patients’ plasma. Mechanistically, dietary fiber increased the abundance of Bacteroides xylanisolven s, which converts androstenedione into a nonandrogenic secondary hormone metabolite we named coproandrosterone, which is further metabolized by gut microbiota into dihydro-coproandrosterone. This metabolic pathway was validated in a mouse model. These findings highlight the potential of dietary fiber to alleviate PMOS by modulating androgen homeostasis through gut microbiota, offering insights for prebiotic and probiotic therapies.

abstract: Obesity is now widely recognized as a chronic progressive condition. The altered biological mechanisms that cause obesity frequently require long-term treatment, including pharmacotherapies or bariatric surgery. In recent decades, the pathophysiology of obesity has been understood to an extent that obesity management medication (OMM) discovery could be rationally pursued. Advances in defining the regulation of food intake and energy expenditure by molecular communication from peripheral organs to the brain led to the development of OMMs that appear capable of safely achieving scalable and sustained body weight loss. However, side effects, heterogeneous treatment responses, long-term metabolic adaptations, adherence, and other factors may limit the use of existing OMMs and justify the development of additional medications to improve the health of people living with obesity.

abstract: Elastocaloric cooling (eC) uses shape memory alloys (SMAs) as energy-efficient, eco-friendly refrigerants. However, cost-effectively fabricating SMAs into fatigue-resistant, heat transfer–enhanced structures remains a key obstacle to commercialization of the eC technology. We introduce a “stamping and stacking” (S-S) method for producing porous, fatigue-resistant SMA structures. Honeycomb-like chips are stamped from nitinol (NiTi) thin sheets and then stacked into a layered tubular structure to increase heat exchange surface and at the same time avoid buckling and splitting failures encountered in existing SMA structures. The stacked structure endures >10 8 compression cycles and can deliver high specific cooling power of 3850 watts per kilogram. Our S-S method reduces fabrication costs by one order of magnitude compared with existing approaches, enabling mass production of eC refrigerant structures for commercial deployment.

title: Glacial abrupt transitions in ocean circulation were much slower than ice-core records imply
summary_zh: 冰川海洋环流突变远慢于冰芯记录。亚洲季风区洞穴石笋记录揭示缓慢变化。

方法亮点：精确定年技术

Method highlight: Precise dating techniques
Key finding: Ice-core records do not fully reflect the speed of change
abstract: Dansgaard-Oeschger (DO) events during the last ice age are thought to reflect rapid shifts in the Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation (AMOC). Greenland ice cores suggest warming transitions within only a few decades—or even just over 10 years. Using precisely dated speleothem oxygen-isotope records from the Asian monsoon region, we have shown that the same DO warmings unfolded over more than a century. Isotope modeling revealed that Greenland records primarily capture a rapid atmospheric reorganization triggered by the initial sea-ice retreat in the northeastern North Atlantic, whereas the parallel AMOC recovery and hemispheric thermal adjustment proceeded much more slowly. These findings reveal that natural AMOC transitions evolved more slowly than the rapid North Greenland oxygen-isotope shifts would imply, thereby refining our understanding of “abruptness” during DO events.

title: Tumor metastasis co-opts liver hematopoiesis to promote immunosuppression
summary_zh: 研究揭示肿瘤转移利用肝脏造血促进免疫抑制。方法上，通过识别肝转移相关造血干细胞。实验表明，肝转移建立异位门脉造血微环境。
summary_en: This study reveals that tumor metastasis co-opts liver hematopoiesis to promote immunosuppression. The method involves identifying liver metastasis-associated hematopoietic stem cells. Experiments show that liver metastases establish ectopic periportal hematopoietic niches.
insights: 创新点：发现肝转移相关造血干细胞的新功能
方法亮点：利用DIRAC模型进行多组学数据整合
关键发现：肝转移促进免疫抑制
insights_en: Novelty: Discovery of a new function of liver metastasis-associated hematopoietic stem cells
Method highlight: Utilization of DIRAC model for multi-omic data integration
Key finding: Liver metastasis promotes immunosuppression
abstract: Cancer-associated hematopoietic abnormalities contribute to systemic immunosuppression. However, whether tumors can initiate localized extramedullary hematopoiesis to suppress antitumor immunity remains unclear. In this study, we identify a distinct form of hepatic hematopoiesis driven by liver metastasis–associated hematopoietic stem cells (LM-HSCs). Liver metastases establish ectopic periportal hematopoietic niches that recruit bone marrow HSCs through Kupffer cell–dependent C-C motif chemokine receptor 1 (CCR1) signaling. Although LM-HSCs retain self-renewal and multipotency, cAMP response element–binding protein (CREB) activation skews their differentiation toward the myeloid lineage, particularly annexin A1–positive (ANXA1 + ) immature neutrophils. These neutrophils produce glucocorticoids, which activate glucocorticoid receptor signaling in a paracrine manner and induce immune checkpoint receptor expression and functional anergy in CD8 + T and natural killer cells. Collectively, these findings suggest that liver metastases reprograms hepatic hematopoiesis to promote immunosuppression.

title: Integration and annotation of spatial multi-omic data with DIRAC
summary_zh: 研究展示DIRAC模型在多组学数据整合中的应用。方法上，DIRAC模型统一了不同任务。实验表明，DIRAC提高了细胞类型注释的准确性。

insights: 创新点：DIRAC模型在多组学数据整合中的应用
方法亮点：DIRAC模型统一了不同任务
关键发现：DIRAC提高了细胞类型注释的准确性

Method highlight: Unification of different tasks by DIRAC model
Key finding: Improved accuracy of cell-type annotation by DIRAC
abstract: Spatial multi-omic technologies measure multiple molecular layers within intact tissues. Two central challenges are vertical integration, which combines different molecular modalities, and horizontal integration, which aligns cell types across studies. Here we show domain invariant representation through adaptive calibration (DIRAC), a geometric deep learning model that unifies these tasks in a generalized domain adaptation framework. DIRAC learns task-discriminative features that are insensitive to domain shifts caused by batch effects, omic modalities or study sites, enabling a shared embedding space and automated cell-type annotation through label transfer from reference datasets. Across sequencing-based and imaging-based datasets, DIRAC identified a new microvascular proliferation domain in glioblastoma, corrected cortical-layer annotations in severe Alzheimer’s disease, resolved subtle structures in mouse embryos and remained robust to missing data and unseen cell types. We generated mouse spleen and thymus Stereo-CITE-seq data and used DIRAC to reveal thymic T cell migration and splenic immune cell interactions. DIRAC is fast and scales to millions of cells. DIRAC is a geometric deep learning model that enables both vertical and horizontal integration and annotation of spatial multi-omic data.

title: Biological foundation models
Unlocking spatial diversity of circular RNAs with abcFISH
Making AI approachable, one byte at a time
DIRAC makes complex spatial multi-omic data simpler to analyze
Normalized Raman imaging for studies of tissue physiology of the kidney
summary_zh: 研究提出NoRI技术用于肾脏组织生理学研究。方法上，NoRI技术进行定量、无标记测量。实验表明，NoRI准确分类肾小管类型。
summary_en: This study proposes the NoRI technique for the study of kidney tissue physiology. The method involves quantitative, label-free measurements with NoRI. Experiments show that NoRI accurately classifies tubule types.
insights: 创新点：NoRI技术在肾脏组织生理学中的应用
方法亮点：NoRI技术的定量、无标记测量能力

insights_en: Novelty: Application of NoRI technique in kidney tissue physiology
Method highlight: Quantitative, label-free measurement capability of NoRI
Key finding: Accurate classification of tubule types by NoRI
abstract: Abstract Conventional histological relies on fixation, embedding, sectioning, and staining methods that distort cellular architecture, extract lipids, and introduces variability, limiting reproducibility. We present Normalized Stimulated Raman Imaging (NoRI) that enables quantitative, label-free protein and lipid measurements at high-spatial resolution. NoRI computationally corrects protein, lipid, and water Raman signals, allowing quantitative biomass measurements while preserving tissue architecture, facilitating analysis by convolutional neural networks. Applied to mouse kidney, NoRI accurately classified tubule types (F1-[harmonic mean of precision and recall against manual annotation]=0.93), anatomical regions (F1=0.91), and biological sex (F1=0.97), revealing greater cytoplasmic lipid (+6.9mg/mL; p=0.028) and nuclear protein (+26.3mg/mL; p<0.001) in female tubules. In acute kidney injury, NoRI captured dynamic lipid and protein organization and quantified brush border remodelling and lipid droplet changes over 25 days. Spatial lipid quantification was central for feature classification in AKI (F1=1.0). These results establish NoRI as a reproducible, quantitative method for diagnostics, histopathology, and feature discovery.

title: In-group neural alignment serves as a biomarker of social identity
summary_zh: 研究探讨群体内神经同步性。比较宗教与世俗群体。发现神经同步性与理解相关。
summary_en: This study investigates in-group neural alignment. Compares religious and secular groups. Finds neural alignment relates to understanding.
insights: 创新点：神经同步性作为社会身份生物标志物
方法亮点：使用fMRI研究群体内神经同步性
关键发现：神经同步性与理解相关联
insights_en: Novelty: Neural alignment as a biomarker of social identity
Method highlight: Using fMRI to study in-group neural synchronization
Key finding: Neural alignment is associated with understanding
abstract: Abstract Existing research has found that shared neural responses to naturalistic narratives are associated with shared understanding, especially among members of the same social group. In this fMRI study, we tested whether in-group neural synchronization solely reflects explicit shared understandings, or relates to other group characteristics. To do so, we compared the neural synchronization patterns among two distinct social groups: Religious ( N = 21) and Secular ( N = 21). Participants were scanned while watching short video clips containing religious or neutral content and then answered questions regarding their reactions to- and interpretation of the videos. Behavioral results did not reveal group differences in responses’ homogeneity: neither in the engagement and agreement while watching the videos, nor in the emotions and verbal reactions elicited by it. However, neuroimaging results revealed that religious participants exhibited strikingly higher in-group synchronization than secular, both for religious and neutral narratives. Remarkably, it was possible to predict individuals’ religious affiliation solely based on their in-group neural synchrony, with accuracy scores of up to 92%. This pattern was consistent across all neural networks, most prominently in the Default Mode Network (DMN), Control and Attention networks. It also emerged in the Salience network and Somatomotor regions, hinting at neural processes that may foster group cohesion and identification. We propose that increased neural synchrony in the Religious group was driven mainly by greater homogenous social structure, suggesting a novel perspective for interpreting the role of neural synchrony in group dynamics.

Method highlight: Mathematical framework for analyzing data feature loss
