abstract: t-distributed Stochastic Neighborhood Embedding (t-SNE) has gained popularity as a dimension reduction technique, especially for visualizing data. It is well-known that dimension reduction may lose important data features. We provide a mathematical framework for understanding this loss for t-SNE, establishing several quantitative results across different scenarios that demonstrate how important structural information is lost.

title: Trust as a hidden driver of epidemic-relevant behavior: Institution- and behavior-specific associations across 20 national survey waves
summary_zh: 研究信任作为流行病相关行为的隐藏驱动因素。分析20次全国调查数据。发现信任是保护行为的主要预测因素。
summary_en: This study investigates trust as a hidden driver of epidemic-relevant behavior. Analyzes data from 20 national surveys. Finds trust is a dominant predictor of protective behavior.
insights: 创新点：信任作为流行病相关行为的驱动因素
方法亮点：分析20次全国调查数据
关键发现：信任是保护行为的主要预测因素
insights_en: Novelty: Trust as a hidden driver of epidemic-relevant behavior
Method highlight: Analysis of 20 national survey waves
Key finding: Trust is a dominant predictor of protective behavior
abstract: Abstract Compartmental models of infectious disease transmission make assumptions about human behaviors. Specifically, they parameterize interactions across population groups, assumed to have distinct epidemiologically-relevant behavioral patterns, primarily through contact matrices stratified by demographic variables such as age, gender, or socioeconomic status. Although such demographic characteristics are readily measurable, they may inadequately capture the social and psychological forces that govern protective behaviors. Drawing on 20 waves of a national survey conducted throughout the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States, we show that institutional trust — particularly trust in public health agencies, physicians, and hospitals — is a dominant predictor of protective behavior adoption. For mask wearing during periods of strongest pandemic activity, for example, institutional trust explains more behavioral variance across population groups than age, income, education, and partisan affiliation combined. In unadjusted analyses, the difference in protective behavior adoption between individuals with the highest and lowest trust in the CDC was four- to six-fold larger than the corresponding differences by age, income, or educational attainment, and exceeded the difference between Democratic and Republican respondents. This association was institutionally specific (e.g., the relationship attenuates for trust in banks), and behaviorally specific (e.g., trust in the CDC is associated with protective behaviors but not visiting a doctor). The latter suggests that trust modifies voluntary compliance with public health recommendations rather than access to or use of healthcare. We conclude that compartmental models of disease transmission would be substantially improved by incorporating institutional trust as a stratifying variable. We additionally offer a trust-integrated mathematical modeling framework and recommendations for the data infrastructure needed for its implementation.

title: Intermittent gas–liquid rearrangement controls the mixing of gases in porous media
summary_zh: 研究多孔介质中气体混合。使用4D X射线成像研究氮气注入。发现气体混合通过序列变化。
summary_en: This study investigates gas mixing in porous media. Uses 4D X-ray imaging to study nitrogen injection. Finds gas mixing evolves through a sequence of changes.
insights: 创新点：多孔介质中气体混合研究
方法亮点：使用4D X射线成像
关键发现：气体混合通过序列变化
insights_en: Novelty: Study of gas mixing in porous media
Method highlight: Using 4D X-ray imaging
Key finding: Gas mixing evolves through a sequence of changes
abstract: Gas mixing in porous media governs important environmental and industrial applications in which multiple gas components share the available pore space with liquid water, simultaneously undergoing gas mixing and gas–liquid redistribution. Currently, this process is represented by macroscopic models that ignore pore scale dynamics. We demonstrate that this is not generally valid, and can lead to large errors in the mixing rate. We use 4D X-ray imaging to investigate nitrogen injection into a porous sandstone saturated with krypton and water, jointly imaging the gas mixture composition evolution and multiphase flow of gas and water. In contrast to the smooth, continuous representation of the conventional advection–diffusion model, our results show that gas mixing evolves through a sequence of distinct regimes controlled by gas connectivity. Initially, immiscible gas–water displacement generates gas composition variance as the different gases occupy neighboring pores separated by water. As gas connectivity increases, intermittent gas–liquid interfacial rearrangements rapidly connect regions of contrasting gas composition, driving a fast decay in composition variance. Once connectivity stabilizes, mixing is controlled by a confined diffusion process within the quasi-static gas network. At later times, further mixing is driven slowly by multicomponent Ostwald ripening, whereby trapped gas ganglia exchange solutes through the surrounding liquid phase. These findings provide insights into gas mixing in porous media, suggesting concepts for upscaling the role of pore scale multiphase flow in gas mixing in the subsurface.

title: Dysregulation of mechanosensing signaling in monocytes of patients with systemic sclerosis is associated with skin inflammation
summary_zh: 研究系统性硬化症患者的单核细胞机械传感信号失调。发现皮肤浸润单核细胞炎症标志物增强。
summary_en: This study investigates dysregulation of mechanosensing signaling in monocytes of SSc patients. Finds skin-infiltrating monocytes exhibit heightened inflammatory signatures.
insights: 创新点：系统性硬化症患者单核细胞机械传感信号失调研究
方法亮点：单细胞RNA测序数据再分析
关键发现：皮肤浸润单核细胞炎症标志物增强
insights_en: Novelty: Study of dysregulation of mechanosensing signaling in SSc patients
Method highlight: Reanalysis of single cell RNA sequencing datasets
Key finding: Enhanced inflammatory signatures in skin-infiltrating monocytes
abstract: Systemic sclerosis (SSc) is a severe autoimmune connective tissue disease characterized by immune dysregulation and progressive fibrosis of the skin and internal organs, resulting in substantial organ dysfunction and increased mortality. Fibrosis is driven in part by infiltration of immune cells, including monocytes that become activated within fibrotic tissue. However, how the mechanical properties of fibrotic skin regulate their function remains poorly understood. Here, we demonstrate that increased stiffness activates human monocytes through mechanosensing. Reanalysis of single cell RNA sequencing datasets revealed that skin infiltrating monocytes exhibit heightened inflammatory signatures as compared to circulating counterparts, with further amplification in SSc. Using collagen-coated hydrogels modeling physiological and fibrotic stiffness, we show that increased stiffness enhances CD86 expression, and broadly upregulates inflammatory transcriptional programs in human monocytes. Mechanistically, stiffness-driven activation was associated with chromatin remodeling and epigenetic reprogramming, identifying the transcription factor Specificity Protein 1 (SP1) as a central regulator. CRISPR–Cas9-mediated disruption or pharmacologic inhibition of SP1 significantly attenuated stiffness- induced inflammatory gene expression, whereas we found no evidence for involvement of the canonical YAP/TAZ–TEAD axis, and pharmacological modulation of PIEZO1 neither reproduced nor blocked the response. Further, monocytes from patients with SSc displayed altered transcriptional trajectories and an exaggerated inflammatory response to high stiffness, accompanied by reduced expression of wound healing and antifibrotic programs. Together, these findings identify SP1-dependent mechanosensing as a previously unrecognized pathway controlling human monocyte activation in the skin and provide mechanistic insight into how tissue stiffness sustains inflammation in SSc.

title: Atypical phenylalanine ammonia-lyases that enhance phenylpropanoid production in plants
summary_zh: 研究植物中增强苯丙烷类化合物生产的非典型苯丙氨酸氨解酶。发现PALnc成员在体外被反馈激活。
summary_en: This study investigates atypical phenylalanine ammonia-lyases enhancing phenylpropanoid production in plants. Finds PALnc members are feedback-activated in vitro.
insights: 创新点：非典型苯丙氨酸氨解酶研究
方法亮点：使用生物化学筛选
关键发现：PALnc成员在体外被反馈激活
insights_en: Novelty: Study of atypical phenylalanine ammonia-lyases
Method highlight: Using biochemical screening
Key finding: PALnc members are feedback-activated in vitro
abstract: Plants synthesize diverse phenylpropanoids, which provide us essential medicine, nutrients, and biomaterials while also acting as a major global carbon sink. Phenylpropanoids are primarily derived from L-phenylalanine (Phe) via Phe ammonia-lyase (PAL), a highly regulated enzymatic activity that limits phenylpropanoid production. However, it remains poorly understood how different plant species regulate PAL enzymes. Phylogeny-guided biochemical screening uncovered complex and diverse feedback regulation of PAL enzymes from 14 different plant species. This screening found a previously uncharacterized PAL clade, namely PALnc (from noncanonical), with some members exhibiting feedback activation by p -coumaric acid, caffeic acid, and 4-hydroxyphenylpyruvic acid in vitro. Transient expression of two PALnc genes, from Elaeis guineensis ( EgPALnc ) and Piper methysticum ( PmPALnc2 ), in Nicotiana benthamiana leaves elevated phenylpropanoid content, supported by the high in planta stability of PALnc proteins compared to canonical PALs. Whereas overexpression of Arabidopsis thaliana PAL1 ( AtPAL1 ) in stable Arabidopsis transgenic lines resulted in very low accumulation of AtPAL1 protein and minor metabolic effects, introduction of EgPALnc rendered high content of EgPALnc protein and hyperaccumulation of hydroxycinnamates derivatives. Our findings uncover a previously overlooked diversity in the regulation of the entry step of phenylpropanoid biosynthesis across various plants and identify atypical PALs within the PALnc clade as valuable tools to debottleneck and enhance phenylpropanoid production in planta.

title: Longitudinal Retinal Layer Changes After Deep Sclerectomy in Primary Open-Angle Glaucoma: A Three-Year Retrospective Cohort Study Using Spectral-Domain OCT
summary_zh: 研究原发性开角型青光眼深部巩膜切除术后的视网膜层变化。使用光谱域OCT进行三年回顾性队列研究。
summary_en: This study investigates longitudinal retinal layer changes after deep sclerectomy in primary open-angle glaucoma. Conducts a three-year retrospective cohort study using spectral-domain OCT.
insights: 创新点：原发性开角型青光眼深部巩膜切除术后的视网膜层变化研究
方法亮点：使用光谱域OCT进行队列研究
关键发现：视网膜层变化与手术相关
insights_en: Novelty: Study of longitudinal retinal layer changes after deep sclerectomy in primary open-angle glaucoma
Method highlight: Using spectral-domain OCT for cohort study
Key finding: Retinal layer changes associated with surgery
abstract: Background: To evaluate longitudinal peripapillary and macular retinal layer changes over three years before and after deep sclerectomy (DS) in eyes with primary open-angle glaucoma (POAG). Methods: This retrospective monocentric study included 150 eyes undergoing DS with intraoperative mitomycin C. Cohort 1 (n = 111) was analyzed for absolute retinal layer thickness changes and cohort 2 (n = 39) for pre- and postoperative thinning rates using spectral-domain OCT. Intraocular pressure (IOP), medication use, best-corrected visual acuity (BCVA), and visual field mean defect (MD) were assessed over three years. Results: Mean IOP decreased significantly at three years in both cohorts (cohort 1: 22.8 ± 0.7 to 14.9 ± 0.7 mmHg; cohort 2: 20.8 ± 1.2 to 13.5 ± 0.9 mmHg; both p < 0.001), alongside a significant reduction in medication use (p < 0.001). BCVA remained stable, whereas MD worsened significantly in a mixed-effects model (cohort 1: +0.70 dB/year, p = 0.002; cohort 2: +0.74 dB/year, p < 0.001). Despite sustained IOP reduction, mean peripapillary RNFL thickness declined (cohort 1: 60.1 ± 1.4 to 56.6 ± 1.8 µm, p < 0.001; cohort 2: 61.1 ± 2.4 to 57.4 ± 2.9 µm, p = 0.005). In cohort 2, the macular RNFL thinning rate decreased numerically after surgery (−1.40 ± 0.67 to −0.08 ± 0.47 µm/year; difference 1.32 µm/year, 95% CI −0.28 to 2.92; p = 0.11). Macular layers showed no significant changes. Conclusions: DS achieved sustained IOP reduction with stable visual acuity, but visual field MD worsened over three years. Peripapillary RNFL thinning persisted postoperatively, though macular thinning rates showed a non-significant reduction. Structural monitoring remains necessary after glaucoma surgery despite adequate IOP control.

title: Methodological Reporting and Reproducibility in Eye-Tracking Research on School-Age Specific Learning Disorders: A Systematic Methodological Review and Evidence Map
summary_zh: 本文系统回顾了眼动追踪研究在学龄期特定学习障碍中的应用，分析了方法报告的完整性和证据支持。研究采用PRISMA 2020标准进行报告。
summary_en: This paper systematically reviews the application of eye-tracking in research on school-age specific learning disorders, analyzing the completeness of methodological reporting and evidence support. The study was reported following the PRISMA 2020 standard.
insights: 创新点：首次系统评估眼动追踪研究方法报告的完整性和证据支持
方法亮点：采用PRISMA 2020标准进行系统综述和证据映射
关键发现：多数研究方法报告不完整，影响结果的可解释性和可重复性
insights_en: Novelty: First systematic evaluation of the completeness of methodological reporting and evidence support in eye-tracking research
Method highlight: Utilization of PRISMA 2020 standard for systematic review and evidence mapping
Key finding: Majority of studies have incomplete methodological reporting, affecting the interpretability and reproducibility of results
abstract: Eye tracking (ET) is increasingly used to study school-age specific learning disorders (SLDs), but the interpretability and reproducibility of this research depend on methodological procedures that are often incompletely reported. This systematic methodological review and evidence map examined how ET methodology is reported in research relevant to school-age SLDs and what type of evidence supports methodological recommendations. PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, and PsycINFO were searched up to 8 August 2026, supplemented by Google Scholar and reference lists, and the review was reported following PRISMA 2020. Two reviewers independently screened records; data extraction and eight-domain reporting-completeness coding were performed by one reviewer and fully checked against the source texts by a second reviewer. Twenty-one sources were included and appraised for reporting completeness across eight methodological domains. Only four sources provided direct school-age SLD evidence, all concerning dyslexia or reading, and no included source examined children with diagnosed dysgraphia or dyscalculia. Among the empirical studies, calibration, data-quality, drift, and event-parsing procedures were the least completely reported, whereas task descriptions and converging behavioral measures were reported more consistently. Most methodological recommendations therefore rest on general or developmental ET evidence and can be transferred to SLD populations only with caution. The review provides a minimum reporting framework and evidence-tiered guidance in which each recommendation is labeled by the type of evidence that supports it. More complete methodological reporting is a precondition for interpretable and reproducible ET research in school-age SLDs.

title: Assessment of Visual Quality Changes as a Result of Spectacle Misalignment
summary_zh: 本研究通过数值模拟评估了眼镜镜片倾斜对视觉质量的影响，分析了视网膜图像质量、波前像差和单眼视力预测的敏感性。
summary_en: This study assessed the impact of spectacle lens misalignment on visual quality through numerical simulation, analyzing the sensitivity of retinal image quality, wavefront aberrations, and model-predicted monocular visual acuity.
insights: 创新点：量化了镜片倾斜对视觉质量的影响
方法亮点：使用Zemax OpticStudio进行数值模拟
关键发现：镜片倾斜显著影响视觉质量
insights_en: Novelty: Quantified the impact of lens tilt on visual quality
Method highlight: Numerical simulation using Zemax OpticStudio
Key finding: Lens tilt significantly affects visual quality
abstract: Background: A substantial proportion of presbyopic patients experience visual symptoms or fail to adapt to progressive addition lenses (PALs), and lens tilt caused by suboptimal frame fitting has been suggested as one of the possible contributing factors. The aim of this theoretical study was to quantify the sensitivity of retinal image quality, wavefront aberrations and model-predicted monocular visual acuity to controlled horizontal and vertical misalignment (tilt) of single-vision (SV) spectacle lenses across a range of spherical refractive powers and viewing directions. No clinical, comfort or adaptation outcome was measured. Methods: A tolerance analysis of spectacle lens mispositioning was performed by numerical simulation in Zemax OpticStudio using the Liou–Brennan schematic eye, augmented with a 0.11 mm posterior retinal shift to account for higher-order aberrations of the average healthy eye. Twelve HOYA single-vision spectacle lenses (made from CR-39 1.50 and Eyas 1.60 materials, refractive powers ±2.00, ±4.00 and ±6.00 D) were tilted around the vertical axis (lens front face angle, LFFA) up to 5° and around the horizontal axis (pantoscopic angle, PA) up to 12.5°, in 2.5° steps, the latter range covering the whole span of pantoscopic angles encountered in practice, both for axial fixation and for an eccentric 20° nasal viewing direction at infinite object distance. Wavefront aberrations (Zernike astigmatism,C22, C2−2) and visual acuity (V, in logMAR units) were computed via a previously validated polychromatic point-spread-function-based algorithm. Results: For the central (on-axis) viewing direction, none of the tested spectacle lenses were sensitive to tilt. For 20° oblique gaze, however, astigmatism became disturbing for negative lenses at or below −6.00 D and for positive lenses already around +5.00 D. Visual acuity simulations confirmed that lenses of ±4.00 D and stronger lost on average 0.03 logMAR (≈one third of an ETDRS line) at 5° of tilt, while ±2.00 D lenses were unaffected. Extending pantoscopic tilt to the upper physiological limit increased the effect in a monotonic manner: at PA = 12.5°, the oblique astigmatism of +6.00 D lenses reached 0.69–0.73λ (≈0.95–1.00 D of cylinder), and their predicted acuity deteriorated by 0.09–0.12 logMAR, i.e., about one ETDRS line, whereas +4.00 D lenses lost at most 0.03 logMAR, and ±2.00 D lenses remained unaffected throughout. Conclusions: In this optical model, the effect of SV lens tilt on predicted visual acuity depended on lens power, tilt axis and viewing direction: tilt was optically inconsequential for axial fixation and for low powers, whereas at 20° eccentric fixation, lenses of ±4.00 D and above showed a small model-predicted degradation that became clinically relevant in magnitude only for +6.00 D lenses at pantoscopic angles approaching 12.5°. These model-derived results describe the optical tolerance of SV lenses only; they were not obtained with PAL designs and do not quantify clinical visual performance, adaptation or wearing comfort.

title: Oculomotor Behavior During Visually Guided Responses in Inline Speed Skaters
summary_zh: 本研究调查了速滑运动员在视觉引导反应中的眼动行为，通过训练前后比较，分析了眼动参数的变化。
summary_en: This study investigated the oculomotor behavior during visually guided responses in inline speed skaters, analyzing changes in eye movement parameters before and after a training session.
insights: 创新点：研究了速滑运动员的眼动行为
方法亮点：使用ReactionX系统和Neon眼动追踪器
关键发现：训练改善了视觉引导反应中的眼动行为
insights_en: Novelty: Investigated the oculomotor behavior in inline speed skaters
Method highlight: Utilization of ReactionX system and Neon eye tracker
Key finding: Training improved oculomotor behavior in visually guided responses
abstract: Inline speed skating requires efficient visual processing and oculomotor coordination, particularly during physically demanding exercise. This study investigated whether an acute training session alters oculomotor behavior during visually guided responses to spectrally narrow-band chromatic stimuli. Fifteen federated speed skaters (16.90 ± 6.54 years) were assessed before (PRE) and after (POST) a complete training session. Participants performed a structured visual task using the ReactionX system, which presented randomly ordered spectrally narrow-band chromatic green, blue, and red light stimuli, while binocular eye movements were recorded at 200 Hz using a Neon sports eye tracker (Pupil Labs, Berlin, Germany). Blink frequency and duration, fixation and saccadic parameters, and saccade amplitude and velocity were analyzed. No significant PRE–POST differences were observed for the main oculomotor variables across stimulus colors (p > 0.05). Numerically fewer fixations and saccadic eye movements after training were observed for green (p = 0.102 and p = 0.109) and red stimuli (p = 0.116 and p = 0.121), but these differences did not reach statistical significance. Significant positive correlations between saccade amplitude and velocity were observed for green and red stimuli (ρ = 0.52–0.75; p < 0.05). These exploratory findings do not provide evidence of significant changes in oculomotor behavior following a single training session and the observed numerical differences cannot be interpreted as changes in visual scanning efficiency or color-specific effects.

title: Parental Smoking and Corneal Astigmatism in a Matched Pediatric Sample
summary_zh: 本研究分析了家长吸烟与儿童角膜散光之间的关系，通过匹配病例对照研究，探讨了吸烟对儿童视力的影响。
summary_en: This study examined the association between parental smoking and corneal astigmatism in a matched pediatric sample, exploring the impact of smoking on children's vision.
insights: 创新点：探讨了家长吸烟与儿童角膜散光的关系
方法亮点：采用匹配病例对照研究设计
关键发现：家长吸烟与儿童角膜散光显著相关
insights_en: Novelty: Explored the relationship between parental smoking and childhood corneal astigmatism
Method highlight: Matched case-control study design
Key finding: Parental smoking is significantly associated with childhood corneal astigmatism
abstract: Objective: The objective of this study was to examine the association between parental smoking, a questionnaire-based proxy for secondhand smoke exposure, and incident right-eye corneal astigmatism (CA). Methods: This nested case–control reanalysis included 78 pairs matched on sex and follow-up duration. The primary endpoint, revised after peer review, was CA < 1.0 diopter (D) at cohort entry and ≥1.0 D at the index visit. Conditional logistic regression adjusted for entry age, entry CA, parental astigmatism, and afterschool outdoor time. Subsequent refractive astigmatism (RA) change was examined as an exploratory secondary outcome in the same selected sample. Results: Keratometry-based classification agreed with all original case–control labels. Parental smoking was reported for 61/78 cases and 48/78 controls. The adjusted odds ratio was 2.257 (95% profile-likelihood confidence interval, 1.016–5.434; likelihood-ratio p = 0.0456; Wald p = 0.0538). RA change was available for all 156 children after 19 blank cylinder entries were confirmed as measured zeros. The adjusted difference in RA change was 0.266 D (95% confidence interval, 0.181–0.351; p < 0.001). Conclusions: The CA estimate suggested higher odds with parental smoking, but wide intervals and inference sensitive to the statistical method indicate substantial uncertainty. The exploratory RA association is susceptible to selection bias because participants were sampled according to CA case status; adjustment for case status does not itself remove this bias. These findings do not establish causality or population-level astigmatism progression.

title: In Vivo Architecture and Functional Dynamics of Conjunctival Lymphatic Vessels: A Three-Plexus Model Visualized by Modified Trypan Blue Lymphangiography
summary_zh: 本研究通过改良的锥蓝淋巴管造影技术，可视化并描述了结膜淋巴管的体内结构和功能动态。
summary_en: This study visualized and described the in vivo architecture and functional dynamics of conjunctival lymphatic vessels using a modified trypan blue lymphangiography technique.
insights: 创新点：使用改良锥蓝淋巴管造影技术可视化结膜淋巴管
方法亮点：采用标准化注射技术
关键发现：揭示了结膜淋巴血管的三重网络结构
insights_en: Novelty: Visualized conjunctival lymphatic vessels using modified trypan blue lymphangiography
Method highlight: Standardized injection technique
Key finding: Revealed a three-plexus network structure of conjunctival lymphatic vessels
abstract: The conjunctival lymphatic network is critical for ocular surface immunity, aqueous humor drainage after glaucoma surgery, and subconjunctival drug delivery, yet its in vivo architecture in humans remains incompletely characterized. This study aimed to visualize and describe the in vivo architecture and functional dynamics of conjunctival lymphatic vessels using a modified trypan blue injection technique. Ninety eyes of 78 patients (66 unilateral, 12 bilateral contributions) undergoing routine cataract surgery were enrolled. A modified intratissue injection technique using a 34-gauge needle, a silicone tube adapter, and 0.08% trypan blue was applied at standardized locations (limbus, 4 mm, 7 mm, and fornix), with real-time video recording under the operating microscope in all cases. A total of 249 investigations were performed, with successful lymphatic visualization in 143 (57.4%). Three distinct lymphatic plexuses were identified: superficial, intermediate, and deep. The superficial plexus showed a valve-like “pearl beads” morphology with blind-ending segments; the intermediate plexus consisted of larger collectors draining toward the fornix; and the deep plexus—previously undescribed—comprised flat, interconnected vessels without visible valves, filled exclusively via inter-plexus lymphatic bridges. Limbal lymphatic capillaries originated only from the intermediate and deep plexuses. Drainage followed a consistent nasal-to-temporal and posterior-to-fornix pattern, and blood elements were observed replacing trypan blue within lymphatic vessels during and after surgical manipulation. This study provides the first in vivo description of a three-plexus conjunctival lymphatic architecture in humans and identifies inter-plexus bridges as a novel anatomical feature. The modified trypan blue technique proved effective for mapping both structure and dynamics, even when subconjunctival dye depots formed, confirming its utility for in vivo lymphatic visualization.

title: Respiratory phase orchestrates human olfactory cortical dynamics
summary_zh: 研究揭示呼吸相位调控嗅觉皮层动态。采用鼻呼吸与脑电图同步记录，发现气味刺激引发呼吸相位锁定的脑电活动。
summary_en: Research reveals that respiratory phase regulates olfactory cortical dynamics. Nasal respiration and EEG recordings show phase-locked brain activity triggered by odor stimuli.
insights: 创新点：呼吸相位调控嗅觉皮层动态的新发现
方法亮点：鼻呼吸与脑电图同步记录技术
关键发现：气味刺激引发呼吸相位锁定的脑电活动
insights_en: Novelty: New discovery of respiratory phase regulating olfactory cortical dynamics
Method highlight: Synchronized nasal respiration and EEG recording technique
Key finding: Odor stimuli trigger phase-locked brain activity related to respiratory phase
abstract: A bstract Olfaction is fundamental to perception, memory, and emotion, yet the neural basis of human odor processing remains poorly understood. Here, we demonstrate that odor-evoked brain activity is organized by respiratory phase–not absolute time–revealing that natural breathing structures olfactory cortical dynamics. Using simultaneous nasal respiration and electroencephalography (EEG) recordings in 17 participants, we delivered naturalistic odors (peppermint, oregano, and grapefruit) synchronized to individual breathing cycles. Odor presentation elicited distinct, respiratory phase–locked event-related spectral perturbations (RPL-ERSPs) in frontal and temporal regions, emerging during the first breath after stimulus onset. The most discriminative neural signatures were theta-band activity during inhalation and alpha-band activity during exhalation, patterns that were obscured in traditional time-locked analyses due to natural variability in breath duration. Leave-one-subject-out cross-validation of RPL-ERSPs achieved reliable odor discrimination (peppermint: AUC = 0.78; oregano: AUC = 0.68; grapefruit: AUC = 0.61), establishing that phase-locked features generalize across individuals. To connect neural responses to perceptual experience without relying on precise odor naming—which is notoriously difficult and can be disproportionately impaired in some populations—we quantified odor recognition using free-response descriptions scored with a semantic-similarity approach. Behavioral recognition strength paralleled the neural decoding hierarchy across odors, establishing the perceptual validity of RPL-ERSPs. RPL-ERSPs also revealed rapid habituation, with decoding performance declining over repeated presentations, due to selective degradation of the most informative phase-locked features. Together, these findings establish respiratory rhythm as a temporal scaffold for human olfactory cortical processing, positioning RPL-ERSPs as a sensitive, task-free approach for assessing olfactory function. We provide an open-source, respiration-synchronized olfactometer design (<$500) to enable replication and broader adoption of this approach. 1 Teaser Aligning brain activity to natural breathing unlocks objective neural markers of human smell perception.

title: Intuitive knowledge of object acoustics enables perceptual separation of physical variables from impact sounds
summary_zh: 研究通过建立概率生成模型，揭示人类从碰撞声音中感知物体属性的能力。
summary_en: The study reveals humans' ability to perceive object properties from impact sounds through a probabilistic generative model.
insights: 创新点：建立概率生成模型分析碰撞声音
方法亮点：结合理论声学统计物体共振
关键发现：人类准确判断物体属性
insights_en: Novelty: Establishing a probabilistic generative model for analyzing impact sounds
Method highlight: Combining theoretical acoustics with statistics of object resonances
Key finding: Humans accurately judge object properties from collision sounds
abstract: Upon hearing objects collide, humans can estimate physical attributes such as material and mass. Although the physics of sound generation is well established, the inverse problem that listeners solve - of inferring physical parameters from sound - remains poorly understood. Classical accounts posit the use of acoustic cues that correlate with physical variables, but do not explain how humans might distinguish multiple concurrent physical causes. To study this problem, we built a probabilistic generative model of impact sounds, combining theoretical acoustics with statistics of object resonances measured from hundreds of everyday objects, and used it to synthesize and manipulate experimental stimuli. Humans accurately judged object properties from collision sounds. However, when both of the colliding objects varied, performance was impaired if the distribution of object resonances deviated from those measured in real-world objects. The results suggest that listeners use internal physical models to separate the acoustic contributions of objects in the world.

title: Evolutionary dynamics of collective behavior across the tree of ray-finned fishes
summary_zh: 研究利用机器学习分析鱼类集体行为，探讨集体行为对物种多样性的影响。
summary_en: The study uses machine learning to analyze fish collective behavior and discusses the impact of collective behavior on species diversity.
insights: 创新点：机器学习分析鱼类集体行为
方法亮点：研究集体行为对物种多样性的影响
关键发现：集体行为与物种多样性关系
insights_en: Novelty: Machine learning analysis of fish collective behavior
Method highlight: Studying the impact of collective behavior on species diversity
Key finding: Relationship between collective behavior and species diversity
abstract: Abstract Trait evolution and lineage diversification are thought to be driven by selection on the phenotypes of individuals. However, many important phenotypes are only manifested when individuals interact. Collective behavior is one such phenotype. During collective behavior, interactions among individuals lead to emergent group-level phenotypes that can govern individual fitness. Yet, whether collective behaviors exhibit similar patterns of trait evolution to individual traits and whether these group phenotypes have influenced macroevolutionary diversification is unknown. In ray-finned fishes, the most species-rich of all vertebrate classes, many species exhibit striking displays of collective behavior in the form of collective movement. Here, we use state-of-the-art machine learning methods for text and image analysis to quantify collective movement phenotypes for 2,839 Actinopterygian fishes, comprising nearly 10% of all extant species. We find that collective movement is highly evolutionarily stable in some clades and extremely labile in others, exhibiting over 300 evolutionary transitions. Consistent with theoretical predictions, collective movement is associated with more patchy diets and higher predation pressure. Finally, we find that the evolution of collective movement coincides with an increase in net macroevolutionary diversification rate. Our analyses reveal that collective behavior is deeply intertwined with ecological and evolutionary dynamics across a vast phylogenetic scale, unlocking new questions about the role of collective phenotypes in shaping the diversity of life on Earth. Significance Collective behavior is thought to contribute to the fitness of individuals that live in groups, but we still do not understand why some species exhibit collective behavior and others do not. We developed machine learning methods to quantify collective phenotypes for thousands of species spanning the phylogeny of ray-finned fishes and found collective behavior to be widespread and consistently correlated with experiencing higher predation pressure and foraging for grouping prey. Lineages that evolve collective movement show a higher net diversification rate. Our results illustrate that collective behavior is foundational to the broad-scale patterns of evolution and diversification in the largest vertebrate class.

title: Correction for Pande et al., A lipid cue drives the subcellular localization of a self-inserting bacterial transmembrane protein
Methionine restriction inhibits EZH2-mediated GSDMD methylation to promote pyroptosis in prostate cancer
summary_zh: 研究揭示蛋氨酸限制通过抑制EZH2介导的GSDMD甲基化促进前列腺癌细胞焦亡。
summary_en: The study reveals that methionine restriction promotes pyroptosis in prostate cancer cells by inhibiting EZH2-mediated GSDMD methylation.
insights: 创新点：蛋氨酸限制促进前列腺癌细胞焦亡的新机制
方法亮点：EZH2抑制与GSDMD甲基化的研究
关键发现：EZH2甲基化抑制焦亡
insights_en: Novelty: New mechanism of methionine restriction promoting pyroptosis in prostate cancer cells
Method highlight: Study of EZH2 inhibition and GSDMD methylation
Key finding: EZH2 methylation inhibits pyroptosis
abstract: EZH2 is frequently overexpressed in solid tumors, yet the clinical efficacy of its inhibitors remains limited, highlighting an urgent need to elucidate their cytotoxic mechanisms. Here, we identify EZH2 as a posttranslational suppressor of pyroptosis through direct methylation of GSDMD. We revealed that EZH2 inhibition triggered GSDMD-dependent pyroptosis in prostate cancer cells. Clinical specimens showed an inverse correlation between EZH2 levels and cleaved GSDMD (GSDMD N-terminal, GSDMD-N) levels, reinforcing its role as a negative regulator of GSDMD activation. Mechanistically, EZH2 methylated GSDMD at lysine 168, thereby blocking caspase-1-mediated cleavage and suppressing its activation. Notably, methionine deprivation overcame this blockade and combined with the EZH2 inhibitor GSK126 to enhance pyroptosis and suppress tumor growth in vivo. These findings establish the methionine–EZH2–GSDMD axis as an epigenetic-metabolic hub controlling pyroptosis via posttranslational regulation, providing a mechanistic rationale for co-targeting methionine metabolism and EZH2 in prostate cancer therapy.

title: Predicting key viral mutations from within-host deep sequencing data
summary_zh: 研究开发计算框架预测病毒关键突变，为疫苗和疫情应对提供支持。
summary_en: The study develops a computational framework to predict key viral mutations, supporting vaccine development and epidemic response.
insights: 创新点：开发计算框架预测病毒突变
方法亮点：分析宿主内病毒基因组深度测序数据
关键发现：预测病毒突变与宿主适应
insights_en: Novelty: Development of a computational framework for predicting viral mutations
Method highlight: Analysis of within-host viral genome deep sequencing data
Key finding: Prediction of viral mutations and host adaptation
abstract: Rapid SARS-CoV-2 evolution drives continuous epidemic waves, harming vaccine protection and exerting heavy burden to population health. Predicting virus evolution holds the key for current and future medical countermeasures against infectious diseases by allowing well-matching vaccines and timely epidemic response. However, due to its high genetic diversity, fast transmissibility and evolutionary rate, accurate and timely prediction of SARS-CoV-2 evolution remains a challenge. To address this, we developed a computational framework, Beth-2, to predict key mutations of SARS-CoV-2 through analyzing within-host viral genome deep sequencing data. We leveraged the early fitness signals of variants exhibited within-host and their fitness pattern between-host to infer the emerging mutations with fitness potential. In retrospective data validation, 98.6% of the key SARS-CoV-2 mutations on receptor binding domain could be detected by our model with a median lead time of 9 mo before they reached predominance at population level. Among the 26 prospectively predicted mutations, 69% of them exhibited significantly enhanced transmissibility and five showed significant immune escape from plasma of subjects who received COVID-19 mRNA vaccine collected 6 mo after the prediction time. The mutations predicted by Beth-2 that are functionally enhanced include F456L, the defining mutation of multiple current circulating lineages, including KP.3, NB.1.8.1, and XFG. The model captures mutations of high fitness potential under the natural immune environment of host and is applicable to other pathogens. The framework can be implemented along with the existing genome surveillance network and offers an efficient and effective instrument for vaccine preparation and epidemic response.

title: Mussels possess distinct vanadium and iron storage systems for fabricating metal-reinforced adhesive fibers
summary_zh: 研究揭示贻贝具有独特的钒和铁储存系统，用于制造金属增强粘附纤维。
summary_en: The study reveals that mussels have distinct vanadium and iron storage systems for fabricating metal-reinforced adhesive fibers.
insights: 创新点：贻贝金属储存系统的新发现
方法亮点：研究贻贝足的生物制造系统
关键发现：金属增强粘附纤维的形成
insights_en: Novelty: New discovery of mussels' metal storage systems
Method highlight: Study of the mussel foot's biofabrication system
Key finding: Formation of metal-reinforced adhesive fibers
abstract: Mussels fashion a protein-based fibrous adhesive holdfast known as a byssus to tether themselves in marine habitats against crashing waves. The capacity of mussels to anchor securely is dependent on load-bearing protein-metal cross-links mediated by 3,4-dihydroxyphenylalanine (DOPA) residues coordinated to metal ions, which significantly enhance byssus mechanical properties (e.g., adhesive strength, abrasion resistance, toughness, self-healing capacity). However, the natural metal incorporation process during byssus formation remains poorly understood—a knowledge gap that limits the decades-old field of mussel-inspired materials from fulfilling its potential. Here, we investigate the natural byssus biofabrication system, the mussel foot, focusing specifically on iron and vanadium storage using a multilength scale ensemble of spectroscopic methods. Confocal Raman spectroscopy, synchrotron µ-X-ray fluorescence and µ-X-ray absorption spectroscopy, and scanning transmission electron microscopy with energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy studies indicate that these two metals occupy separate coordination environments: vanadium storage is DOPA-based, while iron is stored in ferritin-like structures. Lacking precedence, these findings indicate that mussels evolved a catechol-based metal storage system to specifically acquire and store what is typically considered a trace metal ion in biology, which they employ subsequently to mechanically reinforce protein-based glues and coatings produced by the mussel. Beyond the biological implications, these findings have potential to transform the field of mussel-inspired materials.

title: Coupling of structural preordering and density fluctuation: A unified picture of nucleation in metallic glasses
summary_zh: 研究提出金属玻璃成核的统一图景，揭示结构预序和密度波动的同时出现。
summary_en: The study proposes a unified picture of nucleation in metallic glasses, revealing the simultaneous emergence of structural preordering and density fluctuations.
insights: 创新点：金属玻璃成核统一图景的提出
方法亮点：研究无序金属系统成核过程
关键发现：结构预序与密度波动的耦合
insights_en: Novelty: Proposal of a unified picture of nucleation in metallic glasses
Method highlight: Study of nucleation processes in disordered metallic systems
Key finding: Coupling of structural preordering and density fluctuations
abstract: Crystallization is ubiquitous in nature and technology, occurring in pharmaceuticals, biomacromolecules, polymers, metallurgy and glass formation. Yet how crystallization proceeds, particularly at its earliest stage, remains elusive. Studies on glass-forming liquids increasingly suggest that crystallization initiates in structurally preordered regions, with density fluctuations playing a secondary role, a view widely generalized from hard-sphere colloids. Here we show, across disordered metallic systems from pure elements and intermetallic compounds to glass-forming alloys, that density fluctuations and structural preordering emerge simultaneously during nucleation. This coupling reflects local atomic rearrangements in which free-volume reduction, denser packing, and bond-orientational order develop together. Our findings provide a physical basis for a unified nucleation framework for disordered materials.

title: Simply aging
summary_zh: 文章通过一系列简短陈述，构建了衰老生物学概念框架。
summary_en: The article develops a conceptual framework for aging biology through a series of brief statements.
insights: 创新点：衰老生物学概念框架的构建
方法亮点：通过简短陈述讨论衰老生物学
关键发现：衰老是生物过程缺陷的累积
insights_en: Novelty: Construction of a conceptual framework for aging biology
Method highlight: Discussion of aging biology through brief statements
Key finding: Aging is the accumulation of defects in biological processes
abstract: Biological aging is complex and resists any single mechanistic narrative. This article develops a conceptual framework for aging biology through a series of brief statements on central topics in the field, with the goal of discussing aging simply, directly and accessibly. The organizing principle is that aging is a default outcome of living: because biological processes are inherently imperfect, deleterious changes (the deleteriome) accumulate over time and progressively erode functional reserve. The deleteriome provides a unifying framework for molecular damage, regulatory drift, maladaptive remodeling, and system-level failure, without reducing aging to individual genes, pathways, compartments, hallmarks, or pathologies. Evolution does not program aging; it shapes maintenance and renewal systems that oppose this trajectory with limited fidelity and unavoidable trade-offs. Aging begins during development, following an early embryonic phase of rejuvenation. Modern biomarkers make biological age imperfectly but increasingly measurable. Biological age is heterogeneous across cells, organs, and systems, modifiable by interventions and environment, and in some contexts partially reversible or resettable, although aging itself is irreversible. This model links first principles of aging to measurement, intervention, and longer-term strategies, with the goal of clarifying how substantial longevity gains might be achieved, both within and beyond existing species-level constraints.

title: FDA Approves New Over-the-Counter Eye Drops for Minor Irritation

Worldwide Acne Burden Projected to Rise Through 2050

SGLT2 Inhibitors, Potassium Binders, Pregnancy After Kidney Donation, and More From Kidney Week
summary_zh: 本文访谈了Keisha Gibson博士，探讨肾脏周会上的研究，包括SGLT2抑制剂、钾结合剂和肾脏捐献后的妊娠。
summary_en: This article interviews Dr. Keisha Gibson, discussing research from the Kidney Week, including SGLT2 inhibitors, potassium binders, and pregnancy after kidney donation.

SGLT2抑制剂在肾脏疾病中的应用
肾脏捐献后妊娠的风险评估

Application of SGLT2 inhibitors in kidney diseases
Risk assessment of pregnancy after kidney donation
abstract: This Medical News article is an interview with Keisha Gibson, MD, MPH, cochair of the Kidney Week Education Committee and chief of pediatric nephrology at the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill.
