Exercise Prescriptions Recommended for Cardiovascular Health
JAMA Editors' Summary Podcast
Waist Circumference Adds to BMI, but Will Clinicians Adopt It?
summary_zh: 本文讨论了腰围测量在心血管代谢风险评估中的应用，以及临床医生是否接受这一新指标。
summary_en: This article discusses the use of waist circumference in cardiometabolic risk assessment and whether clinicians will adopt this new measure.
insights: 腰围测量作为BMI补充的潜力
临床实践中腰围测量的挑战
腰围测量对改善患者预后的潜在影响
insights_en: Potential of waist circumference as an addition to BMI
Challenges of waist circumference measurement in clinical practice
Potential impact of waist circumference measurement on patient outcomes
abstract: This Medical News article discusses the growing use of waist circumference to refine cardiometabolic risk assessment beyond body mass index (BMI), examining whether such a shift can meaningfully improve patient outcomes and what it would take to implement the measure in routine clinical practice.

title: Preparing for dialysis when dialysis might never begin?
Vertigo, multifocal brain lesions, and a diagnostic clue on the skin
UNMASC: modelling non-monotonic dose responses to cytokine combinations
summary_zh: 本研究开发了UNMASC模型，用于描述细胞因子组合的非单调剂量反应。
summary_en: This study developed the UNMASC model to describe non-monotonic dose responses to cytokine combinations.
insights: UNMASC模型描述细胞因子组合的非单调剂量反应
为细胞因子效应设计实验方案
非单调剂量反应在细胞因子研究中的应用
insights_en: UNMASC model describes non-monotonic dose responses to cytokine combinations
Designing experimental protocols for cytokine effects
Application of non-monotonic dose responses in cytokine research
abstract: ABSTRACT Induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs) have been proposed as an alternative T cell source for CAR-T cell therapies, as they can be differentiated and matured into T cells in vitro using cytokines. These assays benefit from computational and mathematical models to design appropriate experimental protocols. However, models are limited by typical monotonic dose-responses, preventing them from being used for cytokine effects that are largely non-monotonic. To address this shortcoming, we developed Uncovering Non-Monotonic Antagonistic and Synergistic Combinations (UNMASC), a novel mathematical model describing non-monotonic dose-response surfaces of cytokine interactions that distinguishes synergy of efficacy and potency. We showed that our approach successfully recapitulates non-monotonic observed dose-response surfaces characterizing in vitro T cell progenitor differentiation. Our results highlighted cytokine combinations with antagonistic effects alone but synergistic in combination, particularly IL3 and IL7. Together, UNMASC accelerates the efficient cell generation assays and extends drug interaction surfaces to a broader range of dose-responses.

title: Multi-ancestry genome-wide and transcriptome-wide association analyses identify new risk loci and genes for inflammatory bowel disease
summary_zh: 本研究通过多祖先全基因组关联分析和转录组关联分析，发现了炎症性肠病的新的风险基因。
summary_en: This study identifies new risk loci and genes for inflammatory bowel disease through multi-ancestry genome-wide and transcriptome-wide association analyses.
insights: 多祖先全基因组关联分析发现新的风险基因
转录组关联分析揭示炎症性肠病机制
基因与炎症性肠病病理途径的关系
insights_en: Multi-ancestry GWAS identifies new risk genes
Transcriptome-wide association analysis reveals IBD mechanisms
Genetic associations with IBD pathogenic pathways
abstract: ABSTRACT To advance genetic understanding of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), we conduct multi-ancestry genome-wide association studies (GWAS) meta-analyses of 63,415 cases of Europeans and East Asians, and identified 60 previously unreported susceptibility loci. Integrating multi-ancestry transcriptome-wide association studies (TWAS), cell type-specific TWAS, alternative splicing, and alternative polyadenylation analyses using RNA-sequencing data from normal colon tissues of 707 Europeans and 364 East Asians, we identify 441 candidate risk genes, including 324 not previously implicated by GWAS or TWAS, of which 291 were further supported by colocalization or summary-data-based Mendelian randomization analyses. These genes converge on pathways central to IBD pathogenesis (e.g., immune regulation), with over half showing transcriptional dysregulation supported by single-cell and spatial omics analyses. We further identify 44 druggable genes linked to 221 approved drugs or Phase II/III clinical-stage compounds. Our findings deepen the understanding of IBD genetics and provide insights for future research relevant to precision medicine for IBD.

title: Resolving phonons in superconductor Bi2Sr2CaCu2O8+δ at sub-unit-cell resolution
summary_zh: 本研究通过亚单元分辨率的电子能量损失光谱，揭示了超导体Bi2Sr2CaCu2O8+δ中的声子模式。
summary_en: This study resolves phonon modes in the superconductor Bi2Sr2CaCu2O8+δ using sub-unit-cell resolution electron energy loss spectroscopy.
insights: 亚单元分辨率电子能量损失光谱揭示声子模式
发现层特定定位的声子模式
声子频率的空间调制
insights_en: Sub-unit-cell resolution EELS resolves phonon modes
Identified layer-specific localized phonon modes
Spatial modulation of phonon frequencies
abstract: Abstract The role of phonons in cuprates remains controversial, with their complex lattice structure complicating the investigation. Here, we identify phonon modes originating from charge reservoir and superconducting layers of Bi 2 Sr 2 CaCu 2 O 8+δ using sub-unit-cell resolved electron energy loss spectroscopy in a scanning transmission electron microscope. We reveal several phonon modes exhibiting layer-specific localization: ~78 meV in-plane modes localized in the CuO 2 planes, ~42 meV hybrid (in-plane and out-of-plane) modes in the CuO 2 planes, and ~38 meV hybrid modes in the BiO layers. We also observe a periodic modulation of phonon frequencies induced by the superstructure, spatially correlating with the superconducting gap variation. Our findings offer new insights into the lattice dynamics in cuprates, fostering deeper exploration of the microscopic linkage between structural modulation, electronic inhomogeneity, and electron-phonon coupling.

title: A 17.2T MRI atlas and multiparametric exploration of the mouse hypothalamus reveal sexual dimorphism and lateralization
summary_zh: 利用17.2T MRI研究小鼠下丘脑，揭示性二态性和侧化现象。高分辨率成像和通路追踪技术提供新的结构功能见解。
summary_en: Using 17.2T MRI to study the mouse hypothalamus reveals sexual dimorphism and lateralization. High-resolution imaging and tractography techniques provide new structural and functional insights.
insights: 创新点：高场强MRI研究下丘脑
方法亮点：结构功能成像与通路追踪
关键发现：性二态性和侧化现象
insights_en: Novelty: High-field MRI study of the hypothalamus
Method highlight: Structural and functional imaging and tractography
Key finding: Sexual dimorphism and lateralization
abstract: Abstract Structural and functional insights into the mouse hypothalamus are hampered by its small size and deep location. Here, we leverage ultra-high-field magnetic resonance imaging (UHF-MRI) at 17.2 Tesla to achieve unprecedented spatial resolution in structural, functional and neurochemical imaging of the mouse hypothalamus, including sexual dimorphism in certain nuclei. High-resolution ex vivo anatomical MRI enabled precise hypothalamic parcellation, improving on existing atlases and revealing nuclei previously unresolved by MRI. Diffusion MRI and tractography mapped intra- and extra-hypothalamic pathways, facilitating circuit-level exploration without a priori assumptions. Resting-state fMRI combined with independent component analysis identified novel hypothalamic networks, demonstrating the enhanced capacity of UHF MRI to detect deep-brain activity. ¹H-magnetic resonance spectroscopy quantified neurochemical profiles, revealing sexually dimorphic heterogeneity within the hypothalamus. Our comprehensive multimodal approach uncovers sex differences in hypothalamic anatomy, microstructure, and neurochemistry, emphasizing the importance of sex as a biological variable. This integrated pipeline offers a valuable resource for dissecting hypothalamic circuits and functions, advancing our understanding of neuroendocrine regulation, behavior, and disease mechanisms, with direct translational relevance.

title: Pre-bilaterian roots of the chordate body plan
summary_zh: 通过多学科研究，揭示两侧对称动物体计划的共同进化起源。研究结合跨物种转基因、信号通路干扰和单细胞转录组比较。
summary_en: Through multidisciplinary research, reveals the common evolutionary origin of the bilaterian body plan. The study combines trans-species transgenesis, signaling pathway perturbations, and cross-phylum single-cell transcriptomic comparisons.
insights: 创新点：多学科研究体计划起源
方法亮点：跨物种转基因与信号通路研究
关键发现：共同进化起源
insights_en: Novelty: Multidisciplinary study of the origin of the body plan
Method highlight: Transgenic and signaling pathway research across species
Key finding: Common evolutionary origin
abstract: Abstract Similarity of body-plan features across distant phyla provides striking testimony to the Darwinian concept of common descent throughout Metazoa. In both the cnidarian Nematostella and chordates, gastrula organizers direct the initial establishment of embryonic axes. Whether these domains share a common evolutionary origin is a fundamental question for understanding the origin of the chordate body plan. To address this question, we combine trans-species transgenesis, perturbations of signaling pathways, cross-phylum single-cell transcriptomic comparisons, and transplantation assays. We show that cis-regulatory elements that recapitulate NvBmp2/4 and NvChordin expression in Nematostella —and therefore report the endogenous cnidarian organizer regulatory environment—also drive organizer-restricted activity in vertebrate embryos, consistent with vertebrate organizer gene-regulatory logic. Moreover, we show that, as in vertebrates, Smad2/3-mediated signaling is active in the Nematostella organizer and is required for organizer-specific expression of NvBmp2/4 and NvChordin . Together, our data support remarkable homology between cnidarian and chordate gastrula organizers and are consistent with the idea that the cnidarian–bilaterian ancestor possessed a blastopore organizer with the potential to generate dorsal–anterior chordate fates. On this basis, we propose a “skewed evo-schistostomy” scenario for the evolution of the chordate body plan from a cnidarian–bilaterian ancestor.

title: Two distinct α2β1 integrin glycan interactions mediate cell entry of a picornavirus
summary_zh: 研究小RNA病毒通过α2β1整合素糖基化相互作用进入细胞。揭示病毒与细胞受体结合的关键机制。
summary_en: Studies how a picornavirus enters cells via distinct α2β1 integrin glycan interactions, revealing key mechanisms of virus-cell receptor binding.
insights: 创新点：小RNA病毒细胞进入机制研究
方法亮点：敲除细胞与抗体处理
关键发现：病毒与细胞受体结合机制
insights_en: Novelty: Study of picornavirus cell entry mechanism
Method highlight: Knockout cells and antibody treatment
Key finding: Virus-cell receptor binding mechanism
abstract: Abstract Equine rhinitis A virus (ERAV), a picornavirus closely related to foot-and-mouth disease virus, causes respiratory infections in horses. We performed a HEK293T CRISPRi screen and identified integrin α2β1 as a protein receptor for ERAV. Using knock-out cells and pretreating cells with an antibody or soluble receptor, we confirmed the importance of this integrin for infection of multiple cell types, including equine fibroblasts. Cryo-EM and glycoproteomics analyses revealed that ERAV binds integrin α2β1 in its closed conformation by attaching to the β-propeller of the α2 chain, independent of divalent cations, as well as to a high-mannose glycan on α2 N112 and a sialylated glycan on β1 N269. Using glycan knockout and knock-in cells and by reconstituting integrin α2β1-depleted cells with mutant receptors, we demonstrated the importance of these glycans for virus entry. Our results identify a hitherto unseen combination of protein and glycan interactions between a virus and its receptor.

title: Nitrene-triggered carbocationic rearrangement of tetrasubstituted alkenes enables divergent access to fused δ-lactams
summary_zh: 报道一种利用氮烯触发的四级烯烃碳正离子重排合成δ-内酰胺的方法。该方法条件温和，产率高，对映选择性高。
summary_en: Reports a method for the synthesis of fused δ-lactams using nitrene-triggered carbocationic rearrangement of tetrasubstituted alkenes. The method proceeds under mild conditions with high yields and excellent diastereoselectivity.
insights: 创新点：新型烯烃重排合成δ-内酰胺
方法亮点：温和条件与高选择性
关键发现：合成方法适用于复杂底物
insights_en: Novelty: Novel alkene rearrangement for δ-lactam synthesis
Method highlight: Mild conditions and high selectivity
Key finding: Synthesis method applicable to complex substrates
abstract: Abstract Transition-metal-catalyzed nitrene transfer has emerged as a powerful strategy for alkene functionalization, yet its application to sterically congested tetrasubstituted alkenes remains severely underdeveloped. Here, we report an Ir(III)-catalyzed nitrene-triggered aziridination–rearrangement cascade that enables the efficient conversion of cyclic-substituted tetrasubstituted alkenes into cycloalkane-fused δ-lactams. The transformation proceeds under mild conditions with excellent yields and uniformly high diastereoselectivities and exhibits broad compatibility with carbon-, oxygen-, and nitrogen-based nucleophiles, including structurally complex and biologically relevant substrates. Combined experimental and computational studies support a concerted aziridination by an Ir–nitrenoid to generate a strained tricyclic intermediate, which undergoes a strain-release-driven aza-semipinacol rearrangement to furnish a bicyclic azacarbocation. Divergent nucleophilic interception or elimination of this intermediate provides rapid access to structurally diverse fused δ-lactam architectures. These findings establish a nitrene-triggered carbocationic rearrangement manifold for the functionalization of tetrasubstituted alkenes and expand the synthetic potential of transition-metal-catalyzed nitrene transfer.

title: CO2 responsive nanoscopic and macroscopic materials directed by peptides
summary_zh: 利用肽序列设计控制纳米和宏观材料对CO2的响应。肽功能化纳米颗粒对CO2表现出显著和可调的响应。
summary_en: Utilizes peptide sequence design to control the responsiveness of nanoscopic and macroscopic materials to CO2. Peptide-functionalized nanoparticles exhibit pronounced and tunable responses to CO2.
insights: 创新点：肽序列设计控制材料响应
方法亮点：CO2响应性材料
关键发现：纳米颗粒对CO2的敏感性
insights_en: Novelty: Peptide sequence design for material responsiveness
Method highlight: CO2-responsive materials
Key finding: Nanoparticles' sensitivity to CO2
abstract: Stimuli such as pH, light, and electromagnetic fields have enabled precise control over nanoscale interactions, yet gases remain relatively unexplored as regulators of material behavior despite their central roles in biology, energy, and climate. Here, we introduce carbon dioxide as a dynamic and reversible stimulus for controlling nanoscale and macroscale matter using sequence-specific peptide design. Peptide-functionalized nanoparticles exhibit pronounced and tunable responses to CO 2 across orders of magnitude changes in gas flow rate, with sensitivity governed by site- and sequence-specific changes in peptide structure. The aggregation sequence-dependence is described by six design principles while quantitative modeling show that aggregation rate scales with flow rate rather than cumulative CO 2 dose. This gas-controlled response translates from colloidal nanoparticles to cm-scale biocompatible hydrogels that reversibly and colorimetrically respond to CO 2 . Leveraging this responsiveness, we further demonstrate spatial patterning of a hydrogel through a gas-permeable mask using CO 2 as a lithographic stimulus. Consequently, this work establishes gas-mediated control as a general and scalable strategy for programming responsive materials across length scales.

title: Bell nonlocality with directly generated telecom-band spin–photon entanglement
summary_zh: 通过直接生成电信波段自旋-光子纠缠实现贝尔非定域性。验证了量子信息科学中的关键概念。
summary_en: Achieves Bell nonlocality with directly generated telecom-band spin-photon entanglement, verifying a cornerstone concept in quantum information science.
insights: 创新点：电信波段自旋-光子纠缠生成
方法亮点：实现贝尔非定域性
关键发现：量子信息科学验证
insights_en: Novelty: Telecom-band spin-photon entanglement generation
Method highlight: Achieving Bell nonlocality
Key finding: Verification in quantum information science
abstract: Quantum nonlocality, typically revealed through entanglement distribution across quantum networks, is a cornerstone of quantum information science. Long-distance distribution of entanglement requires the information carrier, i.e., flying photons, to operate in the minimum-loss telecom band of optical fiber. While extensive efforts have been devoted to the direct generation of entanglement between C-band telecom photons and various stationary spins, the verification of quantum nonlocality remains an outstanding challenge. Here, utilizing a dipole transition in rubidium atoms with a wavelength of 1530 nm and a cavity-assisted protocol, we achieve resonant excitation and direct emission of C-band telecom photons from a single atom, generating spin–photon entanglement with a measured Bell state fidelity exceeding 91.4%. We then verify Bell nonlocality by observing a Bell inequality violation of 2.455(77) > 2 using this high-quality entangled pair. These results extend the wavelength of a single-atom quantum emitter to the telecom C-band, achieving sufficiently high-fidelity spin–photon entanglement to finally verify Bell nonlocality. The authors demonstrate the direct generation of telecom C-band spin-photon entanglement from a single neutral atom, achieving >91.4% Bell-state fidelity and a CHSH violation of 2.455(77), thereby establishing Bell nonlocality in a fiber-compatible quantum networking platform

title: Recent extreme heatwaves are no match for future events
summary_zh: 近年极端热浪无法与未来事件相比。基于多种指标，近期观测到的热浪在低至中排放情景下也无法匹敌。未来高至极高排放情景下，许多地区预计将经历累积热量多几倍、持续时间长几倍（长达数月）的热浪。
summary_en: Recent extreme heatwaves are not comparable to future events. Based on multiple metrics, observed heatwaves are not matched even under low to medium emission scenarios. In a high to very high emission future, many regions are projected to experience heatwaves with several times more cumulative heat and many times longer durations (up to several months) than the observed heatwaves.
insights: 创新点：近期热浪无法与未来热浪相比。
方法亮点：基于多种指标分析未来热浪。
关键发现：未来热浪累积热量和持续时间将远超近期观测值。
insights_en: Novelty: Recent heatwaves cannot be compared to future heatwaves.
Method highlight: Analysis of future heatwaves based on multiple metrics.
Key finding: Future heatwaves will have significantly higher cumulative heat and longer durations than observed recent heatwaves.
abstract: Abstract In recent years, record-breaking heatwaves have occurred over many regions of the Earth causing serious impacts to human and natural systems. Here we show that recently observed exceptional heatwaves are no match to potential future 21 st century events based on multiple metrics. For several observed heatwaves, this holds even under low- and medium-emissions scenarios. In a high- to very high-emissions future, many regions are projected to experience heatwaves that generate several times more cumulative heat and are many times longer (up to several months) than the observed heatwaves. Should the Nationally Determined Contributions under the Paris Agreement not be implemented, in most regions a concerningly large proportion of projected heatwaves exceeds all analyzed heatwave characteristics at once. Our results underscore the crucial need for substantial emissions reduction and have important implications for adaptation measures, as a substantial proportion of projected heatwaves is well outside the recent lived experience.

title: Excess type I interferon disrupts developmental crosstalk and promotes premature distalization in trisomy 21 lungs
summary_zh: 过量的I型干扰素破坏了唐氏综合征肺部的发育通讯，并促进其过早远端化。研究发现，IFN-I信号过度激活与唐氏综合征肺部发育异常有关。
summary_en: Excess type I interferon disrupts developmental crosstalk and promotes premature distalization in trisomy 21 lungs. Findings indicate that hyperactivation of IFN-I signaling is associated with congenital lung anomalies in trisomy 21.
insights: 创新点：揭示了I型干扰素在唐氏综合征肺部发育中的作用。
方法亮点：通过单细胞RNA测序研究IFN-I信号。
关键发现：IFN-I信号过度激活导致肺部发育异常。
insights_en: Novelty: Unveils the role of type I interferon in the development of trisomy 21 lungs.
Method highlight: Investigated IFN-I signaling using single-cell RNA sequencing.
Key finding: Hyperactivation of IFN-I signaling leads to lung developmental anomalies.
abstract: Abstract Pulmonary complications are a primary cause of morbidity and mortality in children with Down Syndrome resulting from Trisomy 21 (T21). We recently described congenital lung anomalies associated with T21, yet the underlying mechanisms remain elusive. Type I interferon (IFN-I) signaling is consistently hyperactivated in many T21 tissues. IFN-I is recognized as a key regulator of immune cell activation and differentiation, with an under-appreciated role in tissue development. In this study we examine the effects of over-activation and repression of IFN-I signaling in developing human lung tissues. Single-cell RNA sequencing indicates that IFN treatment of tissue explants largely recapitulates transcriptional changes associated with altered epithelial differentiation in T21 lungs. Lineage-specific cell co-culture experiments confirm that mesenchyme-driven IFN-I hyperactivation promotes epithelial bud remodeling, shifts progenitor cell identity, and suggests the induction of AT2-like programs. Our data show that IFN-I is necessary and sufficient to drive T21-related lung pathologies and provide a model system enabling therapeutic discovery.

title: Metabolic reprogramming modulates cardiomyocyte hypertrophy via GLS1 in chronic kidney disease in male mice
summary_zh: 代谢重编程通过GLS1调节雄性小鼠慢性肾脏病中的心肌细胞肥大。研究发现，CKD驱动心肌细胞代谢重编程，增强谷氨酰胺分解，损害氧化磷酸化。
summary_en: Metabolic reprogramming modulates cardiomyocyte hypertrophy via GLS1 in chronic kidney disease in male mice. Findings show that chronic kidney disease drives cardiomyocyte metabolic reprogramming characterized by enhanced glutaminolysis and impaired oxidative phosphorylation.
insights: 创新点：发现代谢重编程在CKD心肌肥大中的作用。
方法亮点：结合转录组和代谢组学分析。
关键发现：GLS1在CKD心肌肥大中起关键作用。
insights_en: Novelty: Discovers the role of metabolic reprogramming in CKD-induced cardiomyocyte hypertrophy.
Method highlight: Integrated transcriptomic and metabolomic analyses.
Key finding: GLS1 plays a critical role in CKD-induced hypertrophy.
abstract: Left ventricular hypertrophy (LVH) is a major cardiovascular complication of chronic kidney disease (CKD), yet its mechanisms remain poorly understood. Here we show that in preclinical experiments, CKD drives cardiomyocyte metabolic reprogramming characterized by enhanced glutaminolysis and impaired oxidative phosphorylation in male C57BL/6J mice. Integrated transcriptomic and metabolomic analyses identified early upregulation and activation of glutaminase 1 (GLS1) in CKD hearts, while serum-induced GLS1 activity was associated with LV hypertrophic remodeling in a multicenter peritoneal dialysis cohort. Human myocardial samples also showed increased GLS1 expression in CKD. Cardiomyocyte-specific deletion or pharmacological inhibition of GLS1 attenuated CKD-induced hypertrophy in these mouse models. Proteomic and mechanistic analyses further identified phosphate as a major regulator of GLS1 activity and expression. Excessive GLS1 activation increased ammonia production, disrupted mitochondrial respiratory protein expression and redox homeostasis, and reduced bioenergetic efficiency. These findings identify a phosphate–GLS1–glutaminolysis axis linking the uremic milieu to mitochondrial dysfunction and cardiac hypertrophy, and suggest GLS1 as a potential therapeutic target for CKD-associated LVH. Chronic kidney disease often causes heart enlargement, a serious complication whose mechanisms remain unclear. Here, the authors show that excess phosphate activates the metabolic enzyme GLS1, promoting heart enlargement, while blocking GLS1 protects against this effect in male mice.

title: PRMT1 methylates SKP1 to inhibit the ubiquitination of pro-proliferative phosphoproteins during hepatocyte proliferation
summary_zh: PRMT1甲基化SKP1，抑制肝细胞增殖期间的促增殖磷酸化蛋白泛素化。研究发现，PRMT1通过受体酪氨酸激酶信号通路被EGF上调，催化SKP1的R81位点的ADMA修饰。
summary_en: PRMT1 methylates SKP1 to inhibit the ubiquitination of pro-proliferative phosphoproteins during hepatocyte proliferation. Findings show that PRMT1 is upregulated by EGF via receptor tyrosine kinase signaling and catalyzes the ADMA modification of SKP1 at the R81 residue.
insights: 创新点：发现PRMT1在肝细胞增殖中的关键作用。
方法亮点：研究PRMT1对SKP1的修饰。
关键发现：PRMT1抑制促增殖蛋白的降解。
insights_en: Novelty: Discovers the critical role of PRMT1 in hepatocyte proliferation.
Method highlight: Investigated PRMT1 modification of SKP1.
Key finding: PRMT1 inhibits the degradation of pro-proliferative proteins.
abstract: Protein phosphorylation cascades are essential for cell proliferation. Here, we identify protein arginine methyltransferase 1 (PRMT1) as a key stabilizer of phosphoproteins that is indispensable for hepatocyte proliferation during liver regeneration. PRMT1 is upregulated by epidermal growth factor (EGF) via receptor tyrosine kinase signaling and catalyzes the asymmetric dimethylation (ADMA) modification of SKP1 at the R81 residue. This methylation event disrupts FBXW7 recruitment to the SKP1-CUL1-F-box protein (SCF) E3 ubiquitin ligase complex, thereby preventing FBXW7-mediated ubiquitination. Since FBXW7 targets multiple pro-proliferative phosphoproteins, this mechanism prevents their degradation, ensuring the transduction of proliferative signals via phosphorylation cascades. Furthermore, in vivo administration of S-adenosylmethionine, the methyl donor for PRMT-catalyzed methylation, significantly accelerates liver regeneration in both mice and patients. Collectively, these findings establish PRMT1 as a central post-translational regulator of hepatocyte proliferation, highlighting its potential as a therapeutic target for liver diseases. During liver regeneration, EGF upregulates PRMT1, leading to increased asymmetric arginine dimethylation at R81 of SKP1. This impedes the interaction between SKP1 and FBXW7, protects pro-proliferative phosphoproteins from ubiquitin-mediated degradation, and thereby maintains hepatocyte proliferation.

title: Li+-locked domain effect for breaking the temperature stability bottleneck in thermal-detection high-entropy energy storage ceramics
summary_zh: Li+-锁定域效应打破热检测高熵储能陶瓷的温度稳定性瓶颈。研究发现，Li+-富集区域锁定极化纳米域，即使在300°C下也能保持其稳定性。
summary_en: Li+-locked domain effect for breaking the temperature stability bottleneck in thermal-detection high-entropy energy storage ceramics. Findings show that Li+-enriched regions lock polar nanodomains, preserving them even at 300°C.
insights: 创新点：提出Li+-锁定域效应。
方法亮点：设计高熵陶瓷系统。
关键发现：Li+-锁定域提高温度稳定性。
insights_en: Novelty: Proposes the Li+-locked domain effect.
Method highlight: Designed high-entropy ceramic systems.
Key finding: Li+-locked domain enhances temperature stability.
abstract: Conventional brain pacemakers rely on electrochemical batteries, which suffer from leakage, performance degradation, and neurotoxicity, posing serious safety risks. Ceramic-based pulse generators with ultra-fast discharge, high-temperature stability, and self-diagnostic capability offer a promising alternative. However, most dielectric ceramics lose their polarization activity at elevated temperatures. To address this challenge, we introduce a high-entropy composition design that induces a Li-locked domain effect in the ceramic system (1-x)[0.9(Bi0.47Na0.47Yb0.03Tm0.01)TiO3−0.1LiTaO3]−0.06(Ba0.3Sr0.7)(Sn0.5Hf0.5)O3. We demonstrate that Li+-enriched regions lock polar nanodomains, preserving them even at 300 °C. This mechanism yields a recoverable energy density of 11.43 J·cm−3, an efficiency of 84.67%, and excellent temperature stability (Δη/η < 0.3% up to 320 °C). Moreover, Yb3+/Tm3+ co-doping enables anomalous thermal enhancement of photoluminescence and precise temperature monitoring. Remarkably, the experimentally measured temperature sensing deviation is only ±0.23 K. The integration of stable energy storage and optical self-diagnosis provides a new paradigm for ceramic-based brain pacemaker pulse generators with early warning capability, pointing toward a possible solution to the intrinsic safety limitations of conventional battery-powered devices. Dielectric energy-storage ceramics lose polarization at high temperatures, limiting harsh-environment use. Here, the authors show a Li+- locked domain effect in high-entropy BNT-based ceramics, achieving Wrec = 11.43 J cm−3, η = 84.67%, Δη/η < 0.3% up to 320 °C, with self-diagnostic thermometry.

title: Spatiotemporal modulation of microalgae to boost biofuel generation from CO2 by the stick-to-culture strategy
summary_zh: 通过粘附培养策略对微藻进行时空调节，以增强从CO2生成生物燃料。研究发现，SLIM平台利用模拟细胞外基质的水凝胶支架在空间上组织微藻，并动态重新配置其微环境。
summary_en: Spatiotemporal modulation of microalgae to boost biofuel generation from CO2 by the stick-to-culture strategy. Findings show that the SLIM platform employs extracellular-matrix-mimicking hydrogel scaffolds to spatially organize microalgae and dynamically reconfigure their microenvironment.
insights: 创新点：提出粘附培养策略。
方法亮点：设计SLIM平台。
关键发现：时空调节提高生物燃料产量。
insights_en: Novelty: Proposes the stick-to-culture strategy.
Method highlight: Designed the SLIM platform.
Key finding: Spatiotemporal regulation enhances biofuel production.
abstract: The accelerating global energy demand, coupled with diminishing fossil fuel reserves and growing carbon emissions, underscores the urgent need for sustainable energy solutions. Autotrophic microalgae are promising cell factories for converting CO2 into renewable biofuels. However, conventional microalgal biofuels typically depend on energy-intensive or nutrient-deficient regimes that suppress microalgal proliferation, resulting in a critical trade-off between biomass growth and lipid biosynthesis. Here, we report a separable living interface with microalgae (SLIM) platform that employs extracellular-matrix-mimicking hydrogel scaffolds to spatially organize microalgae and dynamically reconfigure their microenvironment, enabling spatiotemporal switching between biomass accumulation or lipid induction. The SLIM platform supports high-density growth of microalgae while facilitating precision substrate-driven metabolic regulation, enabling low-carbon operation and improved lipid production (8.89 g L−1). This work establishes an engineered living material that overcomes essential bottlenecks in microalgal biofuel production and offers a generalizable blueprint for biohybrid systems in advanced biomanufacturing. Balancing biomass growth and lipid accumulation remains a challenge in microalgal biofuel production. Here the authors report extracellular matrix-mimicking hydrogel scaffolds that dynamically reconfigure the microenvironment of spatially organized microalgae, allowing controlled switching between the two states.

title: Robust perovskite lattice for durable and efficient pure-red light-emitting diodes
summary_zh: 开发出耐用的纯红光发光二极管，通过增强钙钛矿晶格。研究发现，通过引入协同刚性环铵和专用静电聚合物，增强了晶格刚度。
summary_en: Develops robust perovskite lattices for durable and efficient pure-red light-emitting diodes. Findings show that lattice stiffness is enhanced by introducing synergistic rigid ring ammonium and a dedicated electrostatic polymer.
insights: 创新点：开发出耐用的纯红光发光二极管。
方法亮点：增强钙钛矿晶格。
关键发现：刚性阳离子和静电聚合物提高晶格刚度。
insights_en: Novelty: Develops durable and efficient pure-red light-emitting diodes.
Method highlight: Enhances perovskite lattices.
Key finding: Rigid cations and electrostatic polymers improve lattice stiffness.
abstract: Metal halide perovskite light-emitting diodes are rising as promising candidates for next-generation display technologies. The bromine-iodine mixed halide perovskites contribute to straightforward emitters for pure-red emission, however, suffering from limited electroluminescent durability and efficiency due to highly sensitive optical properties to the featured soft lattice. Here, we report robust perovskites by intrinsically reinforcing the lattice with synergistic rigid ring ammonium and dedicated electrostatic polymer. We reveal the mechanism of enhanced lattice stiffness by sequentially clarifying the rigid cation-induced high atomic packing factor and the electrostatic polymer-derived strong octahedral Coulomb force. The resultant perovskites exhibit more than 100% improvement in bulk modulus and over 75% decrease in bond angle fluctuation under a high electric field of 107 V m−1. The robust perovskite lattice strongly suppresses the electric field-induced lattice distortion and ion migration, and strengthens the carrier radiative recombination. Consequently, we demonstrate durable and efficient pure-red PeLEDs with a long lifetime of 343.3 h and a high external quantum efficiency of 31.3%. Moreover, we reveal good compatibility of this approach in boosting the blue and green device performances. Mixed-halide perovskites enable pure-red displays but suffer from poor durability and efficiency because their soft lattices distort. Zhou et al. stiffened the lattice with rigid ammonium rings and an electrostatic polymer, producing durable, efficient devices.

title: Culture-independent strain typing of Clostridioides difficile in fecal samples
summary_zh: 开发出基于粪便样本的无培养Clostridioides difficile菌株分型方法。研究发现，PCR检测TcdB成为诊断艰难梭菌感染的关键临床测试。
summary_en: Develops culture-independent strain typing of Clostridioides difficile in fecal samples. Findings show that PCR detection of TcdB has become a key clinical test for diagnosing Clostridioides difficile infection.
insights: 创新点：开发出无培养菌株分型方法。
方法亮点：利用PCR检测TcdB。
关键发现：TcdB检测用于诊断艰难梭菌感染。
insights_en: Novelty: Develops a culture-independent strain typing method.
Method highlight: Utilizes PCR detection of TcdB.
Key finding: TcdB detection for diagnosing Clostridioides difficile infection.
abstract: Abstract Clostridioides difficile ( C. difficile ), the leading cause of healthcare-associated diarrhea, is a spore-forming obligate anaerobe that colonizes the intestinal tract and causes colitis in patients with compromised microbiome-mediated defenses. C. difficile is genomically diverse and is subtyped into ribotypes (RTs) and sequence types (STs) that vary in virulence and epidemic potential. Since secretion of the TcdB exotoxin is common to nearly all disease-associated C. difficile strains, PCR detection of TcdB has become a key clinical test used to diagnose C. difficile infection (CDI). This test and other available clinical laboratory tests, however, do not determine the prevalence of different C. difficile STs, making it impossible to identify transmission events or outbreaks in healthcare settings. Strain typing, because it requires technically demanding and time-consuming anaerobic fecal culturing of C. difficile , is not routinely performed, leaving healthcare epidemiologists unable to distinguish sporadic from epidemic occurrences of CDI. Herein, we optimized the established strain-level profiling tool, MetaPhlAn4 and StrainPhlAn, to distinguish C. difficile strains in the complex fecal microbiomes of hospitalized patients and demonstrate the utility of metagenomic short-read sequencing for culture-independent, rapid epidemiologic surveillance of CDI in healthcare environments.

title: Techno-economic and environmental assessment of next-generation battery-powered farming robots
summary_zh: 评估下一代电池驱动农业机器人技术经济和环境性能。研究对比分析有机和非有机管理下草莓、洋葱、生菜和花生种植成本和排放。
summary_en: Assesses the techno-economic and environmental performance of next-generation battery-powered agricultural robots. Analyzes costs and emissions for strawberry, onion, lettuce, and peanut production under organic and non-organic management.
insights: 创新点：整合生命周期评估和总拥有成本分析
方法亮点：使用模型模拟不同场景下的成本和排放
关键发现：成本和排放结果在文献参考范围内
insights_en: Novelty: Integrates lifecycle assessment and total cost of ownership analysis
Method highlight: Uses models to simulate costs and emissions across various scenarios
Key finding: Costs and emissions results fall within reported literature ranges
abstract: Decarbonizing agriculture without compromising productivity is a major challenge under rising input costs and labor scarcity. Autonomous battery-powered agricultural robots (ABARs) could help by reducing dependence on conventional machinery and enabling more precise application of inputs, but their system-level economic and environmental performance remains unclear. Here, we integrate total cost of ownership and life cycle assessment to evaluate a small ABAR for cradle-to-farm-gate crop production of strawberries, onions, lettuce, and peanuts under organic and non-organic management. Across modeled scenarios, benchmarked costs range from 76% below to 17% above literature-based reference ranges, while greenhouse-gas emissions fall within or below reported ranges. Variable inputs dominate both outcomes, contributing 72-90% of costs and 72-95% of global-warming impacts, with seeds, fertilizers, and irrigation water as main drivers. These results suggest that ABAR value depends less on the platform than on the ability of autonomous operation to reduce input use and labor demand.

title: [18F]FET PET enables histopathology-validated detection of non-contrast-enhancing glioblastoma
summary_zh: 使用[18F]FET PET技术，在未经对比增强的胶质母细胞瘤检测中，其灵敏度显著高于对比增强MRI，特别是在MRI上无增强的区域。
summary_en: Using [18F]FET PET, the detection of non-contrast-enhancing glioblastoma shows significantly higher sensitivity than contrast-enhanced MRI, especially in regions without enhancement on MRI.
insights: 创新点：[18F]FET PET在非对比增强胶质母细胞瘤检测中的高灵敏度
方法亮点：使用[18F]FET PET技术进行肿瘤检测
关键发现：[18F]FET PET在无增强区域检测中的优势
insights_en: Novelty: High sensitivity of [18F]FET PET in detecting non-contrast-enhancing glioblastoma
Method highlight: Use of [18F]FET PET for tumor detection
Key finding: Advantage of [18F]FET PET in detecting non-enhancing regions
abstract: Abstract Accurate visualization of glioblastoma is essential for guiding biopsy, resection and radiotherapy. Contrast-enhanced MRI is routine in clinical practice, yet it can miss metabolically active tumor outside areas of blood-brain barrier disruption. In a histopathology-validated cohort with 472 tissue samples of 61 patients with IDH-wildtype glioblastoma, we show that O-(2-[¹⁸F]fluoroethyl)-L-tyrosine PET ([ 18 F]FET PET) depicts tumor tissue significantly better than contrast-enhanced MRI (CE-MRI), especially in regions that show no enhancement on MRI. [ 18 F]FET PET achieves substantially higher sensitivity for tumor detection (91.2% vs 52.6%) and maintains high reliability in non-enhancing tissue (positive predictive value 98.3%), findings that are consistent across newly diagnosed and recurrent disease and in both cohorts undergoing either resection or biopsy. These results indicate that [ 18 F]FET PET complements MRI by revealing MRI-occult tumor burden. Incorporating amino acid PET into routine planning may therefore improve the accuracy of tumor visualization and, ultimately, patient management.

title: A pilot randomized controlled trial of medically tailored groceries and resource coaching: secondary and exploratory diet and health outcomes
summary_zh: 一项随机对照试验评估了医疗定制食品和资源指导对心血管代谢疾病患者的影响。结果显示，这些干预措施对饮食质量和健康感知有积极影响。
summary_en: A pilot randomized controlled trial evaluates the impact of medically tailored groceries and resource coaching on patients with cardiometabolic conditions. Results show these interventions positively affect diet quality and health perception.
insights: 创新点：评估医疗定制食品和资源指导对心血管代谢疾病的影响
方法亮点：进行随机对照试验以评估干预措施的效果
关键发现：干预措施对饮食质量和健康感知有积极影响
insights_en: Novelty: Evaluating the impact of medically tailored groceries and resource coaching on cardiometabolic conditions
Method highlight: Conducting a randomized controlled trial to assess the effectiveness of interventions
Key finding: Interventions positively affect diet quality and health perception
abstract: Patient access to nutritious food is critical for managing cardiometabolic conditions, yet barriers persist in under-resourced populations. This pilot randomized controlled trial (N = 210) evaluated the impact of medically tailored groceries (MTG) and food resource coaching (Coach) delivered via a co-located food pantry. Participants with Type 2 diabetes, dyslipidemias, and/or hypertension were recruited from a safety-net health center and received either usual pantry support, MTG, or MTG+Coach for four months. Exploratory outcomes reported herein include self-reported diet quality, food security, and perceived health; blood pressure (BP) from electronic health records (N = 166). Additional exploratory self-reported outcomes recommended by the funder and detailed in the supplemental materials include nutrition security, wellbeing (EQ-5D-51), loneliness, adaptive capacity, and the Cooking and Food Provisioning Action Scale. Follow-up completion was 81%. All groups improved over time in food security, diet quality, and perceived health (P < 0.001), but baseline-adjusted analyses did not identify clear differences between MTG arms and usual pantry support for any exploratory outcome. Although descriptively larger BP reductions were observed in the intervention groups, confidence intervals were wide and adjusted between-group comparisons were not statistically significant. Further studies with standardized clinical measurement are warranted. Trial registration: This trial and protocol were submitted to ClinicalTrials.gov (Identifier: NCT06242808) on February 3rd, 2024, prior to recruitment. Here, the authors report secondary and exploratory outcomes of a pilot randomized controlled trial exploring a food-is-medicine intervention of medically tailored groceries with or without resource coaching against usual pantry support. All groups improved over time in food security, diet quality, and perceived health, but baseline-adjusted analyses did not identify clear differences between the groups.

title: Rescue treatment for medium vessel occlusion by intra-arterial tenecteplase: the RESCUE-TNK randomized clinical trial
summary_zh: RESCUE-TNK临床试验旨在评估经动脉注射替奈普酶治疗中等血管闭塞急性缺血性卒中的疗效和安全性。
summary_en: The RESCUE-TNK randomized clinical trial aims to assess the efficacy and safety of intra-arterial tenecteplase for treating acute ischemic stroke due to medium vessel occlusion.
insights: 创新点：评估替奈普酶治疗中等血管闭塞急性缺血性卒中的疗效和安全性
方法亮点：进行随机临床试验以评估治疗效果
关键发现：评估经动脉注射替奈普酶的疗效和安全性
insights_en: Novelty: Assessing the efficacy and safety of tenecteplase for treating medium vessel occlusion in acute ischemic stroke
Method highlight: Conducting a randomized clinical trial to assess therapeutic effects
Key finding: Assessing the efficacy and safety of intra-arterial tenecteplase
abstract: In patients with acute ischemic stroke caused by medium vessel occlusion (MeVO), intra-arterial tenecteplase may offer a targeted strategy to improve recanalization; we hypothesized that intra-arterial tenecteplase would increase successful reperfusion compared with standard care with a comparable safety profile. This phase 2, prospective, randomised, open-label, blinded-endpoint, multicentre study aims to assess the efficacy and safety of intra-arterial tenecteplase for patients with acute ischemic stroke caused by MeVO. Patients with MeVO were randomly (1:1) assigned to receive intra-arterial tenecteplase or standard care. The primary outcome was successful reperfusion of medium vessel occlusion. A total of 80 patients were randomized to either the tenecteplase group (n = 41) or control group (n = 39). Successful reperfusion reached 61.0% (25/41) in the tenecteplase group versus 28.2% (11/39) in the control group (unadjusted odds ratio 3.98, 95% CI 1.56-10.16; P = 0.004). Symptomatic intracranial hemorrhage within 24 h was similar between the tenecteplase and control groups. This work suggests that intra-arterial tenecteplase significantly increased the probability of successful reperfusion compared with standard care, with a comparable safety profile in this stroke population. (Funded by Shenyang Science Tech Project and hospital-initiated grants; ClinicalTrials.gov registration: NCT05657470) Medium-vessel occlusion accounts for a substantial proportion of acute ischemic stroke cases, yet optimal reperfusion treatment strategies remain unclear for patients ineligible for mechanical endovascular thrombectomy. Here, the authors show that intra-arterial tenecteplase significantly increases reperfusion rates for medium-vessel occlusion with acceptable safety, although statistically-significant improvements in 90-day functional outcomes were not detected in this phase-2 randomized trial.

title: Intra-arterial tenecteplase for acute basilar artery occlusion with sufficient recanalization after thrombectomy: the INSIST-IT randomized clinical trial
summary_zh: 急性基底动脉闭塞后，辅助动脉内替奈普酶治疗，随机对照试验。主要疗效终点为90天独立行走，主要安全终点为症状性颅内出血。
summary_en: Intra-arterial tenecteplase as adjunctive therapy after thrombectomy for acute basilar artery occlusion in a randomized clinical trial. Primary efficacy outcome was independent ambulation at 90 days; primary safety outcome was symptomatic intracranial hemorrhage.
insights: 辅助动脉内替奈普酶治疗
随机对照试验设计
疗效和安全终点明确
insights_en: Intra-arterial tenecteplase as adjunctive therapy
Randomized controlled trial design
Efficacy and safety endpoints defined
abstract: The clinical effect of adjunctive intra-arterial tenecteplase after successful recanalization in acute basilar artery occlusion (BAO) remains uncertain. In this prospective, randomized, adaptive-enrichment, open label, blinded-end point, multi-center trial, patients with BAO within 24 h of estimated symptom onset who achieved successful reperfusion after endovascular treatment (EVT) were randomized (1:1) to intra-arterial tenecteplase (n = 75) or control (only received standard medical therapy, n = 69). The primary efficacy outcome was independent ambulation (modified Rankin Scale 0–3) at 90 days; the primary safety outcome was symptomatic intracranial hemorrhage (sICH). The trial was stopped early due to safety concerns and lack of efficacy per Data Safety and Monitoring Committee recommendation. Among 144 randomized patients, 143 (99.3%) completed follow-up. At 90 days, independent ambulation was achieved in 40.0% of the tenecteplase group versus 50.0% in the control group (OR 0.67; 95% CI 0.34–1.29; P = 0.23). sICH occurred in 6.2% versus 4.8% (OR 1.31; 95% CI 0.28–6.89; P = 0.73). All-cause mortality at 90 days was 41.3% versus 26.5% (OR 1.96; 95% CI 0.97–4.03; P = 0.063). In this prematurely terminated trial, adjunctive intra-arterial tenecteplase did not improve functional outcomes in patients with BAO. Acute basilar artery occlusion (BAO) is a life-threatening cause of stroke, and whether intra-arterial tenecteplase after successful recanalization leads to improved outcomes is unclear. This randomized trial by Chen and colleagues was stopped early for safety concerns and shows that adjunctive intra-arterial tenecteplase does not improve functional outcomes in acute BAO.

title: Intra-arterial tenecteplase during thrombectomy for acute ischemic stroke: the BRETIS-TNK2 trial
summary_zh: 动脉内替奈普酶在血栓切除术中的应用，随机对照试验。旨在评估其改善急性缺血性卒中患者临床结果的效果。
summary_en: Intra-arterial tenecteplase during thrombectomy for acute ischemic stroke in a randomized controlled trial. Aimed to evaluate its effect on improving clinical outcomes in patients with acute ischemic stroke.
insights: 动脉内替奈普酶在血栓切除术中的应用
随机对照试验评估效果
改善临床结果的目标
insights_en: Application of intra-arterial tenecteplase in thrombectomy
Randomized controlled trial to evaluate effect
Goal of improving clinical outcomes
abstract: Intra-arterial tenecteplase during endovascular treatment (EVT) may increase first-pass recanalization and dissolve microcirculatory thrombi, but its efficacy and safety are uncertain. We hypothesised that this strategy would improve functional outcomes versus EVT alone. This phase 3, randomised, adaptive-enrichment, open-label, blinded-endpoint multicentre study aims to evaluate whether intra‑arterial tenecteplase improves clinical outcomes for patients with acute ischemic stroke. Patients with large‑vessel occlusion eligible for EVT within 24 hours of symptom onset were randomly assigned (1:1) to the tenecteplase group receiving intra‑arterial tenecteplase during EVT or the control group receiving EVT alone. The primary endpoint was favorable functional outcome. Of 380 randomised patients (192 in the tenecteplase group and 188 in the control group), primary outcome data were available for 190 and 186 patients, respectively. Favorable 90-day functional outcomes (modified Rankin Scale 0–2) occurred in 40.0% of the tenecteplase group versus 46.8% of the control group (unadjusted odds ratio 0.76, [95% CI 0.50–1.14], P = 0.19). This work suggests intra-arterial tenecteplase during thrombectomy did not improve 90-day functional outcomes in this population. (Funded by National Science and Technology Major Project and hospital-initiated grants; ClinicalTrials.gov registration: NCT05657444) It is unclear whether adjunct intra-arterial Tenecteplase during thrombectomy improves clinical outcomes in patients with acute large vessel occlusion. Here, the authors show that adjunct intra-arterial tenecteplase during thrombectomy does not improve 90-day functional outcomes in this population.

title: DeSCENT: Deconvolutional Single-Cell RNA-seq Enhances Transcriptome-based Cancer Survival Analysis
summary_zh: DeSCENT从bulk RNA-seq生成细胞轮廓，结合生存数据预测。在TCGA癌症队列中，DeSCENT提高了C-index。
summary_en: DeSCENT generates cellular profiles from bulk RNA-seq and combines them with survival data for prediction. DeSCENT improved C-index in TCGA cancer cohorts.
insights: DeSCENT结合bulk RNA-seq和生存数据
提高TCGA队列C-index
细胞表示在生存分析中的应用
insights_en: DeSCENT combines bulk RNA-seq with survival data
Improved C-index in TCGA cohorts
Application of cellular representations in survival analysis
abstract: MOTIVATION: Single-cell RNA-seq captures tumor heterogeneity, but it is rarely available together with patient survival outcomes. Bulk RNA-seq cohorts provide survival data but lack direct measurements of cellular expression. RESULTS: DeSCENT generates reference-informed cellular profiles from bulk RNA-seq and combines both representations for survival prediction. We evaluated DeSCENT with three survival models on eight TCGA cancer cohorts. Compared with Bulk, DeSCENT improved average C-index and generally improved time-dependent AUC, while integrated Brier score results were mixed. External validation showed higher average C-index than all three baselines, although performance was lower than in internal evaluation. These findings support the use of cellular representations in the evaluated transcriptome-only setting. AVAILABILITY AND IMPLEMENTATION: Code: https://github.com/YonghaoZhao722/DeSCENT. Archival snapshot: doi:10.5281/zenodo.22073099. SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

title: scPhyloGRN: gene regulatory network inference guided by lineage topology in single-cell developmental data
summary_zh: 研究单细胞发育数据中基因调控网络推断。方法：结合单细胞基因表达与细胞谱系拓扑结构。结果：提出scPhyloGRN框架，提高转录因子靶基因候选者优先级。
summary_en: Infer gene regulatory networks in single-cell developmental data. Method: Integrate single-cell gene expression with cellular phylogeny. Result: Propose the scPhyloGRN framework to prioritize TF-target candidates.
insights: 创新点：结合细胞谱系拓扑结构进行基因调控网络推断
方法亮点：提出scPhyloGRN框架，提高转录因子靶基因候选者优先级
关键发现：scPhyloGRN在多个数据集上优于其他方法
insights_en: Novelty: Inference of GRNs using cellular phylogeny topology
Method highlight: Proposing the scPhyloGRN framework for prioritizing TF-target candidates
Key finding: scPhyloGRN outperforms other methods across multiple datasets
abstract: MOTIVATION: Gene regulatory network (GRN) inference from single-cell transcriptomes is complicated by expression patterns associated with both cell state and shared ancestry. Cellular phylogenies provide developmental context, but incorporating relationships among individual cells into gene-level regulatory inference remains challenging. RESULTS: We present scPhyloGRN, a supervised framework that integrates single-cell gene expression with cellular phylogeny to prioritize directed transcription factor (TF)-target candidates within the observed gene set. The framework maps cell ancestry to gene associations that guide graph construction, attention in a dual-stream encoder, and lineage-consistency regularization. We evaluated scPhyloGRN against ten methods across 17 dataset-reference settings spanning four mouse embryos and one Caenorhabditis elegans dataset. scPhyloGRN showed an overall advantage in regulatory edge prioritization, supported by additional evaluations using shared candidate spaces. Removing lineage information reduced AUPRC in the ablation analyses, while branch-level and regulator-level analyses showed improved ranking and recovery of reference-supported regulatory candidates. AVAILABILITY AND IMPLEMENTATION: Source code and analysis workflows are available at https://github.com/Maria0852/scPhyloGRN, with a versioned archive at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22793831.

abstract: Importance It is unknown whether routine invasive management of chronic coronary disease improves long-term survival when added to guideline-directed medical therapy. Objective To compare the effects of initial invasive and conservative strategies on long-term mortality in patients with chronic coronary disease. Design, Setting, and Participants In this long-term follow-up study of the International Study of Comparative Health Effectiveness with Medical and Invasive Approaches (ISCHEMIA), an international trial of patients with chronic coronary disease, moderate or severe ischemia, left ventricular ejection fraction of 35% or more, and no left main coronary artery disease, unacceptable angina, or recent acute coronary syndrome, participants were randomized at 320 sites in 37 countries beginning August 2012 and followed up through December 2025. Data were analyzed using the intention-to-treat principle. Intervention ISCHEMIA randomized patients to an initial invasive strategy of guideline-directed medical therapy plus coronary angiography and revascularization (when feasible) or an initial conservative strategy with guideline-directed medical therapy alone, with invasive management for failure of medical therapy. Main Outcomes and Measures All-cause, cardiovascular, and noncardiovascular mortality were analyzed using cumulative incidence estimates, Cox and Fine-Gray models, bayesian analysis, and restricted mean survival time. Results Among 5179 participants, median age was 64 (IQR, 58-70) years; 23% were female, 42% had diabetes, and median ejection fraction was 60% (IQR, 55%-65%). During 9-year median follow-up (range, 1 day to 13.4 years), 1071 deaths occurred (782 during extended follow-up): 672 cardiovascular, 359 noncardiovascular, and 40 unclassified. All-cause 11-year mortality was not significantly different between groups (25.8% invasive vs 26.9% conservative; estimated difference, −1.0 percentage point [95% CI, −4.2 to 2.1 percentage points]; adjusted hazard ratio [AHR], 0.97 [95% CI, 0.86-1.09]). By bayesian analysis, the posterior probability of more than 1 percentage-point survival benefit to invasive vs conservative was low (18%). Cardiovascular mortality at 11 years was 15.8% in the invasive group vs 17.1% in the conservative group (estimated difference, −1.4 percentage points [95% CI, −4.0 to 1.3 percentage points]; AHR, 0.88 [95% CI, 0.75-1.02]). Noncardiovascular mortality at 11 years was 9.1% in the invasive group vs 8.1% in the conservative group (estimated difference, 1.0 percentage point [95% CI, −0.9 to 2.9 percentage points]; AHR, 1.18 [95% CI, 0.96-1.45]). Eleven-year restricted mean survival was not significantly different (estimated difference, 14 days [95% CI, −41 to 70 days]). Conclusions and Relevance In this study, long-term all-cause mortality in patients with high-risk chronic coronary disease was not significantly different after routine invasive vs initial conservative management. Trial Registration ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier: NCT04894877
